rows.title: Customer Insights and Activation Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion. 
If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then #korscareers would love to hear from you! 
"I feel really lucky to be surrounded by such a great team. I’m not only grateful that they’ve helped me achieve my goals, but also that I can give them a place where they can achieve theirs." - Michael Kors - 
Job Title: Customer Insights and Activation Analyst Reports to: Senior Manager, Customer Analytics Division: Michael Kors Location: London 
We have an exciting opportunity for a Customer Insights and Activation Analyst in our London office:

What You’ll Do  This role combines customer analysis, hands-on SQL data work, and driving customer audience strategy. You will play a key role in bridging data and marketing working closely with a wide range of stakeholders across Brand, Digital Marketing, Customer retention, and Clienteling to turn customer data into actionable marketing activity. 
Using SQL and Amperity (CDP) you will extract, shape and validate customer data, turning insights into targeted campaign audiences, and continuously refining those audiences based on performance and behaviour. You will transform complex data into clear insights which will help teams understand what’s happening and why. 
This role requires someone who is confident working directly with data and equally comfortable partnering with different teams, and who treats data accuracy and logic as non-negotiable. 

Customer Analytics & Insights  Analyse customer behaviour, engagement and purchase patterns to identify actionable insights Work with wider analytics team on deeper analysis (e.g. segmentation, propensity modelling inputs) Work with business teams to define audiences based on data-driven logic (e.g. lifecycle, value, propensity signals) that drive revenue or engagement Evaluate campaign performance and provide clear recommendations to improve targeting and ROI Support A/B testing design and measurement 
Data Activation (CDP super user) Translate marketing briefs into clear, actionable audience definitions Build, manage and execute customer segments within the CDP (Amperity) for use across email, paid media, and clienteling Use SQL to define, validate and QA audience selections before activation Ensure all customer selections are accurate, compliant, and aligned with marketing requirements (preferences, opt-outs, GDPR) Own segment naming conventions, taxonomy, and governance Support business teams with testing suggestions and best practice Work with legal and IT security departments on setting up connectors between CDP and external partners when needed 
Data & Technical Execution Understanding data landscapes and implication on data availability and accuracy Write and maintain clean, efficient SQL queries to extract and manipulate customer data from Snowflake and CDP Perform data validation and QA checks to ensure accuracy of all outputs used in marketing Troubleshoot data discrepancies across CDP, source systems and reporting outputs Drive best practices in data handling, documentation, and query structuring 
Stakeholder Collaboration Partner with Brand, Digital, Retention, Stores and other marketing teams to understand objectives and translate them into a data-driven solutions Communicate insights in a clear, actionable way (non-technical audience friendly) Act as a key link between data, analytics, and marketing execution 
What We’re Looking For Solid experience working with customer data and GDP Someone who can own end-to-end delivery: from gathering requirements → insight → presenting results → creating audience → evaluation of results Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to working with data A proactive individual who can work independently and manage multiple priorities A clear communicator who can simplify complex data for business stakeholders Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively across teams 
You’ll Need to Have Solid experience working with customer data and GDP Strong hands-on experience using SQL to query, manipulate and validate large datasets (this is essential) Advanced PowerPoint skills Advanced Excel skills Hands-on experience creating customer segments / audiences for campaigns Excellent attention to detail, with a strong focus on data accuracy and governance Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights 

MK Perks  A purpose-driven workplace where you can grow your career, enjoy flexible benefits, and be part of a culture built on inclusion, impact, and recognition. 
Career Growth Clear paths for progression, leadership opportunities, and mentorship programs to help you thrive. 
Work-Life Balance & Flexibility Support for your well-being with flexible work options and generous time-off policies. 
Culture & Belonging Be part of a culture that champions fairness, fosters belonging, and provides opportunities for everyone to grow and reach their full potential. 
Exclusive Employee Perks Enjoy discounts on premium products and luxury brands. 
Impact & Social Responsibility Contribute to global and local causes through volunteer days, sustainability programs, and charitable giving. 

To know more about working at Michael Kors follow us on LinkedIn and visit our Kors Careers Page

The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories.

rows.title: Compliance Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Compliance Data Analyst

This is an opportunity to take on a purpose-led role in the Compliance Data Analytics team focused on transforming compliance through data, automation and predictive insight, helping the organisation proactively identify and manage regulatory and conduct risks.You'll be consulting with our stakeholders to understand their needs and identify suitable data and analytics solutions to meet them along with business challenges in line with our purposeYou'll bring advanced analytics to life through visualisation in a meaningful way for key stakeholders, giving you excellent recognition for your work

What You'll Do

As a Compliance Data Analyst, you'll develop data-driven insights and analytics solutions that help identify and monitor conduct, compliance and regulatory risks across the organisation. You'll be working closely with compliance stakeholders to define detailed questions, problems or opportunities which can be supported through advanced analytics, making sure that new and existing processes are designed to be efficient, simple and automated where possible.

As Well As This, You'll Be

Delivering data and analytics expertise and solutions, that enhance regulatory compliance, strengthen risk oversight and support informed decision makingCommunicating data and analytics opportunities and bringing them to life in a way that compliance stakeholders can understand and engage with, supporting them to select the best approach for the business needsUsing new tools, technologies and methodologies to carry out advanced analyticsDesigning intuitive dashboards, metrics and management information that support risk-based decision making and oversightSharing relevant updates with key stakeholders bringing together advanced analytics, data science and data engineering work that is easily understandable and links back clearly to our business needs

The Skills You'll Need

We're looking for someone with a passion for data and analytics together with knowledge of data architecture, key tooling and relevant coding languages. Along with proficiency in advanced analytics, you'll bring an ability to simplify data into clear data visualisations and compelling insight using appropriate systems and tooling. You'll also have good financial services knowledge, and the ability to identify wider business impact, risk and opportunities, making connections across key outputs and processes.

You'll Also Demonstrate

Strong knowledge of data management principles, and experience working with large datasets within cloud-based data environmentsExperience using SQL to extract, manipulate and analyse data, including gathering, cleaning and transforming data from multiple sourcesExperience using Python for data preparation, analysis and visualisation, including libraries such as Plotly, together with exposure to JavaScriptDashboard design and data visualisation experience and best practicesKnowledge of data engineering, data science and decisioning disciplinesStrong communication skills with the ability to engage with a wide range of stakeholders and translate data into key insights

rows.title: Customer Experience Insights Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Consultant (CL9)

London or Manchester

Song AI and Data

We Are

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology and intelligence.

Visit us at: https://www.accenture.com/gb-en/about/accenture-song-index

The Role

Customers now move fluidly between digital and assisted channels, but many organisations still struggle to connect those interactions into a clear view of behaviour, experience and performance.

As a Customer Experience Insights Specialist, you will help clients understand customer behaviour, segments and journeys across CRM, contact centre, digital and first-party data. You will identify friction, explain channel performance and turn evidence into practical opportunities to improve customer experience and customer service.

This is a hands-on consulting role. You will use Python, analytics and generative AI to explore data, test hypotheses and create actionable insight. You will work directly with clients, independently lead analytical workstreams and stay focused on recommendations that can be implemented and measured.

What You Will Do

Understand Customer Behaviour & Journeys

Analyse customer behaviour, segments, journeys and interactions across digital and assisted channels

Identify journey friction, service failure demand, channel leakage and opportunities to improve customer outcomes

Develop segmentation and behavioural insights that support more relevant experiences and services

Connect Customer & Channel Data

Combine CRM, contact centre, digital analytics, customer feedback and first-party data to create a joined-up view of customer experience

Assess data quality, consistency and suitability for customer and channel analysis

Connect customer, operational and commercial measures to explain experience and performance

Generate Insight with Analytics & AI

Use Python and analytical techniques to explore data, test hypotheses, automate analysis and build repeatable insight products

Apply generative AI responsibly to accelerate analysis, synthesise evidence and enhance insight generation

Use visualisation and clear storytelling to communicate patterns, root causes and optimisation opportunities

Shape Optimisation & Strategy

Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for customer experience, customer service and channel strategy

Define practical measurement approaches for customer experience and channel performance

Work with service design, journey management, CRM, data and technology teams to move from insight to action

Engage Clients & Deliver

Lead analytical workstreams from problem definition through to recommendation

Engage client stakeholders and present findings to non-technical and senior audiences

Contribute reusable methods, assets and points of view to the Song AI and Data practice

Required - Experience & Knowledge

Experience in customer analytics, customer experience analytics, channel analytics or a closely related discipline

Practical knowledge of contact centre operations, customer service journeys, interaction data and performance measures

Experience and knowledge of CRM environments, customer journey management and omnichannel experience optimisation

Ability to combine digital, assisted-channel and first-party data to explain customer behaviour and performance

Strong hands-on Python skills, supported by experience with SQL, data visualisation or equivalent analytical tools

Experience using generative AI to support analysis, synthesis or insight development, with appropriate quality checks and judgement

Proven client-facing experience and the ability to communicate complex analysis to non-technical and senior stakeholders

Self-sufficient, proactive and comfortable delivering high-quality work in ambiguous, fast-paced environments

Preferred

Experience with digital analytics platforms such as Adobe Analytics, GA4 or Contentsquare

Experience with customer journey analytics or journey orchestration platforms

Experience with contact centre analytics, speech or text analytics, and voice-of-customer data

Knowledge of experimentation, optimisation, predictive analytics or machine learning

Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Who You Are

You are curious about why customers behave as they do and practical about turning that understanding into action. You are as comfortable exploring data and testing hypotheses as you are presenting a clear point of view to a client.

You create structure from ambiguity, take ownership of your work and stay focused on measurable customer and business outcomes. You are collaborative when the work requires it and self-sufficient when you need to move independently.

What's In It For You

Our Total Rewards consist of a competitive basic salary, annual performance bonus, opportunities to acquire equity and a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits.

These include:

30 days of leave per year plus 3 extra volunteering days for charitable work of your choice

Family-friendly and flexible work policies

Attractive pension plan with financial wellbeing support and resources

Private healthcare insurance plan and Mental Wellbeing support

Employee Assistance Programme, Career Development and Counselling

A range of generous Parental Leave offerings

SNGCR01


Experience in Customer Analytics, Customer Experience Analytics, or Channel Analytics.
Strong knowledge of CRM, customer journey management, and omnichannel experience optimization.
Understanding of contact centre operations, customer service journeys, and performance metrics.
Ability to analyze and combine customer, digital, and first-party data.
Strong hands-on Python skills with SQL and data visualization experience.
Experience using Generative AI for analysis and insight development.
Proven client-facing and stakeholder management experience.
Self-driven and able to work in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

rows.title: Burberry APP Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
INTRODUCTION

At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. This is the core belief that has guided Burberry since it was founded in 1856 and is central to how we operate as a company today.

We aim to provide an environment for creative minds from different backgrounds to thrive, bringing a wide range of skills and experiences to everything we do. As a purposeful, values-driven brand, we are committed to being a force for good in the world as well, creating the next generation of sustainable luxury for customers, driving industry change and championing our communities.

Job Purpose

We are hiring an APP Data Analyst to join Burberry's Asset & Profit Protection team, supporting a global function that helps protect our people, operations and business performance.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, risk and operational excellence, ensuring key reporting and insights are delivered with accuracy and impact. Working across multiple business functions, you will help maintain the integrity of critical datasets, support decision-making through analytics, and contribute to initiatives that strengthen risk management and operational efficiency.

The role offers broad exposure across the business, with opportunities to develop expertise in data analytics, reporting, fraud prevention and process improvement within a collaborative and highly experienced team.

Responsibilities

Maintain and enhance Asset & Profit Protection operational data, ensuring accuracy, consistency and data integrity across multiple sources.Cleanse, validate and manage incident, investigation, compliance and operational datasets to support reliable reporting.Maintain and develop Power BI dashboards, Power Apps and reporting tools used across global stakeholder groups.Support digital fraud activities, including chargeback analysis and related data investigations where required.Deliver analysis and reporting to support stock loss, compliance and risk-management initiatives across the business.Identify opportunities to improve processes, automate reporting and create new data solutions that drive efficiency and insight.

PERSONAL PROFILE

Experience working with large datasets and delivering accurate, insight-led reporting.Strong Excel capabilities and experience using Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power BI and Power Apps.A detail-oriented approach with a commitment to maintaining high standards of data quality.Confidence working independently while building effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.Curiosity and a proactive mindset when identifying trends, risks and opportunities within data.Experience in retail fraud prevention, Microsoft Access, SAP or SQL is beneficial but not essential.

Burberry is an Equal Opportunities Employer and as such, treats all applications equally and recruits purely on the basis of skills and experience.

rows.title: AI Workflow Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

The Group AI team owns Sky’s enterprise-wide AI ambition, strategy and roadmap to deliver meaningful business value and embed AI into the fabric of how Sky operates. Within this, the Workflow Transformation team is responsible for accelerating Sky’s Agentic transformation, embedding forward deployed teams within business functions to reimagine AI-enabled work, design AI solutions and collaboratively deliver deployments alongside technology and the other Group AI teams.

As AI Workflow Analyst, you will embed within business functions as part of forward deployed teams, partnering with business stakeholders to baseline existing processes, identify high-value opportunities for AI transformation and design AI-enabled workflows. You will combine analytical rigour with creative problem-solving to reimagine the future of how work gets done, developing business cases and translating opportunities into prioritised delivery roadmaps alongside AI Product Managers.

This is a great opportunity to be at the forefront of reimagining how work gets done at Sky, helping move the organisation from today's processes to AI-enabled workflows that unlock new levels of efficiency, effectiveness and employee experience.

What you’ll do 

Map and analyse complex business processes, understanding current state workflows and identifying pain points, inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement. Identify and prioritise high-value AI use cases, building business cases that assess impact, feasibility and value. Facilitate stakeholder workshops to reimagine and design AI-enabled ways of working. Design future-state processes and service blueprints that translate vision into actionable requirements and seamlessly integrate human judgement and AI capabilities. Translate strategy into action through clear process documentation, workflow requirements and implementation plans. Build data-driven business cases that quantify and track value, costs and implementation feasibility Drive adoption of deployed solutions through targeted engagement and change management activities Continuously scan the market and bring AI best practices and new tools to adapt and improve methodology 

What you’ll bring  

You’ll be an AI advocate with a relentlessly curious, experimental mindset, constantly exploring emerging AI tools and technologies. Experience in business analysis, process improvement or management consulting, with the proven ability to map complex processes and design effective solution/improvements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, comfortable tackling ambiguity and using data to drive decisions. Proven ability to translate complex business challenges into clear structured frameworks, insights and actionable recommendations. Skilled in qualitative research and quantitative analysis, using visualisation tools such as Excel and Tableau to generate insights. Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to present, to influence and engage senior stakeholders. Commercially minded, balancing ambition with pragmatism and prioritising work based on business value. Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly and working effectively through change and ambiguity. 

Benefits and perks 

There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here’s a taster:  

Free Sky TV or NOW package, including Sky Sports and Sky Cinema    Pension package with up to 9% employer contribution  Private healthcare with mental health support   Aviva Digital GP and dental insurance   Discounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky Protect   Sharesave and Tech schemes   A range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences  

How you’ll work 

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 3 days in the office per week. 

 

Your office base  

Our Sky Group HQ. Equipped with state-of-the-art technology and workspaces, there’s plenty of space to see your big ideas come to life. Here you’ll find 13 subsidised restaurants and cafes. You can re-energise at our gym, catch the latest films at our cinema, get your car washed and even get pampered at our beauty salon.  

Our Osterley Campus is just a 10-minute walk from Syon Lane train station, or you can get one of our free shuttle buses from Osterley, Gunnersbury and Ealing Broadway stations. Plus, there’s free onsite parking available for cars, motorbikes and bicycles. 

 

Who we are 

We’re Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you’ll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.

 

We’re an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We're a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need as early as you can. 

Just so you know: if your application is successful, we’ll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.  

To be eligible for this role you are required to have the appropriate right to work in the UK. Please be aware Sky does not offer sponsorship for this position.

To find out more about working with us, search on social media.

rows.title: 2027 Operations Intern - London
rows.descriptionText:
About The Internship

Operations are the heart and soul of Uber. These teams are bridging the gap between the virtual and the physical world every day by enabling movement. Movement of people, things, food, and more. We are looking for highly motivated problem-solvers who are passionate about Operations. You will work alongside Operations Managers and partner with teams across our Mobility business.

You will get the chance to work on impactful projects that involve analysing data sets, providing creative solutions and leaning into the execution. You will help support decision making within your teams through your critical thinking, strategic analysis, and data-driven approach.

What You'll Do

 Embark on a chance to reimagine the way the world moves by focusing on real-time, impactful projects  Learn the vast inner workings of Uber - you will have a direct impact on Riders, Drivers, Consumers, Couriers, Restaurants and/or the Marketplace  Solve key strategic problems through analytical frameworks and insights to advise the team on key decisions  Experiment with new products and efficiencies aiming to improve our operations, spanning pricing, demand building, segmentation, customer operations and much more.  Collaborate and engage with a number of functions across the business - operations, finance, policy, communications, product, marketing, legal, and customer support.

rows.title: Actuarial (General Insurance) Industrial Placement Programme 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Location: London, Farnborough, Birmingham or Whiteley

Start Date: June 2027

Closing date for applications: Sunday 18th October 2026

Insurance is so much more than you think! 

Do you want to discover more about careers that will excite, challenge and inspire you? If so, a Zurich industrial placement could be just what you're looking for.

Forget any preconceptions you have about the insurance industry. Our one-year industrial placements give you a real job with real responsibility and a taste of life working at Zurich.

With plenty of support around you, you’ll experience how your future career might look and help us make a difference to our customers at a time when they need us the most.

Our industrial placements are ideal for students in their penultimate year of study. As well as gaining some great experience, successful completion of your industrial placement in 2027 could lead to you being offered a place on one of our graduate programmes starting in 2028.

What can I look forward to?

From day one, you'll be working on real business challenges that make a genuine difference. Our insurance solutions help protect everyone from individual customers and small businesses to local authorities and some of the world's largest organisations. Behind every insurance policy is a team of actuaries helping to understand risk, make informed decisions, and shape business strategy.

As part of the actuarial team, you'll learn from experienced actuaries and analysts across the UK and our wider global business. You'll be supported every step of the way, starting with a dedicated buddy before you join, who'll help you settle in and answer any questions as you begin your career.

Within our General Insurance business, there are two exciting actuarial pathways:

Actuarial reserving - Help answer one of the most important questions in insurance: how much will future claims cost? You'll use data, statistical techniques, and analytical thinking to predict future outcomes, identify emerging trends, provide valuable business insights, and support capital management decisions. Your work will play a key role in ensuring the long-term strength and stability of the business. Actuarial pricing - Discover how data drives business decisions. You'll help determine the price of insurance products by analysing risk, customer behaviour, and market trends. From improving customer segmentation to developing innovative pricing models and technology, you'll contribute to solutions that keep us competitive while delivering value to customers. 

As well as working alongside qualified actuaries, we also provide internal actuarial training to help you understand some of the other work we do, so you can get insight into work that you may not necessarily get a chance to be involved in.

What’s in it for you? 

As well as joining a company that is passionate about sustainability and our customers, you can expect:

£24,968.58 salary 28 days holiday plus an additional three volunteering days You can request to swap UK bank holidays for days off that have cultural or religious significance to you Full private medical cover 12% company pension contribution Annual company bonus Discounted gym membership Discounted gadget insurance Discounted technology offers 

What you’ll need: 

Although we are a hybrid workforce, you should be within a commutable distance of your assigned office.

Additioanlly, you'll need:

strong mathematical skills, an analytical approach and a high level of numerical aptitudeThe ability to learn new technical skills, feel comfortable working with large amounts of data or information, and have an eye for detail Excellent team-working, communication and interpersonal skills A strong interest in pursuing an actuarial career post-graduation, alongside maintaining office performance the ability to build strong working relationships

Entry Requirements: 

You must be in your penultimate year of study and on course to achieve a 2.1 (or above) in a STEM-related or Economics degree subject at a bachelor's level (or equivalent) A minimum C/4 grade in both English and Maths at GCSE level (or equivalent). A minimum A grade at Mathmatics A-level At least 128 UCAS points from 3 A-Level subjects (or equivalent) You must have an indefinite, full right to work and reside in the UK. We cannot accept applications from those who require sponsorship to work in the UK. You must have resided in the UK for a minimum of three consecutive years. 

Are you ready to create a brighter future?  

At Zurich our brand purpose is to create a brighter future together, for our customers, our partners, our employees and the planet. It’s a promise that for our customers, we will put their needs at the heart of everything we do and for our employees, to grow and develop together. For our partners, to collaborate to create mutual value and for the planet, to drive positive impact by integrating our sustainability work into how we do business. We put our customers at the heart of everything that we do, and we’re looking for like-minded people to join us.

We’re passionate about diversity and inclusion; we want our people to bring the whole of themselves to work. You’ll have every opportunity to use your drive and enthusiasm to innovate the future of Zurich. Everybody is made to feel welcome, different opinions are valued, personal needs are respected, and opportunity is equal for all.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work for us. 

Please note we are unable to progress your application if you don't meet our criteria listed above. Please ensure you have the right to reside and work in the UK before you apply as we are unable to provide sponsorship. You must have resided in the UK for a minimum of three consecutive years in order to apply.

Consultant (CL9)

London or Manchester

Song AI and Data

We Are

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology and intelligence.

Visit us at: https://www.accenture.com/gb-en/about/accenture-song-index

The Role

Customers now move fluidly between digital and assisted channels, but many organisations still struggle to connect those interactions into a clear view of behaviour, experience and performance.

As a Customer Experience Insights Specialist, you will help clients understand customer behaviour, segments and journeys across CRM, contact centre, digital and first-party data. You will identify friction, explain channel performance and turn evidence into practical opportunities to improve customer experience and customer service.

This is a hands-on consulting role. You will use Python, analytics and generative AI to explore data, test hypotheses and create actionable insight. You will work directly with clients, independently lead analytical workstreams and stay focused on recommendations that can be implemented and measured.

What You Will Do

Understand Customer Behaviour & Journeys

Analyse customer behaviour, segments, journeys and interactions across digital and assisted channels

Identify journey friction, service failure demand, channel leakage and opportunities to improve customer outcomes

Develop segmentation and behavioural insights that support more relevant experiences and services

Connect Customer & Channel Data

Combine CRM, contact centre, digital analytics, customer feedback and first-party data to create a joined-up view of customer experience

Assess data quality, consistency and suitability for customer and channel analysis

Connect customer, operational and commercial measures to explain experience and performance

Generate Insight with Analytics & AI

Use Python and analytical techniques to explore data, test hypotheses, automate analysis and build repeatable insight products

Apply generative AI responsibly to accelerate analysis, synthesise evidence and enhance insight generation

Use visualisation and clear storytelling to communicate patterns, root causes and optimisation opportunities

Shape Optimisation & Strategy

Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for customer experience, customer service and channel strategy

Define practical measurement approaches for customer experience and channel performance

Work with service design, journey management, CRM, data and technology teams to move from insight to action

Engage Clients & Deliver

Lead analytical workstreams from problem definition through to recommendation

Engage client stakeholders and present findings to non-technical and senior audiences

Contribute reusable methods, assets and points of view to the Song AI and Data practice

Required - Experience & Knowledge

Experience in customer analytics, customer experience analytics, channel analytics or a closely related discipline

Practical knowledge of contact centre operations, customer service journeys, interaction data and performance measures

Experience and knowledge of CRM environments, customer journey management and omnichannel experience optimisation

Ability to combine digital, assisted-channel and first-party data to explain customer behaviour and performance

Strong hands-on Python skills, supported by experience with SQL, data visualisation or equivalent analytical tools

Experience using generative AI to support analysis, synthesis or insight development, with appropriate quality checks and judgement

Proven client-facing experience and the ability to communicate complex analysis to non-technical and senior stakeholders

Self-sufficient, proactive and comfortable delivering high-quality work in ambiguous, fast-paced environments

Preferred

Experience with digital analytics platforms such as Adobe Analytics, GA4 or Contentsquare

Experience with customer journey analytics or journey orchestration platforms

Experience with contact centre analytics, speech or text analytics, and voice-of-customer data

Knowledge of experimentation, optimisation, predictive analytics or machine learning

Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Who You Are

You are curious about why customers behave as they do and practical about turning that understanding into action. You are as comfortable exploring data and testing hypotheses as you are presenting a clear point of view to a client.

You create structure from ambiguity, take ownership of your work and stay focused on measurable customer and business outcomes. You are collaborative when the work requires it and self-sufficient when you need to move independently.

rows.title: Security Systems Engineer - Security Clearence
rows.descriptionText:
About CyberFortis
CyberFortis Consulting Limited is a UK cybersecurity and technology company developing AI-enabled governance, risk and compliance solutions and expanding its capabilities in secure government and defence technology.We are seeking an experienced Security & Secure Systems Engineer to support the design, implementation and assurance of secure technical environments for defence-oriented software and AI capabilities.The successful candidate will work closely with company leadership and engineering teams to translate security requirements into practical technical controls, support secure system delivery, and produce the evidence required for technical assurance and security review.This role is suited to an engineer who combines hands-on security implementation with a strong understanding of secure system architecture, operational risk and security assurance.
Role Purpose
The Security & Secure Systems Engineer will be responsible for developing, implementing and validating security controls across application, infrastructure, identity, data and deployment layers.The role will support secure-by-design engineering, security risk management, vulnerability remediation, operational security and the preparation of technical assurance documentation.The successful candidate must understand that security is an engineering discipline: controls must be implemented, tested, evidenced and maintained throughout the system lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities 
1.Secure Architecture and EngineeringDesign and review secure system architectures, identifying security risks and appropriate mitigations.Translate security requirements into implementable technical controls and engineering standards.Conduct threat modelling and attack-surface analysis for applications, APIs, data flows and infrastructure.Apply secure-by-design principles across development, integration, deployment and maintenance.Review system boundaries, trust relationships, dependencies and external service integrations.Support security architecture decisions for AI-enabled applications and associated data-processing components.
2. Infrastructure and Environment Security Implement and validate secure configurations across approved cloud, infrastructure and application environments.Configure identity and access management, role-based access controls and least-privilege permissions.Support privileged-access management, secrets management, key handling and secure configuration practices.Establish and review security logging, monitoring, alerting and audit-trail requirements.Support network segmentation, environment separation, secure connectivity and controlled administrative access.Assist with backup protection, recovery arrangements, configuration management and operational resilience.
3. Vulnerability Management and Security TestingConduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation activities.Review dependency, container, operating-system, application and infrastructure security findings.Support secure code reviews, configuration reviews and penetration-testing activities.Assess findings according to technical severity, exploitability, exposure and operational impact.Maintain remediation records and verify that security fixes are effective.Develop repeatable security checks that can be incorporated into development and deployment pipelines.
4. Secure Software Development and DevSecOpsIntegrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines and release processes.Support software composition analysis, secrets detection, static analysis and container-image scanning.Establish security acceptance criteria for releases and document residual risks.Work with software engineers to remediate vulnerabilities without unnecessarily disrupting delivery.Maintain secure configuration baselines and support infrastructure-as-code security reviews.Help establish auditable release, change-management and deployment practices.
5. AI and Data Security Review the security implications of LLM integrations, AI orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation and external model services.Assess data flows involving prompts, outputs, embeddings, document stores, caches, telemetry and logs.Help implement appropriate controls for data classification, retention, access, encryption and deletion.Assess prompt injection, insecure tool use, data leakage, excessive agent permissions and other AI-specific attack paths.Support controls that prevent unauthorised use of project data for model training or unrelated processing.Ensure that AI-generated outputs, where relevant, are subject to appropriate validation, traceability and human oversight.
6. Security Assurance and Compliance EvidenceTranslate applicable contractual security requirements into a control implementation and evidence matrix.Prepare and maintain security architecture documents, threat models, risk registers, configuration records and remediation plans.Support security reviews, technical assurance activities and responses to customer security findings.Maintain traceability between requirements, implemented controls, test results and supporting evidence.Support relevant organisational security assessments and improvement plans.Work with the project team to identify security gaps early and track them through to closure or formally accepted remediation.
7. Defence and Government SecurityWork within the security instructions, information-handling rules and access restrictions applicable to each assigned project.Support the implementation of customer-approved security requirements and operational procedures.Identify when a proposed design, hosting arrangement, service or integration requires additional approval.Escalate security incidents, suspected data exposure and material control failures through the designated process.Cooperate with authorised customer security personnel and assurance representatives.Maintain appropriate separation between development, testing and environments handling protected information.
Essential Requirements
Candidates must demonstrate:Active, valid UK SC clearance, subject to verification through the appropriate authorised process.Substantial practical experience in cybersecurity engineering, secure systems engineering, infrastructure security or a closely related discipline.Strong understanding of security architecture, threat modelling and risk-based control implementation.Hands-on experience with identity and access management, least privilege, authentication and privileged access.Practical experience with vulnerability management, secure configuration and security remediation.Understanding of secure software development and DevSecOps practices.Experience with security logging, monitoring, auditability and incident-response processes.Familiarity with cloud security, containers, APIs and modern application architectures.Ability to produce clear technical documentation and evidence that supports independent security review.Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with developers, architects and project stakeholders.A disciplined approach to handling sensitive information and complying with security procedures.
Desirable Experience
The following would be advantageous:Experience supporting UK government or Ministry of Defence technology programmes.Experience with systems subject to formal security assurance or accreditation.Familiarity with UK government security policies and relevant NCSC guidance.Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, IBM Cloud or other enterprise cloud environments.Familiarity with IBM watsonx, LLM application architectures or enterprise AI platforms.Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, infrastructure as code and automated security tooling.Knowledge of data classification, cryptographic controls, key management and secure data handling.Experience with ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus or other relevant security frameworks.Experience with security requirements traceability, technical risk registers and remediation tracking.Relevant security, cloud or infrastructure certifications.
Initial Deliverables
During the initial engagement, the engineer will be expected to contribute to:A security architecture and threat model for the assigned system and deployment environment.A security requirements and controls matrix mapped to the applicable contractual requirements.An assessment of the existing security posture, including prioritised findings and remediation recommendations.A secure configuration baseline covering identity, access, logging, secrets and deployment controls.A vulnerability-management and remediation workflow with clear ownership and verification.Security checks integrated into the engineering and release lifecycle, where appropriate.An evidence pack containing relevant architecture documents, test results, control records and outstanding risks.A documented security handover and recommendations for ongoing operational assurance.Deliverables and acceptance criteria will be agreed with the successful candidate in line with the actual project scope and customer requirements.
Working Expectations
Work closely with the company leadership and technical delivery team.Communicate security risks clearly, with practical remediation options and prioritisation.Maintain accurate records of security decisions, control implementation and outstanding issues.Avoid unsupported claims about compliance, accreditation or security effectiveness.Distinguish implemented and tested controls from planned controls and documented policies.Do not access, transfer or process classified or otherwise restricted information except where the individual, organisation, systems and environment are appropriately authorised.Follow applicable contractual, legal and organisational security requirements.
CyberFortis Consulting Limited is committed to secure-by-design engineering, responsible AI development and rigorous technical assurance.

Responsibilities

The Seller Experience Team is dedicated to enhancing the experience throughout the entire seller journey on TikTok Shop, from onboarding sellers and listing products to addressing violations and appeals, as well as optimizing logistics and providing comprehensive seller and AM education. Strong strategic thinking with the ability to break down complex problems and prioritize impactful solutions. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. Experience in strategy & operations, business analysis, or XFN project management. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or campaign operations from coursework, personal projects, or previous internships. Background in business development, account management, or consulting is a plus. Creative thinker with the ability to propose data-backed campaign improvements. Strong execution skills: ability to handle multiple tasks, coordinate stakeholders, communication with brands, and ensure smooth campaign operations.

rows.title: Analyst-Marketing
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.

As an Analyst, SEO & AI Search Optimization, you will play a critical role in advancing American Express’ visibility in this new landscape. You will help ensure our content is not only indexed—but also interpreted, trusted, and surfaced in AI-generated responses.

This role blends technical SEO, structured data, and AI-ready content optimization. You will partner across product, engineering, marketing, and analytics teams to improve how American Express content performs across both search engines and large language models (LLMs).

This is a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and help shape how one of the world’s most trusted brands shows up in the future of search.

Responsibilities

 SEO & AEO Strategy - Support enterprise SEO and AEO initiatives across traditional and AI-driven search platforms  Support and lead the SEO and AEO strategy for International markets – support the execution of the international markets, by owning one or several markets, including the relationship with local stakeholders  Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner with cross-functional teams to improve discoverability and representation of Amex content  Technical SEO Foundations - Support crawlability, indexation, and rendering improvements  Structured Data & Performance - Assist with structured data implementation such as schema.org and JSON-LD and support site performance optimization  AI Search Optimization - Help optimize content for AI-generated answers including structure, clarity, and intent alignment  AI Visibility & Gaps Analysis - Identify gaps in how Amex content is surfaced or interpreted across AI platforms  Performance Measurement - Track search performance and emerging AI metrics such as visibility, citations, and accuracy  Insights & Optimization - Identify trends and opportunities to improve search performance  Execution & Delivery - Partner with product, engineering, content, and agency teams to implement best practices  Education & Enablement - Support documentation and education of SEO and AEO standards across teams 

Qualifications

 2+ years of SEO experience(agency or in-house; enterprise/global experience a plus).  Familiarity with SEO tools (e.g., Conductor, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, etc.).  Advanced technical SEO understanding and web architecture (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).  Exposure to or interest in using Generative AI to enhance SEO workflows.  Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.  Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail.  Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field (preferred). 

Non-considerations For Sponsorship

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the UK is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

Competitive base salariesBonus incentivesSupport for financial-well-being and retirementComprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business needGenerous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds programCareer development and training opportunities

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

rows.title: AI Workflow Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

The Group AI team owns Sky’s enterprise-wide AI ambition, strategy and roadmap to deliver meaningful business value and embed AI into the fabric of how Sky operates. Within this, the Workflow Transformation team is responsible for accelerating Sky’s Agentic transformation, embedding forward deployed teams within business functions to reimagine AI-enabled work, design AI solutions and collaboratively deliver deployments alongside technology and the other Group AI teams.

As AI Workflow Analyst, you will embed within business functions as part of forward deployed teams, partnering with business stakeholders to baseline existing processes, identify high-value opportunities for AI transformation and design AI-enabled workflows. You will combine analytical rigour with creative problem-solving to reimagine the future of how work gets done, developing business cases and translating opportunities into prioritised delivery roadmaps alongside AI Product Managers.

This is a great opportunity to be at the forefront of reimagining how work gets done at Sky, helping move the organisation from today's processes to AI-enabled workflows that unlock new levels of efficiency, effectiveness and employee experience.

What you’ll do 

Map and analyse complex business processes, understanding current state workflows and identifying pain points, inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement. Identify and prioritise high-value AI use cases, building business cases that assess impact, feasibility and value. Facilitate stakeholder workshops to reimagine and design AI-enabled ways of working. Design future-state processes and service blueprints that translate vision into actionable requirements and seamlessly integrate human judgement and AI capabilities. Translate strategy into action through clear process documentation, workflow requirements and implementation plans. Build data-driven business cases that quantify and track value, costs and implementation feasibility Drive adoption of deployed solutions through targeted engagement and change management activities Continuously scan the market and bring AI best practices and new tools to adapt and improve methodology 

What you’ll bring  

You’ll be an AI advocate with a relentlessly curious, experimental mindset, constantly exploring emerging AI tools and technologies. Experience in business analysis, process improvement or management consulting, with the proven ability to map complex processes and design effective solution/improvements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, comfortable tackling ambiguity and using data to drive decisions. Proven ability to translate complex business challenges into clear structured frameworks, insights and actionable recommendations. Skilled in qualitative research and quantitative analysis, using visualisation tools such as Excel and Tableau to generate insights. Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to present, to influence and engage senior stakeholders. Commercially minded, balancing ambition with pragmatism and prioritising work based on business value. Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly and working effectively through change and ambiguity. 

Benefits and perks 

There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here’s a taster:  

Free Sky TV or NOW package, including Sky Sports and Sky Cinema    Pension package with up to 9% employer contribution  Private healthcare with mental health support   Aviva Digital GP and dental insurance   Discounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky Protect   Sharesave and Tech schemes   A range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences  

How you’ll work 

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 3 days in the office per week. 

 

Your office base  

Our Sky Group HQ. Equipped with state-of-the-art technology and workspaces, there’s plenty of space to see your big ideas come to life. Here you’ll find 13 subsidised restaurants and cafes. You can re-energise at our gym, catch the latest films at our cinema, get your car washed and even get pampered at our beauty salon.  

Our Osterley Campus is just a 10-minute walk from Syon Lane train station, or you can get one of our free shuttle buses from Osterley, Gunnersbury and Ealing Broadway stations. Plus, there’s free onsite parking available for cars, motorbikes and bicycles. 

 

Who we are 

We’re Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you’ll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.

 

We’re an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We're a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need as early as you can. 

Just so you know: if your application is successful, we’ll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.  

To be eligible for this role you are required to have the appropriate right to work in the UK. Please be aware Sky does not offer sponsorship for this position.

To find out more about working with us, search on social media.

rows.title: Product Business Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Your role: The Senior Business Analyst is a senior analytical voice at the intersection of product thinking, commercial analysis, and delivery execution. This role sets the standard of excellence for analysis, personally leads work on the most complex and highest-risk initiatives, and manages and develops other BAs working alongside them. The right person brings a product and user-problems mindset, uses AI as a daily practice tool, and is as comfortable influencing a roadmap as they are writing a user flow.
We are a fast paced, forward thinking and enjoyable place to work. Business Analysts here are at the heart of our most exciting initiatives to ensure alignment between business goals and technical implementations.
Your team: The Sun comprises digital product teams supporting development and enhancement of The Sun Website, The Sun Mobile App and The Sun membership products. Evolving these products are critical to the continued success of the brand. We are an agile, cross-functional programme, working together to ensure the digital products can continue to meet the needs of the business and customers by improving the user experience, underlying platform and operational tools for teams.
Day to day you will:
Own the end-to-end discovery lifecycle on complex initiatives, owning the analysis from problem definition through to a build-ready solution.Build strong relationships with key executive stakeholders, and align stakeholders and squads around objective data and evidence, leading workshops to drive rapid agreement on goals, priorities, and scope.Proactively contribute to and adopt the standard of excellence for analysis, defining and embedding templates, methodologies, and metric accountability frameworks that ensure consistency and quality.Directly manage and/or mentor other BAs, building individual capability in product thinking, AI fluency, post-launch validation, and commercial framing.Work closely with the Lead Business Analyst to maintain a view of programme priorities and ensure analytical effort is directed to the highest-value initiatives, and not absorbed by low-value work.Act as the connective tissue, ensuring logic and decisions across its initiatives are consistent and don't create downstream problems for other teams.Apply commercial literacy to connect analysis to revenue impact, cost trade-offs, and business opportunity - framing recommendations in ways that actively steer roadmap and product decisionsLeverage AI effectively in their daily work and continuously identifying new opportunities to improve analytical speed and quality
What we’re looking for from you:
You will join The Sun Customer Product team, acting as a strategic partner to Technology, Marketing and other Customer teams. Operating at the heart of our most critical teams, you will drive initiatives across the entire subscriber lifecycle. Hence we are looking for someone who has:
Experienced leading discovery analysis on complex, high-risk product initiatives, with a track record of translating ambiguous problems into clear, executable logic and requirements.Proven ability to operate at senior stakeholder level - building strong, trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, framing analysis in commercial terms, and driving rapid decision-making on high-stakes trade-offsExperience managing and developing Business Analysts, with demonstrable success in shifting ways of working toward higher-value, more product-led analysis. Where required, actively support hiring for additional contract resource, from designing assessments through to evaluating and interviewing candidatesStrong analytical literacy - able to connect analytical findings to revenue impact, cost to serve, and business opportunity, and communicate this fluently to non-analytical audiencesExperience contributing to or improving practice standards, templates, or methodologies at team or programme levelAbility to maintain a clear view of priorities and proactively allocate analytical effort to where it will have the greatest impactAwareness of competitive product landscapes, with the ability to incorporate competitor intelligence into strategic decisions and discovery planningAdvanced, demonstrable use of AI tools in analytical work - including experience building or formalising AI workflows or productivity standards for a team
We are News UK: One of the leading media businesses in the UK and Ireland. Our newsbrands include The Times, The Sunday Times, The Sun, The Sun on Sunday and The TLS. Our national broadcast brands include talkSPORT, Times Radio, Talk and Virgin Radio UK, and we have market-leading local radio stations across Ireland. Life at News
Driven by passion, guided by principles and acting with purpose. We represent, reflect and reach the nation, telling the stories that matter. We inform our audiences so that they can make decisions based on trusted information.
To do this, we believe our employees must represent different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. We strive to maximise and encourage every individual’s potential and ensure everyone feels valued. We support this through our Diversity Strategy, which focuses on three main priorities - attracting talent from a wider, more representative pool, developing equity programmes to drive better representation in our leadership, and ensuring diversity in our workforce as well as the journalism and content we produce. We also currently have 13 employee led networks and groups that support our strategy and connect like minded employees socially.
Benefits
Some of our benefits include:
Maternity leave up to 18 weeks full basic salary & paternity leave up to 2 weeksWide range of training available, plus full LinkedIn Learning accessPrivate medical insurance including coverage for pre-existing conditionsDiscounted gym memberships, free ClassPass at Home, weekly virtual yoga classes‘Bikes for Work’ and ‘Electric Car’ schemeUp to 60% discount on Harper Collins booksAccess to exclusive events and competitions with exciting brands such as talkSPORT, Virgin Radio UK & The Times. rows.title: Burberry APP Data Analyst

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

About the team

The Seller Experience Team is dedicated to enhancing the experience throughout the entire seller journey on TikTok Shop, from onboarding sellers and listing products to addressing violations and appeals, as well as optimizing logistics and providing comprehensive seller and AM education. Our primary objective is to ensure a seamless and efficient process that empowers our sellers to succeed on the platform.

The team focuses on improving the end-to-end seller journey on TikTok Shop—from seller onboarding and product listing to fulfillment, logistics, aftersales, violations, etc. Our goal is to create a seamless and efficient ecosystem that enables sellers to succeed on the platform.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 3 months long internship period.

About The Role:

As a Specialist, you will analyze seller experience across the entire lifecycle, identify key blockers through data insights and case reviews, and develop strategic, scalable solutions. This role plays a critical part in bridging sellers, BizOps, and XFN teams by capturing the voice of sellers and translating it into actionable improvements.

You will work on high-priority initiatives, partnering closely with Biz Ops, Governance, Product, and other XFN teams to drive strategic solutions and measurable improvements in seller experience.

Responsibilities:

 Seller Experience Analysis: Conduct data analysis and case deep dives to uncover root causes behind seller pain points and operational inefficiencies. Strategic Solution Development: Identify and prioritize key seller experience issues and develop systematic, scalable solutions across areas such as onboarding, listing, and violation management. Project Management: Drive cross-functional initiatives with Product, GNE, Operations, and other teams to implement improvement projects. Metrics & Reporting: Track key seller experience metrics and provide insights and recommendations to support leadership decision-making. Stakeholder Communication: Support project reviews and leadership updates to ensure alignment and transparency across teams.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

 University students in Marketing, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, Communications, or related fields. Analytical skills: proficient in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, data visualisation); familiarity with SQL or BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, Google Data Studio) is a plus. Strong strategic thinking with the ability to break down complex problems and prioritize impactful solutions. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. Experience in strategy & operations, business analysis, or XFN project management. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or campaign operations from coursework, personal projects, or previous internships. Background in business development, account management, or consulting is a plus. Creative thinker with the ability to propose data-backed campaign improvements. Strong execution skills: ability to handle multiple tasks, coordinate stakeholders, communication with brands, and ensure smooth campaign operations.

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

Competitive base salariesBonus incentivesSupport for financial-well-being and retirementComprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business needGenerous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds programCareer development and training opportunities
