rows.descriptionText:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services.

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. Learn more here: https://www.parametricportfolio.com/about

This role is part of Parametric’ s hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis and Alpharetta, GA

Excellent opportunity for recent or soon to be 2027 graduates! Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis, Alpharetta

SUMMER COHORT STARTS - July 2027

About The Operations Analyst Program

The Operations Analyst Program is an early-career development opportunity for driven recent and soon-to-be graduates who want to launch a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, data, and technology. Analysts use analytical, technical, and collaborative skills to help deliver operational excellence, solve business challenges, and improve outcomes for clients.

As investment operations evolve through data, automation, and AI, analysts gain hands-on experience supporting business-critical investment processes while helping identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Through ownership of operational processes and exposure to continuous improvement, data analytics, automation, workflow design, and AI, analysts strengthen controls, improve decision-making, and contribute to scalable solutions that support clients and business growth.

Over three weeks, Analysts begin as a cohort with an immersion in Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and Operations organization. Following onboarding, analysts join teams supporting Market, Client, or Control functions, where they develop domain expertise, learn business-critical workflows, and build an end-to-end understanding of how Operations supports clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.

Operations teams are responsible for the execution, oversight, servicing, and control activities that support the investment lifecycle. Analysts work closely with teammates and stakeholders across the organization to execute processes accurately, resolve operational challenges, improve controls, and deliver exceptional client outcomes.

In addition to their core team responsibilities, analysts may collaborate with specialized teams within Operations focused on process transformation, analytics, workflow modernization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Partnering with subject matter experts across Market, Client, and Control functions to identify opportunities, redesign processes, and implement scalable improvements that enhance operational effectiveness. Through this partnership, analysts may gain exposure to transformation initiatives while continuing to build deep operational expertise.

The program is designed for people who are curious about how businesses operate, motivated to improve processes, and eager to continue learning. As business needs evolve, analysts may gain exposure to different Operations functions, participate in cross-functional initiatives, or contribute to transformation efforts, broadening their knowledge, experience, and skill sets.

What You'll Do And Learn

Learn Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and business-critical Operations workflows, and understand how Market, Client, and Control functions support clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.Learn and execute business-critical investment operations workflows accurately and on time. Responsibilities may include activities such as cash and position reconciliation, trade lifecycle support, client servicing, corporate actions, account onboarding and maintenance, contracts, oversight activities, and billing, depending on team assignment.Develop an end-to-end understanding of assigned processes, including activities, decisions, systems, data flows, controls, handoffs, and upstream and downstream dependencies.Investigate exceptions, breaks, recurring operational issues, and client-impacting events using structured problem-solving and data analysis. Identify root causes, assess impacts, and recommend sustainable solutions.Partner with Operations teams, portfolio managers, traders, sales, product management, technology teams, external providers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues, improve handoffs, and support business priorities.Perform quality control and verification activities, maintain accurate records and documentation, and help ensure operational processes meet established policies, procedures, and control standards.Analyze operational and investment data to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, bottlenecks, and emerging risks. Build reports, dashboards, or analytical tools that turn data into actionable insights and improvement opportunities.Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or redesign workflows and contribute to process mapping, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and adoption activities.Collaborate with Automation, Reinvention & Collaboration (ARC) and other partners on process-improvement initiatives, workflow modernization efforts, analytics projects, automation solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.Use or learn tools such as Excel, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, and approved AI solutions, as appropriate to the assignment.Contribute to operational excellence, analytics, automation, or process-improvement initiatives and present findings, recommendations, and outcomes to team members and business partners.

What You'll Bring

Associate or bachelor's degree completed by the program start date. Relevant fields may include industrial, process, or systems engineering; operations research; supply chain; data science or analytics; computer science; information systems; mathematics; statistics; finance; accounting; economics; or a related analytical, business, or technical field. Candidates from other majors with relevant quantitative, technical, or process-improvement experience are also encouraged to apply.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous issues, work with data, identify root causes, and form well-supported conclusions.A systems-thinking and continuous-improvement mindset, including curiosity about how people, processes, data, controls, and technology interact end to end and a desire to make work simpler, more accurate, efficient, scalable, and controlled.High attention to detail and a commitment to quality, sound judgment, risk awareness, responsible use of data and technology, and positive client outcomes.Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with teammates and stakeholders and communicate complex ideas in a clear and organized manner.Ownership, learning agility, adaptability, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.Experience using spreadsheets to organize and analyze information and communicate findings, or the ability to learn quickly.Strong interest in building a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, process improvement, data, and technology.Ability to work full-time (40 hours per week) by the program start date.

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, internships, or project experience involving process mapping, continuous improvement, business analysis, data analysis, automation, workflow design, programming, analytics, or AI.Exposure to one or more tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, version control platforms, or similar technologies.Familiarity with financial markets, investment management, or business operations. Prior investment operations experience is not required.Experience contributing to a cross-functional project, presenting recommendations, developing a prototype, or helping others adopt a new process, workflow, or technology solution.

Salary & Benefits: Set at $28.85 per hour ($60,000 annualized base), eligible annual bonus and for overtime. Cohort starts July, 2027!

Your Impact 

The Vertex Supply Chain Master Data Management Co-Op is a 6-month experiential training program for students currently working towards an advanced degree in Information Technology, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Operations Management or other related fields. If you are passionate, collaborative, and growth-minded, a co-op at Vertex will help you gain meaningful experience in our Supply Chain functional areas and serve as a launchpad for your career.

The application deadline for this co-op is November 15th. Please note that Vertex reviews applications on a rolling basis and reserves the right to close this job posting prior to the listed deadline. Applicants can expect to receive an update about their application before or shortly after the application deadline. 

Ready to apply? Submit your application and let’s turn possibilities into reality! 

 What you will be doing: 

The Supply Chain Master Data Management Co-op will support initiatives to improve the governance, quality, documentation, and usability of master data and planning parameters for products managed by Commercial Supply Chain Planning. The Co-op will work across Supply Chain Planning, Logistics, Digital Technology & Engineering (DTE), Technical Operations, and other subject-matter experts (SMEs) to help define and document data-related processes, establish supporting documentation, measure key metrics, and gather stakeholder feedback.

The Co-op will contribute to the development of master data governance practices, process documentation, training materials, workshop content, and documentation repositories.

Key Responsibilities

Master Data Governance and Process Development

Support the definition and documentation of master data governance, including data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, decision rights, process controls, and escalation pathways.Assist with drafting and maintaining master data management processes, workflows, and supporting reference materials.Support the collection, analysis, and presentation of metric results, trends, and opportunities for process improvement.Support the review, validation, and maintenance of master data and planning parameters in systems such as OPM and Kinaxis RapidResponse.

Workshop and Stakeholder Engagement

Create supporting materials for team workshops and working sessions, including agendas, presentation content, discussion guides, meeting notes, decision logs, and action trackers.Work offline with planners and other stakeholders to capture feedback on processes, data requirements, system usage, and documentation.Partner with Supply Chain Planning, Systems, DTE, Technical Operations, and SMEs to support cross-functional alignment on master data and planning activities.Help organize training-related content and maintain a log of feedback, revisions, and open items.

Required Qualifications

Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across a variety of stakeholders.Strong organizational and project-management skills,Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePointLegal authorization to work in the United States, now and in the future. Please note that Vertex does not provide sponsorship for internships/co-ops or entry level roles within this part of the organization. You must be enrolled in an advanced degree program if graduating before May 2027 You must be available to work full-time, 40 hours per week from January – July 2027 

Preferred

Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, such as Oracle or SAP.Familiarity with supply chain planning platforms, such as Kinaxis RapidResponse.Experience working with data, metrics, dashboards, reporting tools, or process documentation.

Program Details:  

Full-time, paid co-op $25.00 – 35.00 USD/hour Program Dates: January – July 2027 Application Deadline: November 15th, 2026

At Vertex, we believe that when you feel your best, you can perform at your best. That’s why our US benefits and global well-being resources are designed to support you.

 Free 24/7 onsite gym access and free access to group exercise classes  Subsidized commuter benefits- transit and parking  Provided meals—free breakfast daily!  Career development opportunities and events, including C Suite engagement  Social events—both intern-only and company-wide  Location-specific perks and extras!  Recognition of National Intern Day 

 

Our Ways of Working 

Flex Designation:  Hybrid - Boston

Flex Eligibility Status:  Hybrid: work three days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility. 

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.  

This job posting is for a temporary role with a third-party agency partner that provides services to Vertex.  The individual selected for this role will be offered the role as an employee of that third-party agency; compensation, medical benefits, fringe benefits and other terms and conditions of employment shall be presented by the third-party agency upon offer. 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

Pay Range

$0 - $0

Disclosure Statement

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning, Fender), major sports franchises (Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).
We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.
The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.
Who You Are:You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any questionYou bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basisYou are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plusYou communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaningYou have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus
What You’ll Do:Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.
Work EnvironmentGupta Media is an office-first organization.
Our CommitmentAt Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.
CompensationAt Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.
We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.

rows.title: Analyst (Newton Sept 2027)
rows.descriptionText:
Application Due Date: October 1, 2026. Candidates will be interviewed in October and November.

Working at Health Advances allows analysts to gain broad exposure to biotech and pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, research tools, and precision medicine, medtech, digital health, and investor sectors as part of a growing firm. We are seeking candidates who share in our passion for making a direct impact on the healthcare industry as they work closely with colleagues who have a wide range of academic backgrounds and industry experience.

Health Advances is recognized as a top consulting firm and receives high rankings annually for its comprehensive training in both healthcare and business topics. Our analysts are typically staffed on two cases at one time allowing them to simultaneously learn about multiple aspects of the healthcare industry. With projects spanning an average of 4-6 weeks, analysts gain exposure to a variety of project work and sectors in their first year.

Health Advances is committed to continuous learning and the growth of its staff at all levels. Analysts join internal committees (examples: sector-specific, business development, and business analytics committees), attend seminars, and present at our weekly company meetings. Each analyst is paired with a go-to “buddy” in addition to a formal mentor who is part of the Management Team. Our mentorship program ensures that each individual has a tailored skill plan that tracks progress throughout the course of their career at Health Advances.

Analysts leverage prior knowledge in addition to current casework to develop the necessary skills for transition into levels of increased responsibility. Health Advances alumni are accepted into the top advanced-degree programs within several different fields and move on to challenging positions at organizations around the globe.

All interviews are case-oriented and provide the opportunity to work through actual examples of our projects.

Analyst Responsibilities

Synthesizing primary and secondary research and communicating insights to case teams and clientCreating financial models to perform quantitative analysesCoordinating and participating in primary research through client, customer, physician and thought-leader interviewsConducting secondary research on clinical, scientific, and business issuesDeveloping presentations in collaboration with case teams for client deliverables

We are looking for dynamic individuals with the following qualifications:

A formal undergraduate or masters-level degree in life sciencesExceptional quantitative skillsSolid oral and written skillsStrong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across all levelsA sincere interest in learning about the business of healthcare in a multi-disciplinary environmentA desire to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and team-oriented environmentAn ability to prioritize and focus time effectively to meet multiple client-driven objectivesDemonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance research, problem-solving, and insight generation while exercising sound judgment, bias and quality controlMust live in the Boston area and work in the Newton office ~3 days a week

What We Offer

Dynamic, Flexible, Hard Working, Team Environment – We are busy, collaborative, growing, and we are doing meaningful workOpportunities – We encourage you to grow your expertise and take on new challengesInclusive Culture – One that values each employee’s unique perspective and encourages everyone to be their authentic selfFeedback – We are committed to giving and receiving feedback in a direct, open and supportive mannerSupport – You will be part of a team that cares about you personally and professionally; our success depends on your success

Health Advances also offers a broad and competitive range of benefits depending on your job classification eligibility:

Competitive bonus programsMedical, dental and vision insurance, beginning on the first of the month after hire401(k) with company matchShort-term and long-term disability insurancePaid holidaysGenerous sick and vacation payEmployee assistance programsSummer flex scheduling options to allow for early releases on Fridays from Memorial Day to Labor DayPaid volunteer opportunities

This position is located in Newton, MA and starts on September 13, 2027.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for employer sponsorship. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider candidates requiring visa sponsorship, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, F-1 (OPT/CPT/STEM), or other work authorization.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The base pay for this role is $85,000 USD. You are eligible for an annual incentive program (with a reasonable first year estimate ranging from $0-$8,500 USD). rows.title: Product Solutions Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

Job Description

Product Solutions Analyst 

Locations: Boston, MA / Chicago, IL / NYC, NY | Hybrid

Get To Know Us:

The Product Solutions team serves as a team of passionate product experts leading the way in setting the bar for customer satisfaction. The team focuses on resolving some of the most complex product issues for our hedge fund and traditional asset management clients.

Why You Will Love It Here!

About The Operations Analyst Program

The Operations Analyst Program is an early-career development opportunity for driven recent and soon-to-be graduates who want to launch a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, data, and technology. Analysts use analytical, technical, and collaborative skills to help deliver operational excellence, solve business challenges, and improve outcomes for clients.

As investment operations evolve through data, automation, and AI, analysts gain hands-on experience supporting business-critical investment processes while helping identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Through ownership of operational processes and exposure to continuous improvement, data analytics, automation, workflow design, and AI, analysts strengthen controls, improve decision-making, and contribute to scalable solutions that support clients and business growth.

Over three weeks, Analysts begin as a cohort with an immersion in Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and Operations organization. Following onboarding, analysts join teams supporting Market, Client, or Control functions, where they develop domain expertise, learn business-critical workflows, and build an end-to-end understanding of how Operations supports clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.

Operations teams are responsible for the execution, oversight, servicing, and control activities that support the investment lifecycle. Analysts work closely with teammates and stakeholders across the organization to execute processes accurately, resolve operational challenges, improve controls, and deliver exceptional client outcomes.

In addition to their core team responsibilities, analysts may collaborate with specialized teams within Operations focused on process transformation, analytics, workflow modernization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Partnering with subject matter experts across Market, Client, and Control functions to identify opportunities, redesign processes, and implement scalable improvements that enhance operational effectiveness. Through this partnership, analysts may gain exposure to transformation initiatives while continuing to build deep operational expertise.

The program is designed for people who are curious about how businesses operate, motivated to improve processes, and eager to continue learning. About The Operations Analyst Program

The Operations Analyst Program is an early-career development opportunity for driven recent and soon-to-be graduates who want to launch a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, data, and technology. Analysts use analytical, technical, and collaborative skills to help deliver operational excellence, solve business challenges, and improve outcomes for clients.

As investment operations evolve through data, automation, and AI, analysts gain hands-on experience supporting business-critical investment processes while helping identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Through ownership of operational processes and exposure to continuous improvement, data analytics, automation, workflow design, and AI, analysts strengthen controls, improve decision-making, and contribute to scalable solutions that support clients and business growth.

Over three weeks, Analysts begin as a cohort with an immersion in Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and Operations organization. Following onboarding, analysts join teams supporting Market, Client, or Control functions, where they develop domain expertise, learn business-critical workflows, and build an end-to-end understanding of how Operations supports clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.

Operations teams are responsible for the execution, oversight, servicing, and control activities that support the investment lifecycle. Analysts work closely with teammates and stakeholders across the organization to execute processes accurately, resolve operational challenges, improve controls, and deliver exceptional client outcomes.

In addition to their core team responsibilities, analysts may collaborate with specialized teams within Operations focused on process transformation, analytics, workflow modernization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Partnering with subject matter experts across Market, Client, and Control functions to identify opportunities, redesign processes, and implement scalable improvements that enhance operational effectiveness. Through this partnership, analysts may gain exposure to transformation initiatives while continuing to build deep operational expertise.

The program is designed for people who are curious about how businesses operate, motivated to improve processes, and eager to continue learning. As business needs evolve, analysts may gain exposure to different Operations functions, participate in cross-functional initiatives, or contribute to transformation efforts, broadening their knowledge, experience, and skill sets.

What You'll Do And Learn

Identify root causes, assess impacts, and recommend sustainable solutions.Partner with Operations teams, portfolio managers, traders, sales, product management, technology teams, external providers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues, improve handoffs, and support business priorities.Perform quality control and verification activities, maintain accurate records and documentation, and help ensure operational processes meet established policies, procedures, and control standards.Analyze operational and investment data to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, bottlenecks, and emerging risks. Build reports, dashboards, or analytical tools that turn data into actionable insights and improvement opportunities.Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or redesign workflows and contribute to process mapping, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and adoption activities.Collaborate with Automation, Reinvention & Collaboration (ARC) and other partners on process-improvement initiatives, workflow modernization efforts, analytics projects, automation solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.Use or learn tools such as Excel, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, and approved AI solutions, as appropriate to the assignment.Contribute to operational excellence, analytics, automation, or process-improvement initiatives and present findings, recommendations, and outcomes to team members and business partners.

Associate or bachelor's degree completed by the program start date. rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning, Fender), major sports franchises (Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).
We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.
The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.
Who You Are:You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any questionYou bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basisYou are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plusYou communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaningYou have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus
What You’ll Do:Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.
Work EnvironmentGupta Media is an office-first organization.
Our CommitmentAt Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.
CompensationAt Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.
We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.

About Cedar Gate Technologies

Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, enables payers, providers, employers, and service administrators to excel at value-based care with a unified technology and services platform delivering analytics, care, and payment technology on a single data management foundation. At Cedar Gate, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where great ideas thrive. We invest deeply in our people through ongoing training, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of teamwork, offering the chance to grow your skills while contributing to high impact initiatives for some of the world's most dynamic companies.

Position Summary

At Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, our Data Onboarding Analysts play a vital role in helping clients unlock the full value of their data. In this highly collaborative and client-facing role, you will lead data onboarding initiatives for some of our most strategic clients, partnering with internal teams and client stakeholders to ensure data is delivered, validated, and integrated successfully.

As a Data Onboarding Analyst, you will serve as the central coordinator for data onboarding projects, guiding clients through requirements gathering, data acquisition, file specifications, onboarding timelines, and issue resolution. You'll work closely with teams across Data Management, Data Acquisition, Product, and Implementation to ensure projects stay on track, risks are proactively managed, and clients have a smooth and positive experience throughout the process.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining project management, relationship management, and data-focused problem solving. You'll gain exposure to healthcare analytics and data operations while developing expertise in managing complex data initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering meaningful results for clients. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building strong relationships, and take pride in keeping projects organized and moving forward, we'd love to hear from you.

Roles & Responsibilities

› Lead the successful onboarding and implementation of assigned clients by coordinating cross-functional teams, driving project execution, managing risks, and ensuring a seamless client experience

› Work with a dedicated Data Management team, Product Team, Implementation Team, and Data Acquisition team to develop a detailed communications and project plan to monitor and track implementation progress

› Manage change control to existing project scope and project schedule and communicate appropriately to stakeholders

› Collaborate with the Data Acquisition Team to ensure inbound data files are being delivered within project timelines; and escalate issues & risks to appropriate stakeholders in a timely manner.

› Monitor and communicate project milestones, status, and risk to the Director and Client as appropriate

› Create all project-related paperwork - including Implementation Agendas, Project Plans, and Status Reports - and distribute timely to the client and/or executive management team

› Serves as the dedicated point of contact for assigned high profile clients

› Identify opportunities for process improvement and workflow streamlining

› Work with the Data Acquisition team to ensure Vendor Implementation tickets are created and monitored throughout the implementation; ticket categories include (but are not limited to) Legal Agreement execution, SFTP setup, file receipt/review, and distribution of file analysis

› Facilitate discussion regarding data structures, file specifications, and data requirements to ensure alignment with client and operational needs

Job Location

Burlington, MA (Boston)

Work Arrangement

Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 remote)

Experience / Qualifications

› Proven success leading projects from planning through execution, delivering exceptional outcomes for clients and stakeholders

› Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams in a collaborative, fast-paced environment

› Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients, colleagues, and leadership

› Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

› Proven ability to build trust and establish strong partnerships with senior leaders and key stakeholders

› Aptitude for quickly learning new technologies, business processes, and technical concepts, and applying them effectively

› An engaging, positive, and customer-focused approach that inspires confidence, fosters teamwork, and drives successful outcomes

› Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience

› Prefer those with experience within healthcare, including Population Health Management, value-based care, or end-to-end medical claims operations

› Experience analyzing complex data and translating insights into meaningful business recommendations and strategic decisions is highly preferred

› Proven technology skills are preferred, especially supporting or implementing SaaS solutions in a client-facing environment and advanced Excel and reporting skills, including experience with Power BI, data transformation, ETL processes, and data quality analysis

› PMP, Six Sigma, or other recognized project management or process improvement certifications is preferred but not required for this position.

› Prior experience managing projects within Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery environments

› To be eligible for this position, you must reside in the same country where the job is located.

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services.

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. Learn more here: https://www.parametricportfolio.com/about

This role is part of Parametric’ s hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis and Alpharetta, GA

Excellent opportunity for recent or soon to be 2027 graduates! Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis, Alpharetta

SUMMER COHORT STARTS - July 2027

About The Operations Analyst Program

The Operations Analyst Program is an early-career development opportunity for driven recent and soon-to-be graduates who want to launch a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, data, and technology. Analysts use analytical, technical, and collaborative skills to help deliver operational excellence, solve business challenges, and improve outcomes for clients.

As investment operations evolve through data, automation, and AI, analysts gain hands-on experience supporting business-critical investment processes while helping identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Through ownership of operational processes and exposure to continuous improvement, data analytics, automation, workflow design, and AI, analysts strengthen controls, improve decision-making, and contribute to scalable solutions that support clients and business growth.

Over three weeks, Analysts begin as a cohort with an immersion in Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and Operations organization. Following onboarding, analysts join teams supporting Market, Client, or Control functions, where they develop domain expertise, learn business-critical workflows, and build an end-to-end understanding of how Operations supports clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.

Operations teams are responsible for the execution, oversight, servicing, and control activities that support the investment lifecycle. Analysts work closely with teammates and stakeholders across the organization to execute processes accurately, resolve operational challenges, improve controls, and deliver exceptional client outcomes.

In addition to their core team responsibilities, analysts may collaborate with specialized teams within Operations focused on process transformation, analytics, workflow modernization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Partnering with subject matter experts across Market, Client, and Control functions to identify opportunities, redesign processes, and implement scalable improvements that enhance operational effectiveness. Through this partnership, analysts may gain exposure to transformation initiatives while continuing to build deep operational expertise.

The program is designed for people who are curious about how businesses operate, motivated to improve processes, and eager to continue learning. As business needs evolve, analysts may gain exposure to different Operations functions, participate in cross-functional initiatives, or contribute to transformation efforts, broadening their knowledge, experience, and skill sets.

What You'll Do And Learn

Learn Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and business-critical Operations workflows, and understand how Market, Client, and Control functions support clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.Learn and execute business-critical investment operations workflows accurately and on time. Responsibilities may include activities such as cash and position reconciliation, trade lifecycle support, client servicing, corporate actions, account onboarding and maintenance, contracts, oversight activities, and billing, depending on team assignment.Develop an end-to-end understanding of assigned processes, including activities, decisions, systems, data flows, controls, handoffs, and upstream and downstream dependencies.Investigate exceptions, breaks, recurring operational issues, and client-impacting events using structured problem-solving and data analysis. Identify root causes, assess impacts, and recommend sustainable solutions.Partner with Operations teams, portfolio managers, traders, sales, product management, technology teams, external providers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues, improve handoffs, and support business priorities.Perform quality control and verification activities, maintain accurate records and documentation, and help ensure operational processes meet established policies, procedures, and control standards.Analyze operational and investment data to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, bottlenecks, and emerging risks. Build reports, dashboards, or analytical tools that turn data into actionable insights and improvement opportunities.Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or redesign workflows and contribute to process mapping, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and adoption activities.Collaborate with Automation, Reinvention & Collaboration (ARC) and other partners on process-improvement initiatives, workflow modernization efforts, analytics projects, automation solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.Use or learn tools such as Excel, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, and approved AI solutions, as appropriate to the assignment.Contribute to operational excellence, analytics, automation, or process-improvement initiatives and present findings, recommendations, and outcomes to team members and business partners.

What You'll Bring

Associate or bachelor's degree completed by the program start date. Relevant fields may include industrial, process, or systems engineering; operations research; supply chain; data science or analytics; computer science; information systems; mathematics; statistics; finance; accounting; economics; or a related analytical, business, or technical field. Candidates from other majors with relevant quantitative, technical, or process-improvement experience are also encouraged to apply.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous issues, work with data, identify root causes, and form well-supported conclusions.A systems-thinking and continuous-improvement mindset, including curiosity about how people, processes, data, controls, and technology interact end to end and a desire to make work simpler, more accurate, efficient, scalable, and controlled.High attention to detail and a commitment to quality, sound judgment, risk awareness, responsible use of data and technology, and positive client outcomes.Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with teammates and stakeholders and communicate complex ideas in a clear and organized manner.Ownership, learning agility, adaptability, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.Experience using spreadsheets to organize and analyze information and communicate findings, or the ability to learn quickly.Strong interest in building a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, process improvement, data, and technology.Ability to work full-time (40 hours per week) by the program start date.

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, internships, or project experience involving process mapping, continuous improvement, business analysis, data analysis, automation, workflow design, programming, analytics, or AI.Exposure to one or more tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, version control platforms, or similar technologies.Familiarity with financial markets, investment management, or business operations. Prior investment operations experience is not required.Experience contributing to a cross-functional project, presenting recommendations, developing a prototype, or helping others adopt a new process, workflow, or technology solution.

The Business Analyst will be responsible for collaborating with business translators, understanding business requirements, and supplying the data and analyses to support the solution. Our mission is to add value to the business by utilizing our expertise in data analysis, data engineering, statistics, and machine learning to identify and address the biggest opportunities to grow our $1B+ business. This position is in our Tewksbury, MA office with hybrid on-site/remote schedule available.

rows.descriptionText:
About Cedar Gate Technologies

Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, enables payers, providers, employers, and service administrators to excel at value-based care with a unified technology and services platform delivering analytics, care, and payment technology on a single data management foundation. At Cedar Gate, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where great ideas thrive. We invest deeply in our people through ongoing training, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of teamwork, offering the chance to grow your skills while contributing to high impact initiatives for some of the world's most dynamic companies.

Position Summary

At Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, our Data Onboarding Analysts play a vital role in helping clients unlock the full value of their data. In this highly collaborative and client-facing role, you will lead data onboarding initiatives for some of our most strategic clients, partnering with internal teams and client stakeholders to ensure data is delivered, validated, and integrated successfully.

As a Data Onboarding Analyst, you will serve as the central coordinator for data onboarding projects, guiding clients through requirements gathering, data acquisition, file specifications, onboarding timelines, and issue resolution. You'll work closely with teams across Data Management, Data Acquisition, Product, and Implementation to ensure projects stay on track, risks are proactively managed, and clients have a smooth and positive experience throughout the process.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining project management, relationship management, and data-focused problem solving. You'll gain exposure to healthcare analytics and data operations while developing expertise in managing complex data initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering meaningful results for clients. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building strong relationships, and take pride in keeping projects organized and moving forward, we'd love to hear from you.

Burlington, MA (Boston)

› Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients, colleagues, and leadership

› Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

› Proven ability to build trust and establish strong partnerships with senior leaders and key stakeholders

› Aptitude for quickly learning new technologies, business processes, and technical concepts, and applying them effectively

› An engaging, positive, and customer-focused approach that inspires confidence, fosters teamwork, and drives successful outcomes

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning, Fender), major sports franchises (Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).
We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.
The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.
Who You Are:You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any questionYou bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basisYou are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plusYou communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaningYou have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus
What You’ll Do:Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.
Work EnvironmentGupta Media is an office-first organization.
Our CommitmentAt Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.
CompensationAt Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.
We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.

rows.title: Data Onboarding Analyst 2
rows.descriptionText:
About Cedar Gate Technologies

Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, enables payers, providers, employers, and service administrators to excel at value-based care with a unified technology and services platform delivering analytics, care, and payment technology on a single data management foundation. At Cedar Gate, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where great ideas thrive. We invest deeply in our people through ongoing training, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of teamwork, offering the chance to grow your skills while contributing to high impact initiatives for some of the world's most dynamic companies.

Position Summary

At Cedar Gate Technologies, an IQVIA business, our Data Onboarding Analysts play a vital role in helping clients unlock the full value of their data. In this highly collaborative and client-facing role, you will lead data onboarding initiatives for some of our most strategic clients, partnering with internal teams and client stakeholders to ensure data is delivered, validated, and integrated successfully.

As a Data Onboarding Analyst, you will serve as the central coordinator for data onboarding projects, guiding clients through requirements gathering, data acquisition, file specifications, onboarding timelines, and issue resolution. You'll work closely with teams across Data Management, Data Acquisition, Product, and Implementation to ensure projects stay on track, risks are proactively managed, and clients have a smooth and positive experience throughout the process.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining project management, relationship management, and data-focused problem solving. You'll gain exposure to healthcare analytics and data operations while developing expertise in managing complex data initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering meaningful results for clients. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building strong relationships, and take pride in keeping projects organized and moving forward, we'd love to hear from you.

Roles & Responsibilities

› Lead the successful onboarding and implementation of assigned clients by coordinating cross-functional teams, driving project execution, managing risks, and ensuring a seamless client experience

› Work with a dedicated Data Management team, Product Team, Implementation Team, and Data Acquisition team to develop a detailed communications and project plan to monitor and track implementation progress

› Manage change control to existing project scope and project schedule and communicate appropriately to stakeholders

› Collaborate with the Data Acquisition Team to ensure inbound data files are being delivered within project timelines; and escalate issues & risks to appropriate stakeholders in a timely manner.

› Monitor and communicate project milestones, status, and risk to the Director and Client as appropriate

› Create all project-related paperwork - including Implementation Agendas, Project Plans, and Status Reports - and distribute timely to the client and/or executive management team

› Serves as the dedicated point of contact for assigned high profile clients

› Identify opportunities for process improvement and workflow streamlining

› Work with the Data Acquisition team to ensure Vendor Implementation tickets are created and monitored throughout the implementation; ticket categories include (but are not limited to) Legal Agreement execution, SFTP setup, file receipt/review, and distribution of file analysis

› Facilitate discussion regarding data structures, file specifications, and data requirements to ensure alignment with client and operational needs

Job Location

Burlington, MA (Boston)

Work Arrangement

Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 remote)

Experience / Qualifications

› Proven success leading projects from planning through execution, delivering exceptional outcomes for clients and stakeholders

› Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams in a collaborative, fast-paced environment

› Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients, colleagues, and leadership

› Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

› Proven ability to build trust and establish strong partnerships with senior leaders and key stakeholders

› Aptitude for quickly learning new technologies, business processes, and technical concepts, and applying them effectively

› An engaging, positive, and customer-focused approach that inspires confidence, fosters teamwork, and drives successful outcomes

› Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience

› Prefer those with experience within healthcare, including Population Health Management, value-based care, or end-to-end medical claims operations

› Experience analyzing complex data and translating insights into meaningful business recommendations and strategic decisions is highly preferred

› Proven technology skills are preferred, especially supporting or implementing SaaS solutions in a client-facing environment and advanced Excel and reporting skills, including experience with Power BI, data transformation, ETL processes, and data quality analysis

› PMP, Six Sigma, or other recognized project management or process improvement certifications is preferred but not required for this position.

› Prior experience managing projects within Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery environments

› To be eligible for this position, you must reside in the same country where the job is located.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law. https://jobs.iqvia.com/eoe

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The potential base pay range for this role, when annualized, is $56,100.00 - $140,300.00. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). Dependent on the position offered, incentive plans, bonuses, and/or other forms of compensation may be offered, in addition to a range of health and welfare and/or other benefits.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our analytics team and support data-driven business decisions. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in data analysis, SQL, Excel, and data visualization, along with a curiosity to identify trends and insights from complex datasets. This role is suitable for fresh graduates and candidates with 0

3

year of experience who want to build a career in data analytics and business intelligence. Key Responsibilities Collect, clean, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources. Write and maintain SQL queries to extract and manipulate data from databases. Perform data validation and ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Analyze datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business insights. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports for business and management teams. Assist in defining and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs). Work with different teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions. Perform exploratory data analysis to identify opportunities and potential issues. Support data-driven decision-making through meaningful analysis and reporting. Automate repetitive reporting and data-processing tasks where possible. Document data sources, processes, calculations, and analytical methodologies. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Skills Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field. Strong knowledge of SQL. Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic data analysis. Basic understanding of Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools. Understanding of data cleaning, data validation, and exploratory data analysis. Basic knowledge of Python or R is an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication and presentation skills. Ability to work with large datasets and attention to detail. Preferred Qualifications Internship or academic project experience involving data analysis. Knowledge of Python, Pandas, NumPy, or Matplotlib. Experience creating Power BI or Tableau dashboards. Understanding of basic statistics and data modeling. Familiarity with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle. Knowledge of ETL concepts and data pipelines is a plus. Relevant certifications in SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or Data Analytics will be an advantage. Key Competencies Analytical thinking Problem-solving Attention to detail Data interpretation Business understanding Communication skills Critical thinking Curiosity and willingness to learn Team collaboration What We Offer Hands-on experience working with real-world datasets. Training and mentorship from experienced data professionals. Exposure to SQL, BI tools, reporting, and data visualization. Opportunity to work on business analytics and data-driven projects. Career growth opportunities based on performance. Professional and collaborative work environment. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a curious, analytical, and detail-oriented graduate who enjoys working with data and solving business problems. Candidates should have strong fundamentals in SQL and Excel and a willingness to learn modern analytics tools and technologies.

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Requisition Number: 78670

The company built on breakthroughs.   

Join us.   

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.    

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.   

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.   

Come break through with us. 

As a leading developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of scientific laboratory products for 100 years, Corning’s Life Sciences segment collaborates with researchers seeking new approaches to increase efficiencies, reduce costs and compress timelines in the drug discovery process. Using unique expertise in the fields of materials science, surface science, optics, biochemistry and biology, the segment provides innovative solutions that improve productivity and enable breakthrough discoveries.

The Business Analyst will be responsible for collaborating with business translators, understanding business requirements, and supplying the data and analyses to support the solution. You will be joining an exciting, analytics center of excellence for the Corning Life Science division. Our mission is to add value to the business by utilizing our expertise in data analysis, data engineering, statistics, and machine learning to identify and address the biggest opportunities to grow our $1B+ business. This position is in our Tewksbury, MA office with hybrid on-site/remote schedule available.

Day To Day Responsibilities

 Enable effective decision making by identifying, retrieving, and aggregating data from either the division’s data lake or PowerBI reports to compile it into a digestible, standardized and actionable structure and format  Prepare and deliver analyses and insight reviews to business stakeholders  Propose metrics and/or analyses that should be productionized for broader use across the organization 

Required Education And Years Of Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Research, Math, Finance, or related discipline 

Required Skills

 Demonstrated understanding of the linkage between business data and business information and how to translate between the two  Experience displaying complex quantitative data in a simple, intuitive format and presenting findings clearly and concisely  Experience with data visualization and tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, or similar  Demonstrated understanding of database concepts  Demonstrated ability to work effectively cross-functionally with IT, data subject matter experts, Data Engineers, and other Analysts to mine the right data sources efficiently and accurately  Demonstrated independent and creative problem solving  Excellent organizational skills including prioritization of multiple concurrent projects while still delivering timely and accurate results 

Desired Skills

 3+ years’ experience in data, analytics, and/or business intelligence  1+ years’ experience with SQL or other similar relational database query language  Experience with scripting languages such as Python, R, etc.  Ability to pay close attention to detail in a fast-paced environment  Ability to break down complex problems into smaller deliverables that add value 

This position does not support immigration sponsorship.  

The range for this position is $82,051.00 - $112,821.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.

A job that shapes a life.  

Corning offers you the total package.  

Your well-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one.

 Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win.  As part of our commitment to your financial well-being, we provide a 100% company-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service.  Our health and well-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family.  Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions.

rows.descriptionText:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

At the Lilly Innovation Center in Boston, Massachusetts, we explore how next generation therapeutics, new technologies, data analytics and new care models can improve patient health and the healthcare system. Our Genetic Medicine team in Boston shares a passion for challenging conventional wisdom and creating an environment that embraces creative, break-through concepts. The Center offers a start-up environment with large company support. It is located in the heart of Massachusetts’ exploding science and technology cluster and is within walking distance of some of the best academic and industry innovators in the world.

The successful candidate will have a strong research track record in biology and be analytically minded, systematic, and embrace data-driven decision making. The scientist will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across key Lilly therapeutic areas (e.g. neuroscience, diabetes, immunology) to perform experiments to aid development of RNA oligonucleotide drug candidates for the next generation of RNA therapies.

Work with project team leads to design and plan in vivo experiments to support the preclinical characterization and evaluation of novel therapeutic molecules.Perform rodent handling and dosing, including but not limited to subcutaneous (SC), intravenous (IV), intraperitoneal (IP) and intrathecal (IT) injections.Perform small animal stereotaxic surgeries including but not limited to intracerebral (IC), intracisterna magna (ICM) and intracerebroventricular (ICV) injections in rodents.Perform tissue dissection, trimming and processing, collect bodily fluids (blood, cerebrospinal fluid).Process tissue samples for gene expression or protein endpoints (e.g RT-qPCR, Western blot, ELISA)Support technology development for improving the delivery of novel therapeutics to regions of interest in the central nervous system or other tissues.Assist in troubleshooting technical challenges and provide scientific and technical input to project teamsHelp design and complete experiments and perform data analysisProvide written and verbal communication of work in lab reports and team meetingsAccurate recording of all practical work: completion of electronic notebook to Lilly procedure quality standardsGeneral laboratory assistance, including ordering and receiving lab supplies, preparation of reagents, and maintain laboratory equipmentEnsure compliance with all health and safety regulationsPassionate about contributing in the lab in a diverse and inclusive environment every day
