rows.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Have you ever seen the headline in the news “Banks Pass Federal Reserve Stress Tests” and wondered how Capital One determines how much savings (or “capital”) it needs? Or maybe how we analyze the potential impact of the next recession? At the heart of these questions are sophisticated econometric loss models that help us understand the ways in which the economy impacts our loan portfolios and guide strategic decision making at the highest levels of Capital One.

In the Consumer Credit Risk Management Models and Data Team, we blend cutting-edge quantitative methods, with a deep understanding of our business, data, and regulatory environment to build and deploy predictive models for losses, account volumes and outstanding balances. These models drive key strategic decisions for loss allowances, stress testing, and capital allocation as well as informing our earnings calls and recession preparedness.

If this sounds interesting to you, join us! As a Data Scientist on the deployment & platform side of the team, you’ll be at the forefront helping us to usher in the next wave of disruption by using the latest technology to deploy, optimize and modernize model pipelines and execution platforms that enable machine learning models to provide powerful insights about our portfolio and growth opportunities through new data sources. You will partner with best-in-class data scientists, analysts, and engineers to innovate solutions that directly impact the company’s bottom line in a meaningful way. You will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibilities, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications:

Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

rows.descriptionText:
Benefits

Bonus based on performanceCompetitive salaryOpportunity for advancementTraining & development

Part-Time Digital Marketing & Content Specialist

PuroClean of Greater Landover

Greater Landover, MD | Part-Time | Hybrid / In-Person Content Creation

About The Opportunity

PuroClean of Greater Landover is looking for a creative, energetic, and results-driven Part-Time Digital Marketing & Content Specialist to help grow our brand, tell compelling stories, and generate new business.

We provide property restoration services throughout Maryland, Washington, D.C., and Northern Virginia, including water damage restoration, mold remediation, fire and smoke restoration, commercial cleaning, and other specialty property services.

We are looking for someone who can take what we do every day and turn it into content that people watch, remember, share, and act on.

This is not a position for someone who only wants to schedule posts.

We want a storyteller, content creator, marketer, and idea generator who can help us build a recognizable local brand while developing marketing campaigns that generate leads and business opportunities.

The position will begin part-time, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time marketing role as the company continues to expand.

What You'll Do

You will help develop and execute PuroClean of Greater Landover's digital marketing strategy across multiple platforms.

Responsibilities Include 

Create engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn Film and edit restoration projects, before-and-after transformations, customer stories, employee features, educational content, and behind-the-scenes footageDevelop attention-grabbing Instagram and Facebook advertisements Turn restoration projects into compelling stories instead of simply posting project photosCreate content explaining water damage, mold, fire damage, emergency response, commercial restoration, and property maintenanceDevelop social media campaigns designed to generate phone calls, website traffic, referrals, and qualified leads Post and manage content on:InstagramFacebookLinkedInTikTokGoogle Business ProfileUtilize Zelly AI and other AI marketing tools to assist with content creation, campaign development, automation, lead generation, and marketing ideasCreate monthly and weekly content calendarsDevelop creative concepts for paid and organic advertisingWrite captions, headlines, calls-to-action, and marketing copyHelp position PuroClean in front of property managers, real estate professionals, plumbers, HVAC companies, insurance professionals, commercial businesses, government agencies, and homeownersIdentify local trends, community events, partnerships, and opportunities that can increase brand visibilityHelp develop email, social media, referral, and community outreach campaignsMonitor engagement, leads, website traffic, and campaign resultsRecommend new strategies based on marketing performanceHelp grow the company's followers while focusing on the more important goal: growing revenue Work directly with ownership to brainstorm new campaigns and business-development ideas
We Want Someone Who Can Tell a Story

A flooded basement isn't just a picture of wet drywall.

A mold remediation project isn't just someone wearing PPE.

A fire-loss project isn't simply another worksite.

Every Job Has a Story

What happened?

What problem was the customer facing?

How did PuroClean respond?

What did our team do differently?

What was the result?

We want someone who understands how to capture those moments and turn them into content that builds trust with potential customers.

The Ideal Candidate

You May Be a Great Fit If You

Love creating video contentUnderstand Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedInKnow how to shoot quality video using a smartphone or cameraCan edit short-form video quicklyUnderstand hooks, storytelling, captions, trending formats, and calls-to-actionAre comfortable appearing on camera occasionally and coaching others who appear on cameraCan interview customers, employees, business partners, or company leadershipHave experience with tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Zelly AI, or similar platforms Understand basic digital advertisingAre curious about AI and how it can improve marketingThink creatively about generating leadsCan work independently and bring ideas to the tableAre comfortable visiting active restoration projects to capture contentUnderstand that successful marketing should ultimately contribute to business growth 

We'd Especially Like to Meet You If...

You Have Experience Marketing For Any Of The Following

Restoration, construction, home services, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, real estate, property management, insurance, cleaning services, government contracting, or another local service business.

Experience in these industries is helpful but not required. Creativity, initiative, reliability, and the ability to learn are more important.

What Success Looks Like

We Are Not Hiring Someone Simply To Say

"We posted five times this week."

We Want To Eventually Be Able To Say

"That video brought us a customer."

"That LinkedIn campaign introduced us to a property manager."

"That ad generated qualified water-damage leads."

"That project story helped a commercial client understand what PuroClean can do."

"People in our market are starting to recognize the PuroClean name."

The right person will help us measure both audience growth and business growth.

Growth Opportunity

Our goal is to find someone who wants to grow with the company.

This position will initially be part-time, but a successful candidate could eventually grow into a:

Full-Time Marketing Specialist → Marketing Manager → Director of Marketing / Business Development

As the company grows, we want this person to have the opportunity to take greater ownership of our marketing strategy, advertising, brand development, and lead-generation efforts.

Schedule

Part-Time

Approximately 5–10 hours per week, with flexibility depending on content needs and project activity.

Some work may be completed remotely, but the candidate must be available to periodically visit our office, restoration projects, customer locations, networking events, and other locations throughout the local market to capture original content.

Qualifications

Social media/content creation experience preferredVideo filming and editing abilityStrong writing and communication skillsFamiliarity with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedInAbility to manage multiple projects and deadlinesCreative mindset with a strong sense of initiativeValid driver's license and reliable transportation preferredComfortable working around active restoration and construction environments when necessaryMarketing, communications, advertising, film, digital media, or related education is helpful but not required

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with examples of your work.

We Would Especially Like To See

Instagram ReelsTikTok videosAdvertisementsSocial media campaignsVideo editing examplesBusiness contentPhotographyGraphic designAny content you've created that successfully tells a story

Portfolio links, Instagram/TikTok accounts, websites, Google Drive portfolios, or other examples are welcome.

About PuroClean Of Greater Landover

PuroClean of Greater Landover is a locally owned property restoration company serving residential, commercial, and government customers throughout the greater Maryland, Washington, D.C., and Northern Virginia market.

Our company is growing, and we are building a marketing operation designed to grow with it.

We aren't looking for someone to simply manage our social media.

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the brand.

This is a remote position.

rows.title: TDM Marketing Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Are you a marketing and communications professional who is passionate about making a positive difference in the community? Are you interested in public transportation, biking, walking, and helping others make sustainable travel choices? Are you creative, driven to excel in all that you do, eager to grow professionally, and energized by working with teams? If so, then this is the position for you.

Foursquare Integrated Transportation Planning, Inc. (Foursquare ITP) is looking to hire a talented and motivated individual to join our team as a Transportation Demand Management (TDM) Marketing Specialist supporting TDM programs within the Washington, DC, Maryland, and Virginia (DMV) region. Foursquare ITP operates TDM programs on behalf of clients nationwide, encouraging commuters, residents, and visitors to bike, walk, scoot, carpool, vanpool, and use public transit through coordinated multi-layered marketing and outreach programs.

Join our team and advance your career with a company centered on our passion for the profession, investment in each other, dedication to our clients, and a positive outlook. We are looking for someone who lives our four core values every day. Learn about the principles that shape our culture here.

Role 

In this role, you will be the go-to marketing and communications support for one of our clients' TDM programs.

Responsibilities will include: 

Work as part of the program team to accomplish organizational goals. Develop and execute marketing campaigns that focus on shifting behavior from driving alone to sustainable forms of transportation. Develop a marketing workplan, with guidance from a marketing manager, including a detailed calendar of events and campaigns. Develop social media content and strategy, manage ongoing digital communications, and interact and connect with influencers to cross-promote programs. Update the website content. Assist with the execution of client annual awards or recognition events, along with promotion and expansion of program initiatives. Partner with transportation stakeholders across the greater DMV region and create co-marketing opportunities. Write press releases about programs and events. Develop marketing and collateral pieces to educate the public about sustainable travel choices, including writing content, providing guidance to graphic design, and developing video/short-form content. Create and manage communications, such as newsletters, blogs, and dedicated emails. Create and manage paid/digital advertising. Provide public outreach assistance (e.g., events, canvassing, etc.). Provide customer service and materials fulfillment. 

Required Skills And Experience

Education and experience requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or similar is preferred. A relevant degree can be substituted with sufficient experience. At least three years of relevant experience in a progressively responsible role. 

Skills requirements:

Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communications skills. Knowledge of a variety of marketing and communications channels, as well as outreach and public relations techniques. Familiarity using automated marketing tools and concepts (e.g., Mailchimp, Autopilot). Strong use of Microsoft Office Tools (e.g., Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). Experience using the Adobe Creative Suite (e.g., InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop). Experience applying design guidelines and branding standards to all materials. Ability to use self-hosted WordPress (Wordpress.org) to edit content on websites. Experience with content creation (e.g., video reels, blogs, graphics). Experience with marketing analytics platforms and dashboards (e.g. Google Analytics). Experience working with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, OneCommute) is beneficial. Experience with project management software (e.g., Asana) is preferred. Proficiency in Spanish is beneficial. 

Location 

This is a hybrid in-office/work-from-home position, which may require being on-site one or two days per week.

The selected candidate must live in or relocate to the District of Columbia region within commuting proximity to downtown.

Benefits

We’re proud of the experience we create for our employees and the opportunities we provide for growth. In addition to a competitive salary based on experience and qualifications, we also provide an extensive benefits package. Discover how we invest in our people—through both our Employee Value Proposition and our robust benefits package—here.

Compensation

An individual who meets the minimum requirements would earn $67,100. Salary will increase based on education and experience up to $91,600.

We cannot provide sponsorship now or in the future for this role. Employees must be authorized to work in the US. 

Foursquare ITP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment.

rows.title: Data Analytics & Visualization Analyst - Clearance Required

About Partner ForcesPartner Forces is a management consulting firm helping homeland security organizations solve some of their most pressing and complex challenges. We partner with government agencies and industry to strengthen national security and critical infrastructure through expertise in strategy, program management, stakeholder engagement, technology implementation, preparedness, and business transformation.
At Partner Forces, we're more than consultants - we're trusted advisors. We work alongside our clients to solve meaningful problems, deliver actionable solutions, and make a lasting impact. As a growing firm, every employee has the opportunity to contribute not only to our clients' success, but also to the future of Partner Forces. We believe great consultants are developed through collaboration, mentorship, continuous learning, and meaningful opportunities to lead.
Our culture is grounded in six core values: Integrity, Excellence, Positivity, Candor, Determination, and Teamwork. These values shape how we work with our clients, support one another, and grow together. We believe that when our people thrive, our clients do too, which is why we invest in our employees' well-being, professional development, and long-term success.
What We Are Looking ForPartner Forces is seeking a Cleared Data Analytics & Visualization Analyst to support a Department of Homeland Security cybersecurity program. We’re looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with the communication and consulting skills needed to work directly with customers, understand their needs, and turn data into meaningful insights. This role will initially focus on data analysis, reporting, visualization, and development of analytic products, with the opportunity to evolve into broader technical program and PMO support. The right person does not need to be a software developer, but should be technically curious, comfortable working alongside technical teams, and able to understand and translate conversations about data, systems, and technology.

If things go well, from there you'll meet with members from the project team, including the hiring manager and teammates, and possibly be asked to submit a writing assessment to showcase your practical knowledge. If we find you are a match, you’ll get a call offering you the role. While we wish we could hire every great candidate who comes our way, the reality is that we can't. If you are not selected, we will be sure to connect with you and let you know so you can move on with your search. We will also keep your resume for future needs.

rows.title: Market Research Analyst (Advance Statistics)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About Innovation GMU:

The Innovation Service Line guides clients throughout the innovation journey as they develop and launch new or improved products and services spanning a range of verticals. This is accomplished using best-in-class services, including idea screening, concept testing, product testing, price and line optimization, package testing and volumetric forecasting. The Global Modeling Unit (GMU) team within the Innovation service line are methodological “experts” that provide a variety of value-added services. In most cases, value-added services are advanced multivariate data analyses such as regression, GLM, discriminant analysis, MDS, clustering algorithms, and proprietary procedures.

What makes this role important at Ipsos?

We are seeking a Market Research Analyst with a strong quantitative background and expertise in statistical modeling and experimental research methods. The Research Analyst, Marketing Science is a resource for internal and external clients in the design and analysis of data based on statistical procedures. As a Research Analyst, you will provide expertise in the appropriate use of value-added analytical models, including approaches proprietary to Ipsos.

What You Can Expect To Be Doing

Clean, structure, code, and summarize survey and secondary dataUse statistical software (SPSS, R, etc.) and business software (Excel) to uncover and evaluate solutions, and assist project staff in running statistical analysesApply programming skills (Excel VBA, Python, etc.) to help automate standard statistical procedures and chart creation.Demonstrate your understanding of multivariate analysis and Ipsos proprietary products, and work with Client Service from understanding business questions to design, analysis, and applicationWork from an analytic plan, assemble Excel outputs or PowerPoint decks to provide results and explanations for Client ServiceConsistently ensure the timely delivery of error free work

This might be the job for you if you have:

BS or MS in Statistics, Applied Statistics, Biostatistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Psychology, or a closely related quantitative field.Strong academic foundation in:Experimental design (DOE)Hypothesis testingRegression analysisAnalysis of variance (ANOVA)Linear and generalized linear modelsSampling methodologiesMultivariate statistical analysisExperience designing and analyzing market research studies, including surveys, pricing research, concept testing, and customer insights projects.Ability to design experiments and quasi-experiments to measure causal impact.Experience applying statistical methods to business decision-making.Proficiency with statistical software such as R, SAS, Python, SPSS, or Stata.Experience communicating complex statistical findings to non-technical business stakeholders.
About Us

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And we are proud of our continuous efforts in making Ipsos the best place to work!

About The Team

The Innovation Service Line guides clients throughout the innovation journey as they develop and launch new or improved products and services spanning a range of verticals. We help our clients develop the initial idea for a product/service, ensure the fully-articulated description of the product/service resonates with consumers, confirm that prototypes of the product/service properly deliver on consumer expectations, and finetune the full mix prior to launch. This is accomplished using best-in-class services, including idea screening, concept testing, product testing, price and line optimization, package testing and volumetric forecasting.

rows.title: Research Analyst-540176 with Security Clearance
rows.descriptionText:
Description Under this task order, the contractors will work directly with the DRL/ONR office, U.S. Department of State (DOS) to support DRL/ONR's mission to coordinate and implement bureau policy on transnational repression (TNR).. This position will include monitoring unclassified and classified information sources, undertaking research, drafting documents, entering data into relevant unclassified and classified computer systems, drafting written communications, and advising, briefing, and otherwise supporting relevant interlocutors within the State Department, the U.S. government interagency, intergovernmental organizations and civil society organizations. The contractor will work on a team consisting of civil service, foreign service, and contractor personnel. This one (1) position is required to conduct research, technical analysis, and written materials regarding global trends of TNR and support policies to counter and prevent TNR threats that undermine U.S. sovereignty and the rights and safety of persons in the United States. Job Duties: * Support the Department of State's DRL/ONR office in leading efforts alongside interagency partners, intergovernmental organizations, non-governmental organizations, and civil society interlocutors to counter and deter TNR.

 Engage with international counterparts via bilateral or multilateral engagements, including the U.S.-led G7 Rapid Response Mechanism Working Group on TNR and FVEYs channels, to raise awareness of TNR threats, to advance U.S. TNR priorities, and coordinate on information sharing and joint responses. Conduct open source, sensitive, and classified research (including top secret intelligence reports) on cases of suspected TNR through collaboration with relevant geographic bureaus, regional desks, embassies abroad, the intelligence community, and relevant law enforcement agencies to shape interagency course of action development. Coordinate findings with the Office of the Legal Advisor, Bureau of Consular Affairs, Bureau of Counterterrorism, Bureau of Intelligence and Research, Bureau of International Narcotics and Law Enforcement, Department of Justice, Department of Homeland Security, and others by preparing reports, analyses, and briefing materials to inform policy determinations. Monitor and analyze global events that pose a heightened risk of transnational repression, particularly including the abuse of international law enforcement communications and other international cooperation mechanisms, for human rights defenders, civil society activists, journalists, and political critics and dissidents. Develop timely, persuasive materials to further U.S. policies on transnational repression, including briefing memos, BCLs, IMAs, policy papers, Congressional correspondence, and other materials as assigned.

rows.title: Research Assistant - Center for Neurodevelopmental and Imaging Research
rows.descriptionText:
The Research Assistant I assists behavioral and neuroimaging research focused on children with neurodevelopmental conditions with the Neurodevelopmental and Imaging Research Center. The Research Assistant I will play an integral role in all phases of research, including participant recruitment and assessment, MRI data acquisition, neuroimaging data processing, quantitative analysis, and dissemination of research findings. This role interacts with children and families in a clinical research environment and works independently with complex neuroimaging datasets and computational tools.

 Assist with study enrollment, including screening potential participants, determining eligibility, scheduling appointments, preparing participant materials, and supporting participant retention and longitudinal follow-up efforts. Prepare pediatric participants for MRI scanning, including mock scanner training, behavioral support, and facilitation of a positive and engaging research


experience for children and families.

 Administer, score, and support psychosocial, behavioral, clinical, physiologic, and neuroimaging research activities in accordance with study protocols and


Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements.

 Maintain accurate study documentation, participant records, regulatory records, and research databases to ensure accessibility, completeness, and compliance with IRB standards. Coordinate and support MRI and diffuse optical tomography (DOT) scanning sessions involving pediatric participants, ensuring adherence to study protocols and MRI safety procedures. Coordinate and support collection of actigraphy, EEG, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, and computer vision-based data to assess physical


activity, sleep health, physiological function, motor functioning, and movement patterns.

 Perform quality assurance procedures for MRI, DOT, wearable sensor, and biological motion capture data acquisition; monitor scan and data quality; and


troubleshoot issues during data collection.

 Process structural and functional neuroimaging data using established pipelines and software tools, conduct image quality control, and identify imaging artifacts. Assist with neuroimaging analyses, including brain morphometry, connectivity analyses, longitudinal modeling, and other analytical approaches across


research modalities.

 Process and analyze actigraphy, EEG, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, behavioral, and clinical datasets to quantify physical activity, sleep


health, physiological outcomes, and motor function.

 Manage, clean, integrate, organize, and maintain neuroimaging, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, behavioral, clinical, and imaging archive


databases.

 Write and maintain scripts for automated data processing, quality assurance, database management, data visualization, and reproducible research workflows using tools such as Python, MATLAB, R, or Bash. Generate figures, tables, reports, and other materials for manuscripts, presentations, conference abstracts, grant applications, grant reporting, and


academic, clinical, or community audiences.

 Participate in laboratory meetings, research discussions, and meetings with research and administrative partners; assist with scheduling, agenda


preparation, discussion facilitation, and note-taking as needed.

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in Neuroscience, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Biology, or a related field, required.

EXPERIENCE

 Demonstrated interest in neurodevelopment, child development, neuroscience, or clinical research, required. One (1) year of experience with biomedical or social research experience preferred. Familiarity with neuroimaging software such as FreeSurfer, FSL, AFNI, SPM, MRICloud, or related platforms, preferred. Experience working with children, families, or clinical populations. Experience with statistical analysis and data visualization and proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB), preferred.

Also, to make contributions to various aspects of research efforts and perform routine troubleshooting and helps with training and orientation of others working in the laboratory.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Plan and run experiments after discussion with investigators. Work may include making protocol modifications within the parameters set by investigator.Utilize specialized knowledge to interpret results, e.g. read controls, and evaluate results.Use scientific knowledge and lab experience to evaluate whether component parts of experiments are working as expected. Train/orient learners and new staff in the laboratory. Assist in development of new techniques and instruments.Become familiar with published research methods related to current experimental work by investigating published protocols and discussing them with more senior laboratory staff and/or faculty investigators.Process analyzed data into figures for scientific publications.May order equipment and supplies, and interface with vendors.May facilitate problem solving for entry-level lab members with research assays. May participate in protocol development, efficiency, and productivity.May contribute to writing manuscripts and grants by writing methodology sections.Other duties as assigned.

Bachelor's Degree in biology, chemistry or related field.One year of laboratory experience performing relevant techniques.Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

rows.title: Psychology Associate - Research
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Psychology Associate I (Research) will help implement various ongoing pediatric studies, to include recruiting, screening, scheduling, and testing children with and without reading difficulties, ADHD, Autism spectrum disorders, and Tourette syndrome. The incumbent may also assist with ongoing community-based research projects that may require traveling to off-site research locations to complete testing, attending recruitment events, and assisting with training.

Responsibilities

 Administer and score a variety of diagnostic, cognitive, academic, and behavioral assessment instruments adhering to study protocols and Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements. Prepare reports describing research participants’ performance on standardized assessments administered as part of research protocols. Train and supervise staff, students, and volunteers on all aspects of study protocols. Assist with the coordination and communications of research projects in accordance with the funding agency’s award statement, including the recruitment of participants and implementation of all aspects of study protocols. Design databases and implement database design changes. Organize and maintain participant records to ensure accessibility, completion, and compliance with IRB standards. Participate in project meetings involving, but not limited to, grant preparation, manuscript preparation, quality control issues, and protocol development or

revision.

 Code, verify, and accurately enter research data into databases. Accompany participants to the neuroimaging scanner and assist with mock scanning. Explain procedures and sequence of events, and ensure participants

are comfortable and ready to participate in the study.

 Participate in manuscript preparation, including formulating ideas, conducting literature searches, performing data analyses, and assisting in the writing of the manuscript. Enhance professional growth and development through case-conferences, educational programs, in-service meetings, workshops, conferences, and seminars.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS:

Must possess and maintain registration as a psychology associate in Maryland to work under the license of a psychologist employed at the Institute.

EDUCATION:

Master’s degree in clinical, counseling or school psychology or equivalent (as recognized by the Maryland Board of Examiners of Psychologists) required.

EXPERIENCE:

 Minimum 1 year of experience with pediatric populations required. This experience may be satisfied through externship training in psychology. Minimum 1 year of experience facilitating research projects is required. Two years of experience is preferred. Minimum 1 year of experience administering psychological and/or neuropsychological assessments is required.

 Minimum pay range

rows.title: Operations Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter . Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

SPA has a near-term need for a highly motivated Jr. Operations Research Analyst to support key DoD programs in the National Capital Region. In this role, you will learn to apply analytic techniques, modeling and simulation tools, and clear communication skills to help senior decision makers evaluate complex defense challenges. The ideal candidate brings a strong quantitative foundation, curiosity about data driven analysis, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast paced environment. This position requires the candidate to be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain a Top Secret/SCI clearance. Candidates must be able to work independently and as part of a team; training will be provided. Working remote is not an option, and successful candidates are required to work from SPA HQ or from client classified spaces. #KS

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will contribute to project teams by supporting the development of digital models, running simulations, analyzing data, and helping communicate results. Under the direction of senior analysts, day-to-day work includes the ability to:

 Support the development of digital models of complex real-world systems using commercial and proprietary tools. Assist in the design, build, and execution of constructive simulations using best practices for design of experiments. Analyze data sets using analytic frameworks and statistical methods. Prepare presentations, reports, and other deliverables to convey findings and recommendations. Balance tasks across multiple projects and maintain regular communication with task leads.

Qualifications

This position supports DoD programs in the National Capital Region and requires strong analytic, technical, and communication skills to inform decision‑making across complex defense challenges.

Required Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, or a closely related field  Coursework, internship, or academic project experience with data analysis and visualization using Excel, Python, R, Tableau, or similar tools  Ability to apply structured, rigorous analytic methodologies to complex problem-solving  Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to deliver clear technical presentations  U.S. citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI clearance 

Desired Qualifications

 Internship, co-op, ROTC, or academic project exposure to DoD organizations, acquisition programs, or capability development activities  Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools commonly used in defense analysis (e.g., CAMEO, MagicDraw, Sparx EA, AFSIM, STK, AnyLogic) or mission-level modeling and simulation  Knowledge of design of experiments, statistical modeling, machine learning methods, AI agentic training  Softwared development, programming knowledge 

 Pay Range Information 

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, etc. Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are commensurate with experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. Virginia, Pay Transparency Salary range: USD $80,000.00/Yr. - USD $110,000.00/Yr.

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist -  Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Have you ever seen the headline in the news “Banks Pass Federal Reserve Stress Tests” and wondered how Capital One determines how much savings (or “capital”) it needs? Or maybe how we analyze the potential impact of the next recession? At the heart of these questions are sophisticated econometric loss models that help us understand the ways in which the economy impacts our loan portfolios and guide strategic decision making at the highest levels of Capital One.

In the Consumer Credit Risk Management Models and Data Team, we blend cutting-edge quantitative methods, with a deep understanding of our business, data, and regulatory environment to build and deploy predictive models for losses, account volumes and outstanding balances. These models drive key strategic decisions for loss allowances, stress testing, and capital allocation as well as informing our earnings calls and recession preparedness.

If this sounds interesting to you, join us! As a Data Scientist on the deployment & platform side of the team, you’ll be at the forefront helping us to usher in the next wave of disruption by using the latest technology to deploy, optimize and modernize model pipelines and execution platforms that enable machine learning models to provide powerful insights about our portfolio and growth opportunities through new data sources. You will partner with best-in-class data scientists, analysts, and engineers to innovate solutions that directly impact the company’s bottom line in a meaningful way. You will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibilities, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

About Partner ForcesPartner Forces is a management consulting firm helping homeland security organizations solve some of their most pressing and complex challenges. We partner with government agencies and industry to strengthen national security and critical infrastructure through expertise in strategy, program management, stakeholder engagement, technology implementation, preparedness, and business transformation.
At Partner Forces, we're more than consultants - we're trusted advisors. We work alongside our clients to solve meaningful problems, deliver actionable solutions, and make a lasting impact. As a growing firm, every employee has the opportunity to contribute not only to our clients' success, but also to the future of Partner Forces. We believe great consultants are developed through collaboration, mentorship, continuous learning, and meaningful opportunities to lead.
Our culture is grounded in six core values: Integrity, Excellence, Positivity, Candor, Determination, and Teamwork. These values shape how we work with our clients, support one another, and grow together. We believe that when our people thrive, our clients do too, which is why we invest in our employees' well-being, professional development, and long-term success.
What We Are Looking ForPartner Forces is seeking a Cleared Data Analytics & Visualization Analyst to support a Department of Homeland Security cybersecurity program. We’re looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with the communication and consulting skills needed to work directly with customers, understand their needs, and turn data into meaningful insights. This role will initially focus on data analysis, reporting, visualization, and development of analytic products, with the opportunity to evolve into broader technical program and PMO support. The right person does not need to be a software developer, but should be technically curious, comfortable working alongside technical teams, and able to understand and translate conversations about data, systems, and technology.
What You'll DoAnalyze program and operational data to identify trends, insights, risks, and opportunities.Develop dashboards, reports, visualizations, and other analytic products that make complex information easier to understand and act on.Engage directly with customers and stakeholders to gather requirements, understand business needs, and translate those needs into useful data and technology solutions.Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.Support recurring and ad hoc reporting and help improve or automate existing reporting processes.Work alongside technical teams to understand requirements, dependencies, risks, and priorities across data and software initiatives.Support technical program management activities, including tracking requirements, decisions, deliverables, action items, and project progress.Participate in technical discussions involving databases, data schemas, software systems, integrations, and related technologies.Support data governance, documentation, process development, and continuous improvement efforts.Adapt to evolving program needs and take on new responsibilities as the program and technical environment mature.
QualificationsUS Citizenship required.Bachelors degree required.Secret clearance required.Experience in data analysis, business analytics, program analysis, or a related field.Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with experience developing reports, dashboards, or other analytic products.Experience working directly with customers or stakeholders to gather, clarify, and translate requirements.Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical audiences.Experience with or exposure to Python or R; advanced programming expertise is not required.Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.Ability and interest in learning new systems, technologies, and technical concepts.Experience with Power BI, Databricks, ServiceNow, Power Automate, or similar tools preferred but not required.Familiarity with database concepts, data schemas, data governance, or software development environments preferred.ServiceNow administration or development experience is a plus.Previous experience supporting federal government clients or exposure to cybersecurity programs is a plus.Next StepsIf your application looks like a match, someone from our People Operations team will reach out to schedule a phone screening. During this conversation, we will determine if the current or future position aligns with your experience and skills. If things go well, from there you'll meet with members from the project team, including the hiring manager and teammates, and possibly be asked to submit a writing assessment to showcase your practical knowledge. If we find you are a match, you’ll get a call offering you the role. While we wish we could hire every great candidate who comes our way, the reality is that we can't. If you are not selected, we will be sure to connect with you and let you know so you can move on with your search. We will also keep your resume for future needs.
Partner Forces is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at recruiting@partnerforces.com.

rows.title: Junior Forward Deployed Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) 

At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people.  Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

About the APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Program:

APX (Advanced Partnership Accelerator) is a Center of Excellence under AFS’ Data & AI capability. The APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Program represents a strategic initiative to position Accenture Federal Services at the forefront of artificial intelligence innovation in government. This program embeds top technical talent directly with federal clients to fast track the adoption and implementation of advanced technologies from Palantir, Databricks, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and cutting edge AI partners.

As an FDE, you will serve as the critical bridge between breakthrough AI technology and mission-critical federal requirements. You'll work hands-on with the most advanced AI models available, translating their transformative potential into tangible value for defense, intelligence, civilian, and public health missions. This is not a traditional consulting role; FDEs are technical practitioners, innovators, and trusted advisors who operate at the cutting edge of what's possible with AI in highly regulated, high-security federal environments.

What You Will Do:

The APX FDE program exists because federal missions cannot wait for slow, siloed development cycles. They need embedded engineers who move with urgency, autonomy, and precision while being able to reach back to broader support across AFS. As a Junior FDE, you will work at the intersection of engineering, product thinking and client delivery, helping technical teams move from ambiguous client problems, to working proof-of-concept, to production-grade deployment in a matter of weeks. In this role you will:

Embed within client environments as part of a forward deployed engineering (FDE) team to build rapid prototypes using AI tools, coding assistants, and modern frameworks Use AI tools (LLMs, coding assistants, agentic frameworks) as part of daily development work Support integration of solutions into complex client environments, including legacy systems and regulated data contexts Work across the tech stack (frontend, backend, APIs, simple data pipelines) and help develop applications and workflows that use structured and unstructured enterprise data Assist in evaluating model outputs, testing workflows, and applying responsible AI guardrails Implement AI solutions such as RAG workflows, semantic search, prompt engineering patterns, and simple agent behaviors Work with senior FDEs to clarify problem statements and translate them into technical plans Participate in rapid experimentation cycles and incorporate user feedback into updates, documenting solution decisions and contributing to internal learning assets Leverage technical expertise to help clients navigate the rapidly evolving technological landscape, serving as a trusted advisor on emerging AI capabilities, increasing user adoption and scaling mission impact Share observations, user friction points, reusable assets and field intelligence back to APX teams to improve delivery approaches 

What You Bring:

Mission-first Mindset & Relentless Problem Solving: You move fast because the mission can’t wait. You make smart bets in ambiguous terrain, taking ownership early and giving every challenge your full drive before ever considering stepping back. You push through ambiguity, communicate risks and trade-offs, investigate solutions independently to forge the future, and maintain momentum even when the path forward is unclear. Grit & Tenacity to Engineer at the Edge: You remain steady when projects get messy and keep pushing forward through rapid experimentation cycles. You show up confidently in client working sessions, support senior FDEs at the mission edge, adapt in real time, and help teams operate decisively even in uncertainty. Bias for Building: You iterate quickly, communicate plainly across technical and non-technical teammates, ask sharp questions, and summarize decisions in a way that moves teams forward with confidence and alignment. You build work that adds value for our clients, making bold ideas happen fast. Limitless Curiosity & Frontier Learning: You learn rapidly across a wide, rapidly changing technical frontier, from LLMs and agent frameworks to cloud platforms and enterprise AI ecosystems. You approach new tools with curiosity, adaptability, and velocity, and you prefer building and testing over long specification cycles. 

Here’s What You Need:

Bachelor’s Degree or demonstrated hands-on coding experience building and shipping software projects Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Rust) with knowledge of building production services Familiarity with Generative AI (LLMs, chatbots, or AI-powered apps) and eagerness to learn how model outputs influence product workflows Exposure working with APIs and simple data flows, managing structured and unstructured data and ensure data quality. Ability to travel, dependent on client and team Must be a U.S. Citizen and ability to obtain a federal security clearance 

Bonus Points if You Have: 

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related technical field Experience with Palantir, Databricks, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or other emerging technology platforms Prior client experience or collaborative technical work (consulting internships, hackathons, customer success engineering, or team-based builds) Exposure to cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) from coursework, certificates, internships, or individual projects Experience integrating or deploying code in environments with constraints (legacy systems, governance, access controls) Demonstrated ability to take a small idea from zero-to-prototype independently Curiosity about how different frontier labs operate and eagerness to learn their platforms: Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, etc. Relevant Google, Anthropic, or OpenAI certifications or training courses Ability to travel (up to 50%) depending on business need and client requirements Active federal security clearance 

As required by local law, Accenture Federal Services provides reasonable ranges of compensation for hired roles based on labor costs in the states of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia. Accenture Federal Services offers a wide variety of benefits. You can find more information on benefits here. We accept applications on an on-going basis and there is no fixed deadline to apply.

The pay range for the states of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia is:

$72,600—$132,100 USD

What We Believe 

As a company wholly dedicated to serving the US federal government, we bring together the best talent to help reinvent how federal agencies operate and deliver greater value for their mission and the American people. rows.title: Research Assistant - Center for Neurodevelopmental and Imaging Research
rows.descriptionText:
The Research Assistant I assists behavioral and neuroimaging research focused on children with neurodevelopmental conditions with the Neurodevelopmental and Imaging Research Center. The Research Assistant I will play an integral role in all phases of research, including participant recruitment and assessment, MRI data acquisition, neuroimaging data processing, quantitative analysis, and dissemination of research findings. This role interacts with children and families in a clinical research environment and works independently with complex neuroimaging datasets and computational tools.

 Assist with study enrollment, including screening potential participants, determining eligibility, scheduling appointments, preparing participant materials, and supporting participant retention and longitudinal follow-up efforts. Prepare pediatric participants for MRI scanning, including mock scanner training, behavioral support, and facilitation of a positive and engaging research


experience for children and families.

 Administer, score, and support psychosocial, behavioral, clinical, physiologic, and neuroimaging research activities in accordance with study protocols and


Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements.

 Maintain accurate study documentation, participant records, regulatory records, and research databases to ensure accessibility, completeness, and compliance with IRB standards. Coordinate and support MRI and diffuse optical tomography (DOT) scanning sessions involving pediatric participants, ensuring adherence to study protocols and MRI safety procedures. Coordinate and support collection of actigraphy, EEG, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, and computer vision-based data to assess physical


activity, sleep health, physiological function, motor functioning, and movement patterns.

 Perform quality assurance procedures for MRI, DOT, wearable sensor, and biological motion capture data acquisition; monitor scan and data quality; and


troubleshoot issues during data collection.

 Process structural and functional neuroimaging data using established pipelines and software tools, conduct image quality control, and identify imaging artifacts. Assist with neuroimaging analyses, including brain morphometry, connectivity analyses, longitudinal modeling, and other analytical approaches across


research modalities.

 Process and analyze actigraphy, EEG, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, behavioral, and clinical datasets to quantify physical activity, sleep


health, physiological outcomes, and motor function.

 Manage, clean, integrate, organize, and maintain neuroimaging, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, behavioral, clinical, and imaging archive


databases.

 Write and maintain scripts for automated data processing, quality assurance, database management, data visualization, and reproducible research workflows using tools such as Python, MATLAB, R, or Bash. Generate figures, tables, reports, and other materials for manuscripts, presentations, conference abstracts, grant applications, grant reporting, and


academic, clinical, or community audiences.

 Participate in laboratory meetings, research discussions, and meetings with research and administrative partners; assist with scheduling, agenda


preparation, discussion facilitation, and note-taking as needed.

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in Neuroscience, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Biology, or a related field, required.

EXPERIENCE

 Demonstrated interest in neurodevelopment, child development, neuroscience, or clinical research, required. One (1) year of experience with biomedical or social research experience preferred. Familiarity with neuroimaging software such as FreeSurfer, FSL, AFNI, SPM, MRICloud, or related platforms, preferred. Experience working with children, families, or clinical populations. Experience with statistical analysis and data visualization and proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB), preferred.


USD $36,955.98/Yr.

rows.title: Post Doctoral Fellow
rows.descriptionText:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health supportWork-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangementsFinancial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement pathsAdditional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

https://hr.howard.edu/benefits-wellness

Basic Function

A full-time Postdoctoral Position is immediately available in the Laboratory of Dr. Sayan Nandi, in collaboration with Dr. Thomas Heinbockel and Dr. Byron Ford, in the Department of Anatomy, Howard University, Washington DC. The laboratories are focused on understanding the roles of neuroinflammation in brain injury. Microglia are the principal immune cells of the brain and constitute 10%-15% of total brain cells. They are bona fide phagocytes with well-defined roles in clearing dead cells and debris. Microglial “activation” is considered as a “double-edged sword” in neural injuries such as stroke and traumatic brain injury, with both beneficial and detrimental roles. Microglial “activation” is required to clear dead neurons, leading to the recovery process. On the other hand, inappropriately activated microglia can release proinflammatory cytokines and further engulf live neurons, thereby worsening the injury. We will test the ideas of direct roles played by microglia in these processes using genetically engineered mouse models. We will combine surgical, histological, imaging and molecular (spatial transcriptomic and epigenetic) approaches to understand microglial contribution to the recovery

from a neural injury.

Supervisory Accountability

The candidate is expected to be involved either directly or indirectly (by assisting the PIs) in the training of incoming students and postdoctoral fellows.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include assistant/associate deans, directors, department heads/chairs, faculty, staff and students at the College and school levels, and deans, directors, and executive level officers at university level. External contacts include governmental agencies such as Federal and the District of

Columbia Agencies, health professionals, students, parents, and the general public. Fulfill tasks in collaborative team of students and researchers from Howard University.

Principal Accountabilities

The candidate is expected to have training in rodent surgical, histological and imaging techniques.The candidate is also expected to work collaboratively with the faculty in the Department of Anatomy as well as outside the Department, as required.The candidate should be able to effectively communicate with the PIs.This position requires in-depth understanding of brain functions and scientific literature, extensive data analyses and interpretation as well as skills required for scientific presentation.The candidate is expected to be involved in the training of incoming students and postdoctoral fellows in the PI’s laboratory.Participates in academic, didactic, and professional training provided through seminars, workshops, and direct meetings with grant faculty.Coordinates and assure development of pertinent reports and their timely delivery.Conducts data collection, statistical analysis, and data interpretation responsibilities secondary to CMHSR grant portfolio.Participates in grant writing, development of manuscripts and reports, and conduct of primary and secondary data analyses.Manages their own project, which is expected to yield one or more publications including conference abstract proceedings.Mentors doctoral, master’s and undergraduate students engaged in independent research activities.Develops proficiency in career skills, including writing, public speaking, networking, and critical evaluation of scientific literature.Presents scientific work both inside and outside the University with excellent oralcommunication skills.Assists with grant preparation and reporting and contributes to laboratory organizationincluding meeting planning.Designs research experiments, evaluates research findings, and reports results.Conscientious discharge of his/her research responsibilities.Maintains conformity with ethical standards in research.Maintains compliance with good laboratory practice including the maintenance of adequate research records.Engages in open and timely discussion with his/her mentor regarding possession or distribution of material, reagents, or records belonging to their laboratory and any proposed disclosure of findings or techniques privately or in publications.Collegial conduct towards co-trainees, staff members and members of the research group.Adherence to all applicable University policies, procedures, and regulations. All data, research records and materials and other intellectual property generated in university laboratories remain the property of the University.Participates in weekly and/or bi-weekly group meetings, and professional training with or without students.

Core Competencies

Demonstrated analytical and critical thinking skills.Excellent teamwork and communication skills.Scientific writing skills demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications.Ability to acquire accurate, reproducible data.Critical eye towards consistency, reproducibility, and the scientific method in generalExcellent project and time management skillsStrong interpersonal and mentoring skillsAdvocate for safety and ethics in the workplace.Demonstrated computing experience and knowledge, including software packages such as word processing, database applications, and spreadsheet.Competence in both oral and written English and ability to articulate concisely and in aprofessional manner.Ability to maintain confidentiality of information.Ability to work effectively in a collaborative interdisciplinary healthcare environment.

Minimum Requirements

Applicants should have received, by the activation date of the postdoctoral fellowship, a Ph.D. (or similar

doctoral degree such as MD, Pharm.D., Sc.D., DrPH, etc.) in Neuroscience or related fields.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$60,000-$70,000

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist -  Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Have you ever seen the headline in the news “Banks Pass Federal Reserve Stress Tests” and wondered how Capital One determines how much savings (or “capital”) it needs? Or maybe how we analyze the potential impact of the next recession? At the heart of these questions are sophisticated econometric loss models that help us understand the ways in which the economy impacts our loan portfolios and guide strategic decision making at the highest levels of Capital One.

In the Consumer Credit Risk Management Models and Data Team, we blend cutting-edge quantitative methods, with a deep understanding of our business, data, and regulatory environment to build and deploy predictive models for losses, account volumes and outstanding balances. These models drive key strategic decisions for loss allowances, stress testing, and capital allocation as well as informing our earnings calls and recession preparedness.

If this sounds interesting to you, join us! As a Data Scientist on the deployment & platform side of the team, you’ll be at the forefront helping us to usher in the next wave of disruption by using the latest technology to deploy, optimize and modernize model pipelines and execution platforms that enable machine learning models to provide powerful insights about our portfolio and growth opportunities through new data sources. You will partner with best-in-class data scientists, analysts, and engineers to innovate solutions that directly impact the company’s bottom line in a meaningful way. You will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibilities, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications: 

Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)Experience working with AWSAt least 2 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or RAt least 2 years’ experience with machine learningAt least 2 years’ experience with SQL
