rows.title: Psychology Associate - Research
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

The Psychology Associate I (Research) will help implement various ongoing pediatric studies, to include recruiting, screening, scheduling, and testing children with and without reading difficulties, ADHD, Autism spectrum disorders, and Tourette syndrome. The incumbent may also assist with ongoing community-based research projects that may require traveling to off-site research locations to complete testing, attending recruitment events, and assisting with training.

Responsibilities

 Administer and score a variety of diagnostic, cognitive, academic, and behavioral assessment instruments adhering to study protocols and Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements. Prepare reports describing research participants’ performance on standardized assessments administered as part of research protocols. Train and supervise staff, students, and volunteers on all aspects of study protocols. Assist with the coordination and communications of research projects in accordance with the funding agency’s award statement, including the recruitment of participants and implementation of all aspects of study protocols. Design databases and implement database design changes. Organize and maintain participant records to ensure accessibility, completion, and compliance with IRB standards. Participate in project meetings involving, but not limited to, grant preparation, manuscript preparation, quality control issues, and protocol development or

revision.

 Code, verify, and accurately enter research data into databases. Accompany participants to the neuroimaging scanner and assist with mock scanning. Explain procedures and sequence of events, and ensure participants

are comfortable and ready to participate in the study.

 Participate in manuscript preparation, including formulating ideas, conducting literature searches, performing data analyses, and assisting in the writing of the manuscript. Enhance professional growth and development through case-conferences, educational programs, in-service meetings, workshops, conferences, and seminars.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS:

Must possess and maintain registration as a psychology associate in Maryland to work under the license of a psychologist employed at the Institute.

EDUCATION:

Master’s degree in clinical, counseling or school psychology or equivalent (as recognized by the Maryland Board of Examiners of Psychologists) required.

EXPERIENCE:

 Minimum 1 year of experience with pediatric populations required. This experience may be satisfied through externship training in psychology. Minimum 1 year of experience facilitating research projects is required. Two years of experience is preferred. Minimum 1 year of experience administering psychological and/or neuropsychological assessments is required.

 Minimum pay range 

USD $50,786.11/Yr.

 Maximum pay range 

USD $87,503.31/Yr.

rows.title: AI Execution Analyst and Reporting Lead 1 1 1
rows.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

Areas of focus

AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include:

Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $188,600 to $339,400Bay Area California offices – $196,400 to $353,600All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $157,100 to $311,100 Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.For those living in California, please click here for additional information.At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist -  Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Consumer Credit Risk Models and Data

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Have you ever seen the headline in the news “Banks Pass Federal Reserve Stress Tests” and wondered how Capital One determines how much savings (or “capital”) it needs? Or maybe how we analyze the potential impact of the next recession? At the heart of these questions are sophisticated econometric loss models that help us understand the ways in which the economy impacts our loan portfolios and guide strategic decision making at the highest levels of Capital One.

In the Consumer Credit Risk Management Models and Data Team, we blend cutting-edge quantitative methods, with a deep understanding of our business, data, and regulatory environment to build and deploy predictive models for losses, account volumes and outstanding balances. These models drive key strategic decisions for loss allowances, stress testing, and capital allocation as well as informing our earnings calls and recession preparedness.

If this sounds interesting to you, join us! As a Data Scientist on the deployment & platform side of the team, you’ll be at the forefront helping us to usher in the next wave of disruption by using the latest technology to deploy, optimize and modernize model pipelines and execution platforms that enable machine learning models to provide powerful insights about our portfolio and growth opportunities through new data sources. You will partner with best-in-class data scientists, analysts, and engineers to innovate solutions that directly impact the company’s bottom line in a meaningful way. You will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibilities, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications: 

Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)Experience working with AWSAt least 2 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or RAt least 2 years’ experience with machine learningAt least 2 years’ experience with SQL

rows.title: Research Assistant - Center for Neurodevelopmental and Imaging Research
rows.descriptionText:
The Research Assistant I assists behavioral and neuroimaging research focused on children with neurodevelopmental conditions with the Neurodevelopmental and Imaging Research Center. The Research Assistant I will play an integral role in all phases of research, including participant recruitment and assessment, MRI data acquisition, neuroimaging data processing, quantitative analysis, and dissemination of research findings. This role interacts with children and families in a clinical research environment and works independently with complex neuroimaging datasets and computational tools.

 Assist with study enrollment, including screening potential participants, determining eligibility, scheduling appointments, preparing participant materials, and supporting participant retention and longitudinal follow-up efforts. Prepare pediatric participants for MRI scanning, including mock scanner training, behavioral support, and facilitation of a positive and engaging research


experience for children and families.

 Administer, score, and support psychosocial, behavioral, clinical, physiologic, and neuroimaging research activities in accordance with study protocols and


Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements.

 Maintain accurate study documentation, participant records, regulatory records, and research databases to ensure accessibility, completeness, and compliance with IRB standards. Coordinate and support MRI and diffuse optical tomography (DOT) scanning sessions involving pediatric participants, ensuring adherence to study protocols and MRI safety procedures. Coordinate and support collection of actigraphy, EEG, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, and computer vision-based data to assess physical


activity, sleep health, physiological function, motor functioning, and movement patterns.

 Perform quality assurance procedures for MRI, DOT, wearable sensor, and biological motion capture data acquisition; monitor scan and data quality; and


troubleshoot issues during data collection.

 Process structural and functional neuroimaging data using established pipelines and software tools, conduct image quality control, and identify imaging artifacts. Assist with neuroimaging analyses, including brain morphometry, connectivity analyses, longitudinal modeling, and other analytical approaches across


research modalities.

 Process and analyze actigraphy, EEG, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, behavioral, and clinical datasets to quantify physical activity, sleep


health, physiological outcomes, and motor function.

 Manage, clean, integrate, organize, and maintain neuroimaging, wearable sensor, biological motion capture, behavioral, clinical, and imaging archive


databases.

 Write and maintain scripts for automated data processing, quality assurance, database management, data visualization, and reproducible research workflows using tools such as Python, MATLAB, R, or Bash. Generate figures, tables, reports, and other materials for manuscripts, presentations, conference abstracts, grant applications, grant reporting, and


academic, clinical, or community audiences.

 Participate in laboratory meetings, research discussions, and meetings with research and administrative partners; assist with scheduling, agenda


preparation, discussion facilitation, and note-taking as needed.

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in Neuroscience, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Biology, or a related field, required.

EXPERIENCE

 Demonstrated interest in neurodevelopment, child development, neuroscience, or clinical research, required. One (1) year of experience with biomedical or social research experience preferred. Familiarity with neuroimaging software such as FreeSurfer, FSL, AFNI, SPM, MRICloud, or related platforms, preferred. Experience working with children, families, or clinical populations. Experience with statistical analysis and data visualization and proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB), preferred.

rows.title: Brinson Prize Fellowship 2027
rows.descriptionText:
The Brinson Foundation announces the call for applications for postdoctoral fellowships under the Brinson Prize Fellowship Program beginning in the fall of 2027. The Space Telescope Science Institute is collaborating with The Brinson Foundation in support of this program.

Brinson Prize Fellowships are awarded to early-career astrophysicists and cosmologists who are committed to chasing bold ideas with creative, nimble, and innovative research. The awards support ambitious research in observational cosmology, with a focus on projects that complement and capitalize on the latest space science. Proposals describing instrumentation development should be connected with observing the sky, and all proposals should include a science communication plan and ideas for future engagement with broad audiences.

The fellowship is open to applicants who have earned (or will have earned) their doctoral degree on or after January 1, 2023 in astronomy, physics, or related disciplines. The duration of the Fellowship is up to three years.

We anticipate offering up to three Brinson Prize Fellowships this year. The Fellowships are tenable at the following participating U.S. institutions:

California Institute of TechnologyCornell UniversityHarvard UniversityJohns Hopkins UniversityMassachusetts Institute of TechnologyNorthwestern UniversityPrinceton UniversityStanford UniversityThe Ohio State UniversityUniversity of ArizonaUniversity of California, BerkeleyUniversity of ChicagoUniversity of HawaiiUniversity of Michigan


The University of Washington was withdrawn as a participating institution for 2027.

rows.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

As an Associate Director in Information Security, this position leads the application of AI engineering within a global technology program, working closely with program leadership, workstream leads and technologists from across the globe. The position is responsible for the AI agents and automation that produce the program's reporting to senior leadership and to regional teams, and for the technical standards that govern how the program builds with AI.

This position also serves as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams across the function on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within our services and processes. This includes identifying which assurance, risk and policy activities are suited to AI, advising teams on the approach to take, and establishing the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function.

This is a hands-on engineering position at a senior technical grade, with authority across the program and no direct reports. The position runs and builds AI agents and automation using Claude alongside Python, Power Automate, and the Microsoft platform, and determines what work is given to an agent, how agent output is verified, and what remains with people.

Areas of focus

AI Engineering: Building agentic workflows in Claude that complete an entire piece of work, from reading source data through to producing the finished output.Functional AI Leadership: Acting as the AI leader for Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy, guiding teams on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes.Automation Delivery: Owning a program's automation estate, including what is automated, how it is built, and how it is supported over time.Assurance of AI Output: Accountability for reporting that is accurate, reconciled and defensible, with verification of agent output built into the systems that produce it.AI Standards and Capability: Setting the technical direction and standards for how the program builds with AI, and developing engineering capability across the program.

Key Responsibilities

Key responsibilities include:

Design, build and operate the AI agents and automation that produce the program's recurring reporting, using Claude and Claude Code, integrated with the enterprise systems.Own the AI and automation roadmap for the program, prioritizing work according to the effort it saves and the risk it reduces.Guide teams across Technology Assurance, Risk and Policy on where and how to apply AI and agentic AI within the function's services and processes, including which activities are suited to AI and the approach to take.Establish the practices that allow AI to be adopted consistently and safely across the function, and support teams in applying them.Establish how AI output is verified, including reconciliation and checks against source data on every run, and define the conditions under which an agent must stop and escalate rather than continue.Set the standards the program builds to for AI use, covering how work is scoped to an agent, prompt and context engineering, testing for repeatability, documentation and the handling of sensitive data.Advise program leadership on where AI is appropriate, including where a conventional solution is the better answer, and on the cost, risk and effort involved.Evaluate developments in AI tooling and models and introduce what is of value to the program.Build automation that is resilient and supportable, with error handling, secure credential management, logging and alerting, held in version control and documented so that it can be maintained by others.Work with IT and Information Security to secure approval, connectivity and ongoing support for AI tooling, and build within firm policy on AI use, data classification and client confidentiality.Represent the program's AI and automation position to senior stakeholders and governance forums.Develop AI engineering capability across the program through reusable components, documented patterns and practical working sessions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven technical authority in AI engineering, built on agents and automation in production that other people depend on.Ability to judge where AI is the right tool, where a conventional solution is better, and what should remain manual.Understanding of the limitations of AI models, and the ability to design verification appropriate to those limitations.Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate the accuracy of reporting relied on by senior leadership.Capable of building relationships with senior stakeholders.Proficient in explaining technical trade-offs and their business implications to a non-technical audience.Ability to work independently and set technical priorities in a large program.Ability to team well with others and raise the AI engineering capability of colleagues.Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver against fixed reporting deadlines.Ability to maintain a high level of integrity, trustworthiness and confidence when handling confidential information.

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 10 years of experience in software, automation or data engineering, including significant time as a senior individual contributor with technical ownership of systems in production.Demonstrable experience building production solutions with Claude, including Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK.Experience designing agentic workflows that complete an end-to-end task.Practical prompt and context engineering, including testing that model output is reliable and repeatable.Strong Python, including automation of document and data workflows with libraries such as python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl and pandas, or the equivalent.Microsoft platform experience: Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Graph.Production experience with a major enterprise workflow automation platform such as Power Automate, including error handling and unattended runs.A track record of automating a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, with demonstrable outcomes.Experience building unattended systems that run reliably, including error handling, credential management, logging, alerting and scheduling.Experience working with large datasets drawn from multiple systems, including reconciling them and assessing whether the data supports the conclusions being drawn from it.Experience setting technical standards that other people build to, through review, shared components or documented patterns.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.Strong English language communication skills and the ability to work with diverse, globally distributed teams.

Ideally, you'll also have

Experience integrating AI tooling with enterprise systems and data sources.Experience introducing AI tooling into a governed enterprise environment, including the approval and assurance path.Experience evaluating models or agent frameworks and making an adoption recommendation.Experience delivering security, technology risk or audit reporting to a senior audience.Familiarity with vulnerability management data and tooling.Experience coaching or building technical capability in colleagues who are not engineers.Relevant certification in cloud, data or security engineering.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals with a passion for applied AI and a demonstrated ability to build with it to a standard that a global professional services firm can rely on. This is a senior hands-on position for someone who wants to build AI into the way a large program works and to set the standard for how it is used.

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. As we expand our product offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions to our clients.

Our teams are small, agile, and empowered to choose the processes that work best for their goals. Every engineer contributes to the full development lifecycle, from ideation and design to implementation and testing, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.

This is a hybrid role based in Arlington, VA, requiring three days per week onsite.

 Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications across frontend, backend, API, and data-processing layers using technologies such as Java/Spring Boot, TypeScript, and React. Build and enhance scalable services and APIs that support experimentation, analytics, and data-driven decision-making.  Experience as a Software Engineer building and supporting full-stack applications in a modern software development environment. At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people.  Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

About the APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Program:

APX (Advanced Partnership Accelerator) is a Center of Excellence under AFS’ Data & AI capability. The APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Program represents a strategic initiative to position Accenture Federal Services at the forefront of artificial intelligence innovation in government. This program embeds top technical talent directly with federal clients to fast track the adoption and implementation of advanced technologies from Palantir, Databricks, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and cutting edge AI partners.

As an FDE, you will serve as the critical bridge between breakthrough AI technology and mission-critical federal requirements. You'll work hands-on with the most advanced AI models available, translating their transformative potential into tangible value for defense, intelligence, civilian, and public health missions. This is not a traditional consulting role; FDEs are technical practitioners, innovators, and trusted advisors who operate at the cutting edge of what's possible with AI in highly regulated, high-security federal environments.

What You Will Do:

The APX FDE program exists because federal missions cannot wait for slow, siloed development cycles. They need embedded engineers who move with urgency, autonomy, and precision while being able to reach back to broader support across AFS. As a Junior FDE, you will work at the intersection of engineering, product thinking and client delivery, helping technical teams move from ambiguous client problems, to working proof-of-concept, to production-grade deployment in a matter of weeks. In this role you will:

Embed within client environments as part of a forward deployed engineering (FDE) team to build rapid prototypes using AI tools, coding assistants, and modern frameworks Use AI tools (LLMs, coding assistants, agentic frameworks) as part of daily development work Support integration of solutions into complex client environments, including legacy systems and regulated data contexts Work across the tech stack (frontend, backend, APIs, simple data pipelines) and help develop applications and workflows that use structured and unstructured enterprise data Assist in evaluating model outputs, testing workflows, and applying responsible AI guardrails Implement AI solutions such as RAG workflows, semantic search, prompt engineering patterns, and simple agent behaviors Work with senior FDEs to clarify problem statements and translate them into technical plans Participate in rapid experimentation cycles and incorporate user feedback into updates, documenting solution decisions and contributing to internal learning assets Leverage technical expertise to help clients navigate the rapidly evolving technological landscape, serving as a trusted advisor on emerging AI capabilities, increasing user adoption and scaling mission impact Share observations, user friction points, reusable assets and field intelligence back to APX teams to improve delivery approaches 

What You Bring:

Mission-first Mindset & Relentless Problem Solving: You move fast because the mission can’t wait. You make smart bets in ambiguous terrain, taking ownership early and giving every challenge your full drive before ever considering stepping back. You push through ambiguity, communicate risks and trade-offs, investigate solutions independently to forge the future, and maintain momentum even when the path forward is unclear. Grit & Tenacity to Engineer at the Edge: You remain steady when projects get messy and keep pushing forward through rapid experimentation cycles. You show up confidently in client working sessions, support senior FDEs at the mission edge, adapt in real time, and help teams operate decisively even in uncertainty. Bias for Building: You iterate quickly, communicate plainly across technical and non-technical teammates, ask sharp questions, and summarize decisions in a way that moves teams forward with confidence and alignment. You build work that adds value for our clients, making bold ideas happen fast. Limitless Curiosity & Frontier Learning: You learn rapidly across a wide, rapidly changing technical frontier, from LLMs and agent frameworks to cloud platforms and enterprise AI ecosystems. You approach new tools with curiosity, adaptability, and velocity, and you prefer building and testing over long specification cycles. 

Here’s What You Need:

Bachelor’s Degree or demonstrated hands-on coding experience building and shipping software projects Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Rust) with knowledge of building production services Familiarity with Generative AI (LLMs, chatbots, or AI-powered apps) and eagerness to learn how model outputs influence product workflows Exposure working with APIs and simple data flows, managing structured and unstructured data and ensure data quality. Ability to travel, dependent on client and team Must be a U.S. Citizen and ability to obtain a federal security clearance 

Bonus Points if You Have: 

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related technical field Experience with Palantir, Databricks, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or other emerging technology platforms Prior client experience or collaborative technical work (consulting internships, hackathons, customer success engineering, or team-based builds) Exposure to cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) from coursework, certificates, internships, or individual projects Experience integrating or deploying code in environments with constraints (legacy systems, governance, access controls) Demonstrated ability to take a small idea from zero-to-prototype independently Curiosity about how different frontier labs operate and eagerness to learn their platforms: Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, etc. Relevant Google, Anthropic, or OpenAI certifications or training courses Ability to travel (up to 50%) depending on business need and client requirements Active federal security clearance

rows.title: cPLM Pack and Trade Data and Deployment Scientist (Project-based Role)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Mars is delivering a global Product Lifecycle Management transformation program (cPLM) to replace our existing system used to capture and evolve knowledge about our products. This role serves as the critical functional bridge between global Packaging R&D, Supply Chain, and the cPLM platform, securing the foundational data integrity of packaging specifications and finished trade items (Intermediate and Above) before and during all FN site deployments. By driving hands-on system validation, enforcing data compliance standards, and directly enabling packaging developers and master data coordinators, this position ensures that structural packaging specifications and logistics data are digitized accurately and compliantly.

In this role, you will work closely with the Food Nutrition (FN) Scope Lead, the FN SMEs and FN cPLM leadership team. You will also occasionally need to collaborate with Enterprise POs, Corporate DT and other segment scope leads to ensure seamless deployment and capability building.

This is a project-role for the Design and Development for the Food cPLM program. The role is funded through June 2028. As we approach the funding end date, your manager will be in touch with additional information including funding for next phases, including pilot and deployment.

Based country: UK or Netherlands

Your Responsibilities

Packaging and Trader Testing & Continuous Improvement

 Support Discovery & Workshop Execution: Participate in discovery sessions and workshops, capturing precise user needs, packaging data gaps, process steps, and translating them into clear functional requirements or user stories with the support of the scope leads. Validate Packaging & Trade Hierarchies: Build, configure, and validate complex packaging structures (primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging levels) and finished trade item specifications in test environments to verify system calculations, palletization patterns, and functional gaps. Test Attribute Inheritance & Handoffs: Define and execute test cases to ensure packaging material attributes (such as dimensions, weight, recyclability, and barrier properties) accurately roll up and populate at the finished trade item and logistics levels. Map Regional Variabilities: Connect with Packaging Development, Commercial, and Supply Chain across different regions to capture local packaging material and sourcing variations (e.g., local supplier capabilities, regional transit requirements) and verify that the global cPLM system template supports localized specifications without breaking standardization. Execute End-to-End Testing (UAT): Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by contributing to test scripts, preparing clean packaging data sets, logging defects, re-testing resolutions, and validating "dual-system" scenarios to ensure downstream systems (like ERP/SAP) receive accurate packaging and trade data. Drive Process Optimizations: Analyze support ticket trends and user feedback to propose proactive improvements to packaging data structures, workflows, or training templates.

User Support, Learning & Community Enablement

 Provide Day-to-Day Functional Support: Act as the primary, hands-on functional expert for Packaging Developers, Graphics/Artwork and MDG teams, troubleshooting complex system blocks (such as packaging specification creation, material BOM linking, and other scenarios). Triage & Issue Resolution: Capture, log, and categorize user inquiries, rapidly resolving functional "how-to" questions and collaborating with technical partners to resolve deep technical system bugs. Nurture a Champion Network: Establish and coordinate localized "drop-in" clinics or office hours for packaging and supply chain teams to drive community-led problem-solving and reduce repetitive support tickets.

Training, Deployment & Hypercare Support

 Design & Deliver Training: Partner with senior team members and enterprise training leads to support system training, interactive demos, and targeted walk-throughs focused on packaging spec creation, pallet patterns, and trade item setup for developers. Prepare Stakeholder & Leadership Communications: Translate complex cPLM system changes, updates, and escalation paths into clear, benefits-driven "impact summaries" and presentations for Packaging R&D and/or Supply Chain leadership. Coordinate Site Deployment Readiness: Drive site-specific deployment checklists, ensuring that local packaging and Master Data teams complete mandatory packaging data-cleansing and training activities before system go-live. Support FN Pilot and Future Deployments: Support the initial pilot deployment and subsequent Food Nutrition site deployments by establishing reusable templates, checklists, and gathering learning for continuous improvement. Support On-Site and Virtual Hypercare: Act as the dedicated "Intermediate & Above" hypercare lead during site deployments, working shoulder-to-shoulder with local packaging developers and Master Data analysts to resolve day-one data entry blocks.

Data Quality, Governance & Process Compliance

 Audit Legacy Data Readiness: Conduct rigorous data-readiness audits on legacy packaging specifications, pallet specifications, and trade item records, identifying missing, inconsistent, or non-compliant attributes prior to system migration. Remediate Data Gaps & Create Specifications: Directly support local and regional teams in filling critical data gaps by drafting and creating new packaging component and trade item specifications, obtaining missing dimensions or material properties, and ensuring all key records are complete and enriched prior to data migration. Partner with Data Stewards: Work closely with global and regional data stewards to define and enforce strict rules for trade item data, ensuring alignment with standards and regional logistics requirements. Systematically Cleanse Data Gaps: Proactively identify, prioritize, and remediate "orphan" or inconsistent packaging component records, aligning them with the new global packaging taxonomy. Enforce Global Standardization: Monitor and police adherence to global packaging and trade material standards, escalating unauthorized local workarounds or process deviations.

As the program evolves, your responsibilities may need to shift to support the team where needed most.

What do we look for?

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Packaging, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Food Science, Food Technology, or a related scientific discipline (preferred)4-6 years of relevant experience (e.g., R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, data or analytics or business support roles)Interest in digital systems and data; prior experience with R&D/Quality/PLM systems is a plusGood understanding of packaging R&D processes, material properties (primary/secondary/tertiary), and basic supply chain/logistics flows.Excellent networker, easily builds rapport remotelyExceptional English communication skills (oral and written).Good understanding of using computer systems to do your work. Basic use of AI chat services to support your learning would be useful.High learning agility with a proven ability to adapt rapidly to changes in a fast-paced, digital transformation environment.Proven ability to navigate undefined processes and troubleshoot on-the-go.SAP experience would be highly desirableStrong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and work effectively with cross-functional, multicultural teams from various R&D, SRA, Procurement, and IT backgrounds.Exceptional attention to detail with a passion for data accuracy and logical system flows

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

rows.title: Manager, Internal Control
rows.descriptionText:
About The Job

We have an amazing opportunity in our Louisville, CO or White Plains, NY offices for a Manager, Internal Control. As a Manager, Internal Control, you will be responsible to animate an effective internal control environment at Danone across the Americas region. Your focus will be the Sourcing and Finance business processes and control evaluation, with operations testing/traveling and other macroprocess support, as needed. In this role, you will be providing reasonable assurance that our Company is operating effectively and efficiently, has a reliable financial reporting system and complies with applicable local laws and regulations. Also, you will support the development and adoption of effective controls across different processes of the Company and drive continuous improvement in internal control processes.

As part of the team, you will be reporting to the Director, Internal Control and will manage multiple internal stakeholders such as Business Process Owner and Business Control Owners, in addition to working closely with the Global Danone Internal Control and Internal Audit Communities. In this role, you will need to have proper seniority to influence, a sense of urgency, ability to provide context and seek compromise with many areas. Minimum requirements for this role are 1) strong business partnering and communication and presentation skills, 2) curiosity, 3) organizational skills, and 4) ability to think independently and take initiative.

In this fast-paced, dynamic role, your key responsibilities will include but are not limited to

Plan, lead, and complete control testing for processes within your scope, including the effective coordination of resources and timely alignment with business stakeholders. Perform and oversee control evaluations, identify underlying root causes, develop practical and sustainable solutions, and review and align results with business. Occasionally perform operations control review during multi-location on-site visits, review and align results with business. Ensure high quality documentation of controls testing as per the Danone Internal Control guidelines. Conduct risk assessments on key business processes and provide risk mitigation recommendations when high risks are identifiedContribute to presentations and reporting in terms of both content and delivery to key stakeholdersManage management and leadership reporting and presentations, creating impactful content and effectively communicating key messages to the businessEnsure action plans are reviewed and implemented to mitigate risk with clear ownership. Act as a trusted advisor to business leadership by challenging existing processes, influencing organizational change, and helping stakeholders balance risk management with business objectivesPromote adherence to DBS and CBU’s policies and procedures. Identify continuous improvement opportunities for business processesUtilize Data Analytics, Robotic Process Automation, and Generative AI to proactively identify risk and process improvement opportunities, facilitate continuous monitoring, and testing by exception. Travel from 10-15% as needed

The salary range for this position is $110k-145k USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

This role is considered a “hybrid” position that allows for flexible work, meaning it is a role where collaboration with key stakeholders in Danone Hubs occurs. While you may have the option to work from home on a schedule as agreed to with your supervisor, you are also expected to regularly report to your assigned office location at least 3 days per week.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Job Purpose/Overview

The Lead R&D Processes & Work Systems drives adoption, performance and continuous improvement of R&D business processes and work systems across assigned areas. The role translates approved standards into practical routines, governance and capability building so that process expectations are consistently sustained in execution.

Key Responsibilities

Work Systems Leadership & Capability Building

 Lead activation of work system elements such as standard work, maturity expectations, governance routines, problem solving and continuous improvement practices. Build capability through training, coaching and communities of practice so teams can adopt and sustain required ways of working.

Process Adoption & Performance

 Partner with BPOs to convert approved process standards, controls and evidence requirements into practical routines and operating mechanisms. Track maturity, adherence and process performance indicators and drive actions to close gaps.

Regional Integration & Sustainment

 Coordinate with regions and local stakeholders to embed global standards into local execution without losing core control points. Support implementation of process changes into BAU and reinforce sustained use through governance and follow‑through.

Data & Performance Integration

 Ensure data requirements are understood in execution and that process teams are equipped to create complete, accurate and timely data at source. Surface recurring execution or data barriers and coordinate corrective action with process owners and data roles.

Continuous Improvement & Cross‑Functional Alignment

 Lead root cause analysis and practical improvement work across processes, systems and routines. Partner with deployment, data, analytics and technical teams to reinforce an integrated operating model.

Context and Scope

Explain how the job gets done and the way it operates within the team and with stakeholders

This role bridges process ownership and execution. It is differentiated from deployment roles by its primary focus on sustainment, maturity and ongoing work system adoption rather than program rollout management; and from T3 roles by its focus on localized application rather than global strategy or standard ownership.

Education & Professional Qualifications Preferred- Degree in Engineering, Food Science, Operations, Business or equivalent experience.

Knowledge / Experience- Experience in process improvement, work systems, operational excellence or structured capability deployment.

 Strong understanding of governance routines, standard work and behavioral change in a matrix environment. Ability to translate standards into practical execution and coach teams to adopt them. Exposure to R&D systems, quality expectations, data requirements or regulated environments preferred. Experience using performance measures and root cause methods to improve execution preferred.

 Manages Complexity Drives Results Ensures Accountability Builds Networks Collaborates

Job Description:

The Mars Finance Leadership Experience (MFLE) is a full-time, 3-year rotational program designed to support university graduates development in the early years of their Finance career. Associates will rotate through 3 different business areas in Finance across Mars locations – inclusive of Mars Snacking, Mars Petcare, Royal Canin, Internal Audit, Corporate Finance, Mars Global Services, and more!

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with over 170,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Mars Five Principles. Ongoing coaching and mentorship to help you succeed and get the most out of your experience. Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. Some of the perks you will receive are an industry competitive salary & benefits packages, fun freebies, and pet-friendly offices. To learn more about our brands, please click here. 

About Mars, Incorporated

For more than a century, Mars, Incorporated has been driven by the belief that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today. This idea is at the center of who we have always been as a global, family-owned business. Today, Mars is transforming, innovating, and evolving in ways that affirm our commitment to making a positive impact on the world around us.

Across our diverse and expanding portfolio of Snacking, Food, and Petcare products and services, we employ over 140,000 dedicated Associates who are all moving in the same direction: forward. As a $65 billion family-owned business, we produce some of the world’s best-loved brands including ROYAL CANIN®, PEDIGREE®, WHISKAS®, CESAR®, M&M’S®, SNICKERS®, Pringles®, Cheez-It®, and BEN’S ORIGINAL™. and take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses, including AniCura, Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, and VCA™.

We know we can only be truly successful if our partners and the communities in which we operate prosper as well. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our Associates to take action every day to help create a world tomorrow in which the planet, its people and pets can thrive. The Mars Compass, inspired by the Economics of Mutuality, is used to measure the company’s progress in service of its purpose; The world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today.

rows.title: Vice President Strategic Revenue Management
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

As the Vice President of Strategic Revenue Management (SRM) you will be accountable for embedding SRM into how Pet Nutrition North America plans, invests, and grows. This role operates at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Category Leadership, Finance, Supply, Digital, and customer teams, translating insights into practical commercial choices. Success requires shifting the organization from reactive, event-based decisions to a disciplined, value-led model with clear priorities, stronger analytics, tighter governance, and better connection to customer and category growth plans.

This role is on site in our Franklin, TN office.

What are we looking for?

Bachelor's degree in Finance Analytics or related field.10–15+ years of progressive commercial experience in CPG, with depth in SRM, customer development, pricing, trade investment, category strategy, finance, analytics, or commercial transformation. Proven ability to lead SRM as an enterprise growth capability, not just a set of tools or workstreams. Deep expertise in pricing strategy, PPA, promotion effectiveness, trade ROI, customer planning, and value realization. Demonstrated ability to convert analytics into clear decisions, trade-offs, executive recommendations, and measurable business outcomes. Experience embedding new capabilities into S&OP+, annual planning, customer planning, demand reviews, scorecards, and governance forums. Strong cross-functional influence with senior Sales, Marketing, Category, Finance, Supply, Digital, and General Management leaders. Track record of building and developing high-performing teams in a complex, matrixed organization. 

What will be your key responsibilities?

Set the SRM agenda: Define and lead the North America SRM strategy across pricing, promotion, trade investment, price-pack architecture, mix, customer planning, and value realization. Embed SRM into Customer Pods: Partner with Walmart, eCommerce, Grocery, Club, Value, Pet Specialty, and other teams to build coherent plans that improve customer outcomes while protecting enterprise value. Build trade and promotion rigor: Own trade investment strategy, promotion effectiveness, ROI expectations, guardrails, and planned-versus-actual accountability. Strengthen governance and decision rights: Establish clear pricing, promotion, trade, and investment thresholds with escalation paths for plans that do not meet financial or strategic expectations. Scale analytics and digital adoption: Lead adoption of SRM analytics, TPM, ROI measurement, elasticity, price simulation, scenario modeling, and decision-support tools. Partner with PGTs to embed SRM ways of working: imbed capabilites, tools, data standards, and digital capabilities that can be translated into practical routines that improve pricing, trade, promotion, and customer planning decisions at PGT level. Build organizational capability: Develop SRM playbooks, routines, training, and coaching so Sales, Marketing, Category, Finance, and customer teams own SRM thinking. Lead and develop the SRM team: Build a high-performing team with strong category, customer, analytics, trade, pricing, and transformation capabilities. 

What To Expect From Mars

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

rows.title: Mars Finance Leadership Experience
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

The Mars Finance Leadership Experience (MFLE) is a full-time, 3-year rotational program designed to support university graduates development in the early years of their Finance career. Associates will rotate through 3 different business areas in Finance across Mars locations – inclusive of Mars Snacking, Mars Petcare, Royal Canin, Internal Audit, Corporate Finance, Mars Global Services, and more!

In each role of the program, you will be a partner to the business to enable growth and support day to day operations. Examples of the types of work you will do include producing periodic and quarterly reporting and ensure timely submission of data in compliance with corporate deadlines, improving processes, procedures and internal controls and complete special projects, and more. Throughout your first 3 years with Mars, our goal is that you form a strong foundation across multiple types of finance roles to become a strong finance leader within the broader organization.

Your location will be based on the roles we have available in those cities at the time of your offer, but your preferences will be taken into account. Locations could include Chicago, IL, Franklin, TN, Creve Coeur, MO, New York City, NY, Los Angeles, CA, and more! It is expected that you relocate at least once during your time in the program to ensure you’re getting exposure to different business units across Mars.

As an Associate in the Mars Finance Leadership Experience, you will:

Help our finance team drive our digital agenda by unlocking analytics capabilities, processes and helping to mold the usage and adoption of next generation applications and technologies Collaborate with various stakeholders to drive value through tangible assignments (vary depending on business need) with visibility to senior leadership within the organization Build capability in sought after skills including but not limited to data storytelling, analysis, process optimization, senior leader communication, project ownership and stakeholder alignment Participate in various training and skill building events as part of the MFLE program Join a diverse community of early-talent finance professionals to help guide you through your transition into the first phase of your career 

What are we looking for?

Students pursuing a bachelor’s degree program in finance, economics, accounting, or related field, with a graduation conferral date between December 2026 and June 2027 We are looking for agile candidates who have a drive for results, a desire to learn, and who can quickly build relationships and collaborate effectively We are looking for students who are passionate about the consumer products industry and want to build a long-term career in finance and related fields Willingness to relocate to the site of the role (New York City, NY, Los Angeles, CA, Chicago IL, Franklin, TN and others) and who are willing to relocate during the course of the program to other Mars locations (relocation support is provided each time associates are required to move as part of this program) Open to students legally authorized to work in the U.S., without the need for current or future work sponsorship Employment is contingent upon successful completion of drug & background screening 

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with over 170,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Mars Five Principles. Join a community cohort of current and former MFLEs who are also early in their career to support and learn from each other Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. Exciting professional and social engagement activities throughout the experience that provide opportunities to network with your MFLE peers all the way up to senior leaders. Ongoing coaching and mentorship to help you succeed and get the most out of your experience. Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. Some of the perks you will receive are an industry competitive salary & benefits packages, fun freebies, and pet-friendly offices. To learn more about our brands, please click here. 

About Mars, Incorporated

For more than a century, Mars, Incorporated has been driven by the belief that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today. This idea is at the center of who we have always been as a global, family-owned business. Today, Mars is transforming, innovating, and evolving in ways that affirm our commitment to making a positive impact on the world around us.

Across our diverse and expanding portfolio of Snacking, Food, and Petcare products and services, we employ over 140,000 dedicated Associates who are all moving in the same direction: forward. As a $65 billion family-owned business, we produce some of the world’s best-loved brands including ROYAL CANIN®, PEDIGREE®, WHISKAS®, CESAR®, M&M’S®, SNICKERS®, Pringles®, Cheez-It®, and BEN’S ORIGINAL™. and take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses, including AniCura, Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, and VCA™.

We know we can only be truly successful if our partners and the communities in which we operate prosper as well. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our Associates to take action every day to help create a world tomorrow in which the planet, its people and pets can thrive. The Mars Compass, inspired by the Economics of Mutuality, is used to measure the company’s progress in service of its purpose; The world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today.

For more information about Mars, please visit mars.com. Join us on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

Build and influence stakeholder relationships.

Customer relationship management experience. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and syndicated data tools.Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills. Organized, adaptable and self-motivated.

Consumer Insights; Shopper Insights; Customer Insights; Category Analysis, Collaboration and partnership skills; Influencing, Consultative Selling, Customer strategy; Channel strategy, Sales strategy development, Perform product plannnig, Business accumen; financial accumen, commercial accumen, Sales negotiation, P&L Management, Strategy Execution, Operational Excellence, Key Account Management, Account Management, Field sales; Field sales management, Ecommerce, Analysing sales and Ecommerce data, Pharmaceutical Sales, Trade Marketing, Digital activation to HCPs, Leadership skills.

What we offer

Job Description:

The Mars Finance Leadership Experience (MFLE) is a full-time, 3-year rotational program designed to support university graduates development in the early years of their Finance career. Associates will rotate through 3 different business areas in Finance across Mars locations – inclusive of Mars Snacking, Mars Petcare, Royal Canin, Internal Audit, Corporate Finance, Mars Global Services, and more!

Throughout your first 3 years with Mars, our goal is that you form a strong foundation across multiple types of finance roles to become a strong finance leader within the broader organization.

Your location will be based on the roles we have available in those cities at the time of your offer, but your preferences will be taken into account. Locations could include Chicago, IL, Franklin, TN, Creve Coeur, MO, New York City, NY, Los Angeles, CA, and more! Work with over 170,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Mars Five Principles. For more than a century, Mars, Incorporated has been driven by the belief that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today. Today, Mars is transforming, innovating, and evolving in ways that affirm our commitment to making a positive impact on the world around us.

Across our diverse and expanding portfolio of Snacking, Food, and Petcare products and services, we employ over 140,000 dedicated Associates who are all moving in the same direction: forward. As a $65 billion family-owned business, we produce some of the world’s best-loved brands including ROYAL CANIN®, PEDIGREE®, WHISKAS®, CESAR®, M&M’S®, SNICKERS®, Pringles®, Cheez-It®, and BEN’S ORIGINAL™. and take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses, including AniCura, Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, and VCA™.

We know we can only be truly successful if our partners and the communities in which we operate prosper as well. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our Associates to take action every day to help create a world tomorrow in which the planet, its people and pets can thrive. The Mars Compass, inspired by the Economics of Mutuality, is used to measure the company’s progress in service of its purpose; The world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today.

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Data Analyst to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food crafter with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. From our humble beginnings, founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry.

Our purpose, To Earn Pet Lover Trust Every Day so Pets Thrive for a Lifetime, provides the foundation for our highest aspirations as a company. Being a partner to the communities that surround us – and the environment that sustains us – are top priorities.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here’s The Scoop - Summary

We are looking for a data-driven, detail-oriented Data Analyst, preferably within the pet food or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry.

In this role, you will support end-to-end supply chain operations by providing actionable insights across multiple functions and serve as the centralized resource for supply chain data and KPI governance.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, cross-functional environment and is passionate about using data to enhance operational efficiency and support Champion Petfoods’ commitment to delivering high-quality nutrition to pets worldwide.

The Supply Chain Analyst works out of our Corporate office in Edmonton (AB) or Nashville (TN) and works a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-person.

Key Responsibilities:

Analyze data across supply chain to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvements Identify supply chain performance gaps through data analysis, proactively engage with relevant stakeholders to understand root causes, and lead cross-functional efforts to develop and implement innovative solutions. Develop and maintain real-time dashboards, data objects, and reports that track key supply chain metrics Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align analytics outputs with business needs Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels, enabling data-driven decision-making. Assist in the deployment and continuous improvement of supply chain analytics tools and technologies

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Experience in supply chain analytics or data analysis, preferably within the food or pet food industry. Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Python. Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. Experience with data visualization platforms (preferably Power BI). Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across teams. Experience with advanced analytics techniques such as machine learning or predictive modeling preferred. Experience in Generative AI development preferred. Familiarity with Databricks preferred. Understanding of E2E supply chain processes preferred. 

What can you expect from Champion?

Come as you are.
