rows.title: Fundamental Credit Research Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Join Barclays as Fundamental Credit Research Analyst, where you will work closely with the senior analyst covering the investment grade Technology, Media, and Cable/Telecom sectors ("TMT"). The multi-sector nature, coupled with the speed at which AI is impacting the industries and credit markets, makes this a very dynamic role. You will support all aspects of research coverage including following and tracking industry developments and data, modelling companies, and publishing actionable, trade-oriented research.

To be successful as a Fundamental Credit Research Analyst, you should have:


Experience supporting research responsibilities including financial modeling, qualitative analysis, and writingExperience leveraging AI tools appropriately to drive efficiency and insightsKnowledge of current events and how they affect financial markets in your assigned sector


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Proficiency in ExcelPrior experience building and maintaining financial modelsPrior experience with trade-oriented research reports


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in New York, NY.

This role is regulated by FINRA.

Minimum Salary: $110,000

Maximum Salary: $125,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Purpose of the role

To produce and deliver Research with differentiated market insights and actionable ideas to Barclays Clients.

Accountabilities


Analysis of market, sector, corporate and/or economic data to help develop investment theses for your coverage universe to produce best in class Research.Research may range from individual company or sector notes, through to long dated thematic reports.Presentation of Research views to Barclays Clients; this can be through direct, face to face and virtual interactions, Research hosted events and written communications.Engagement with Markets, Client Strategy and other stakeholders, to raise awareness of your Research both to Clients and internally. Prioritise interaction with the most relevant and valuable Clients for your Research.Provision of insights and Research views to internal Clients to help them navigate financial markets and risks.Collaboration with the Supervisory Analyst, Compliance and other stakeholders to ensure Research is produced and delivered to Clients and internal stakeholders in a compliant manner.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Our mission is to protect, defend, and secure the company's products, infrastructure, and data by building highly available, scalable, and extensible security solutions and services. We are seeking a Staff Security Engineer, Vulnerability Management to lead the evolution of our Vulnerability Management Platform. In this role, you will architect the next generation of our Risk-Based Vulnerability Management (RBVM) systems, transforming how we identify, prioritize, and remediate exposure across a massive digital footprint.

You will drive technical excellence across our vulnerability management landscape, from on-prem, cloud, container security to corporate endpoint hygiene. As a Staff Engineer, you will be a technical visionary and mentor, leading the transition toward Continuous Threat Exposure Management and AI-driven remediation workflows that operate at enterprise scale.

What You Will Do

 RBVM Platform Architecture: Design and scale Security Posture Management tools and platforms to provide a unified, risk-scored view of vulnerabilities across on-prem, cloud, containers, VMs, and endpoints.  Automation & Orchestration: Build automated remediation workflows and systems that will reduce median response times for emerging threats and scale across decentralized teams.  Technical Strategy: Lead "Shift-Left" initiatives by integrating vulnerability scanning into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure provisioning to enforce security policies consistently across all asset types, including cloud resources, endpoints, and applications.  AI/ML Innovation: Leverage LLMs and AI agents for automated triage, impact analysis, and generating context-aware remediation instructions for service owners across the infrastructure.  Vulnerability Governance: Partner with Compliance and IT to mature vulnerability standards, SLAs, and risk exception processes across the global digital estate.  Vulnerability Analysis: Provide deep security subject matter expertise to analyze complex vulnerabilities, assess true risk, and drive informed decisions on remediation verdicts, false positives, and risk acceptance.  Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with IT, product, and operations teams to integrate security posture improvements across the entire environment. 

Basic Qualifications

 7+ years of industry experience in software development, with a focus on large-scale security or infrastructure engineering.  Expertise in building distributed systems and high-availability security platforms using Golang, Java, or Python.  Proven track record of designing and operating vulnerability management tools at scale.  Deep understanding of container security, cloud-native infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines.  Experience leading cross-functional security initiatives and mentoring senior engineering staff. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Hands-on experience developing Risk-Based Vulnerability Management (RBVM) frameworks and automated prioritization logic.  Knowledge of AI/ML applications in security, specifically for vulnerability triage or large-scale data analysis.  Experience with External Attack Surface Management (EASM) and tracking internet-facing asset exposure.  Familiarity with Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS), including SBOM and internal package registries.

rows.title: US&C Enablement Lead
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

Uber's Commercial Sales Enablement team supports our multi-billion dollar Delivery business, including Uber Eats, Grocery & Retail, and Direct lines of business. We equip our sales teams with the capabilities, tools, insights, and processes needed to increase seller and account manager productivity, accelerate growth, and improve merchant outcomes. As the US&C Enablement Lead, you will own the enablement strategy and execution for one of Uber's largest and most dynamic commercial regions, serving as a strategic partner to Sales, Operations, Product, and global Enablement leaders.

In this role, you will translate global priorities and major product, policy, and technology changes into locally relevant programs while identifying and addressing the unique capability and performance needs of US&C sellers and managers. From accelerating new-hire productivity and strengthening sales and manager capabilities to enabling critical GTM launches and driving adoption of seller technology and AI, you will lead a portfolio of work designed to change seller behavior and improve commercial performance.

This role requires someone who can move seamlessly between strategy and execution, influence senior stakeholders, use data to prioritize where Enablement can have the greatest impact, and lead a team that helps US&C commercial teams perform at their best.

What You'll Do

 Lead the US&C Revenue Enablement strategy and roadmap, translating commercial priorities, performance data, seller needs, and global initiatives into a focused portfolio of programs that improve seller productivity, capability, and business outcomes.  Partner with senior leaders across Sales, Operations, Product, Marketing, Sales Operations, and Global Enablement to diagnose performance opportunities, establish priorities, define success measures, and align stakeholders on enablement plans and trade-offs.  Drive readiness and adoption for complex product, policy, process, seller technology, and AI transformations, using Uber's GTM intake and tiering processes to coordinate stakeholder alignment, communications, training, manager reinforcement, launch execution, and post-launch adoption.  Build scalable capability programs across the seller lifecycle-including Fast Start onboarding, sales academies, negotiation and solution-selling programs, and frontline manager development-connecting learning to observable seller behaviors and commercial performance.  Leverage platforms and data including Seismic, Salesforce, Tableau, conversational intelligence, and emerging AI tools to personalize enablement, improve content discovery, identify performance gaps, measure adoption, and increase seller and manager productivity.  Measure enablement effectiveness with a disciplined measurement framework spanning learner readiness, behavior and tool adoption, seller productivity, and business outcomes; maintain accurate reporting and communicate progress, risks, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.  Lead and develop the US&C Enablement team, setting clear priorities and operating rhythms, allocating capacity across strategic initiatives, GTM launches, and emerging regional needs, and maintaining a high bar for execution quality, stakeholder partnership, and measurable impact.  Influence the broader commercial organization through clear, concise executive communication, translating complex initiatives and performance signals into actionable recommendations while proactively surfacing dependencies, competing priorities, and risks to successful execution. 

Basic qualifications 

 A minimum of 8 years of professional experience in Revenue/Sales Enablement, Sales Excellence, Learning & Development, Commercial Operations, Sales Operations, or a related field, including experience supporting a complex sales or go-to-market organization.  A minimum of 3 years of experience leading teams, major programs, or cross-functional workstreams with accountability for strategy, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and execution.  Demonstrated experience partnering with senior Sales, Operations, Product, Marketing, and/or Sales Operations leaders to translate business priorities and performance gaps into scalable enablement solutions.  Experience leading complex go-to-market or organizational change initiatives, including product, process, policy, sales methodology, technology, or AI/tool adoption, with responsibility for communications, readiness, execution, reinforcement, and measurement.  Experience using sales and enablement technology such as Salesforce and Seismic, or comparable CRM, LMS/content management, analytics, and seller productivity platforms, to manage programs, drive adoption, and evaluate impact.  Demonstrated ability to use quantitative and qualitative data to identify performance gaps, prioritize investments, maintain accurate reporting, and measure outcomes such as seller productivity, ramp time, adoption, conversion, or revenue performance.  Demonstrated experience applying AI and automation to design, deliver, and scale enablement programs, including using AI-powered tools to improve learning, content, workflows, personalization, or seller productivity.  Professional working proficiency in English, with demonstrated ability to communicate complex strategies, performance insights, risks, and recommendations clearly and accurately to both executive and frontline audiences.  Must be able to work from the designated US&C Uber office/hub according to Uber's applicable hybrid work schedule and travel within the US&C region as required to support commercial leaders, teams, and key enablement programs.  Willingness to travel within US&C as needed (up to 20%). 

Preferred qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in Business, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, Communications, or a related field preferred; MBA or other relevant advanced degree is a plus.  Strong proficiency with data and analytics, including the ability to interpret commercial performance data, diagnose productivity and capability gaps, establish success metrics, and translate insights into clear recommendations for senior leaders. As a Senior Systems Engineer in our Autonomous Mobility & Delivery (AM&D) group, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of autonomous transportation at Uber.

You will be responsible for the safety of the technical frameworks that allow Uber to integrate seamlessly with various autonomous vehicle (AV) partners while developing our own internal autonomous offerings. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge robotics, safety-critical systems, and complex platform integration. This role is on Uber's Autonomous Mobility and Delivery Safety team and reports to the Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Autonomous Mobility & Delivery.

What You Will Need / Bonus Points

---- What You Will Do ----

Define partner-agnostic solutions: Develop and standardize technical safety solutions and frameworks that expedite the go-to-market process for diverse autonomous vehicle tech providers and AV fleet operators on the Uber platform. Define safety requirements for Uber-built autonomous offerings: Lead the elicitation and documentation of high-level and detailed system safety requirements for Uber's proprietary autonomous technology and platform services. Develop V&V strategies: Design comprehensive Verification and Validation (V&V) strategies for both internal Uber solutions and the complex technical interactions between Uber's platform and external AV Partner systems to ensure solutions meet Uber's safety bar. Safety Risk Assessment: Lead technical safety risk assessments to ensure that all AV partner integrations meet Uber's rigorous safety and performance standards. Influence Strategic Decisions: Act as a technical subject matter expert to influence long-term product roadmaps and strategic partnerships, ensuring technical feasibility and safety are at the forefront of business decisions. 

Apply AI responsibly: Evaluate and integrate AI/ML-driven approaches to enhance safety validation and risk identification, while ensuring appropriate oversight, traceability, and compliance with safety standards.

 Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 7+ years of experience in systems engineering, with a significant focus on complex hardware/software integrations. Proven track record in the Autonomous Vehicle industry, specifically within safety-critical systems. Experience with V&V methodologies (e.g., ISO 26262, SOTIF/ISO 21448).

rows.title: Director, Corporate Strategy
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be on the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive work environment, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be with.

With more than 130 million active users across 190 countries and over 1 billion active product listings, eBay is the world’s most vibrant and dynamic online marketplace. Founded in 1995, eBay Inc. connects people around the world, enabling them to buy and sell online. eBay Inc. does this by providing the Internet platforms of choice for global commerce, payments and communications. eBay Inc. is headquartered in San Jose, California. For more information about the company and its global portfolio of online brands, visit www.ebayinc.com

About The Team

We are responsible for setting the strategic direction of eBay: our ambition, where we play, and how we win in the market. The team is responsible for deeply understanding the needs of our core buyers and sellers and crafting the strategies that will differentiate eBay relative to our competitors. We work very closely with product, technology, and regional business teams to ensure the strategy is translated into action across the end-to-end customer experience. Our work can be divided into 3 main topics: we develop eBay Inc’s strategy together with eBay’s executives, we run strategic projects to solve key strategic issues supporting select executives at eBay, we closely monitor the competitive environment & trends.

The opportunity

The Director, Corporate Strategy is a senior leader who will lead several cross-functional projects consisting of 2-6 Strategy Associates, Managers, and Senior Managers. You will bring both process and content leadership to strategy projects and act as the point person between Strategy and cross-functional business teams. Within this role, you will have the ability to influence key elements of eBay’s strategy and to help shape the strategic direction of eBay. The ideal candidate has a track record of making pragmatic, concrete recommendations with real world implementation experience. It is critical for the role that the candidate has strong analytic skills and is excellent in developing creative/ out-of-the-box and well-thought-out solutions for challenging business problems.

Role Responsibilities

Strategy Development: Develop the strategies for eBay to differentiate itself in the market. This will include crafting the strategies, developing the key initiatives to support the strategies and working closely with key eBay constituencies to gain consensus.Project leadership: Independently, lead cross-functional projects involving executive and senior partners from various part of the organization.Thought leadership: Develop content and topic expertise, as well as perspectives on issues important to eBay’s strategy. Structure problems. Develop creative solutions to challenging business problemsStrategy Mobilization: Work with the eBay line organization as needed to support mobilization and implementation of the business strategies.Market and Competitive Analysis: Develop insightful market intelligence about key industry trends (technology, competitors, consumers, regulatory, etc.) and advise the organization of their strategic implications.Business Analytics: Drive business judgment, market understanding, problem solving, and fact-based analysis to identify, prioritize, structure, and solve challenging business problems.Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of critical initiativesCommunication: Develop storylines for presentations, prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadershipLeading through uncertainty: Self-direct as well as manage resources on the strategy team and across the organization to deliver superior end-products in a dynamic industry and corporate environment


Job Requirements

Intellectual curiosityExcellence in structured thinking, developing sensible, creative solutions to challenging strategic business problems. Creativity and “out of the box” thinking that drives innovation. The ability to “see around corners” and “connect the dots” that enable business to proactively drive businessStrong executive presence and ability to communicate strategy clearly and simply. Ease with executive-level interactions. Ability to create clear and simple storylines.Proven track record to lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of key initiatives. Ability to lead, empower and mentor project team membersComfort in reaching out and prioritizing cross-functional collaboration in a highly matrixed environmentOutstanding analytical capabilities (quantitative and qualitative), ability to generate key insightsComfort in handling uncertaintyHighly collaborative – be fun, and easy to work with!


Qualifications

Proven leader with at least 10 years of work experience - at least 2-3 years at a top strategy consulting firm at project management level are a mustBachelors Degree required, MBA or equivalent preferredExpertise in technology, ideally in e-commerce, retail, payments, and/or consumer facing products is highly desirable


Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/company/diversity-inclusion/

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$205,600 - $274,500

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Please see the Talent Privacy Notice for information regarding how eBay handles your personal data collected when you use the eBay Careers website or apply for a job with eBay.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story. 

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work. 

Job Overview

The Associate, Merchandise Planning Business Office will contribute to the development and execution of best-in-class merchandise planning strategies. They will help drive innovation, optimize processes, connect cross functional teams and ensure alignment with company objectives, setting the standard for excellence in merchandise planning across the organization.

What You Will Do

Support the development and implementation of strategic merchandise planning initiatives that elevate the organization's capabilities and drive competitive advantage.Provide independent and strategic financial Division-level target recommendations to drive business outcomes: drive cross-functional alignment of business strategies to plans.Recap and review Vendor performance: analyze financial metrics and suggest business driving strategies in collaboration with Merchants. Share findings with VP, SVP and C-Suite audience.Prepare In-Season ROF Forecast, Pre-Season Plan, Weekly Business Review, and Long Range Vision strategic analysis and presentation materials for VP, SVP, C-Suite audience.Drive continuous improvement and innovation in merchandise planning processes, leveraging advanced analytics, technology, and industry trends to enhance efficiency, effectiveness and consistency.Review, refine and simplify reporting used by the team, partnering with Planning Operations and Technology colleagues.Analyze historical sales data, current trends, and market information to forecast future sales and demand. Generate and maintain regular reports on sales performance, inventory metrics, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress against targets. Support ad-hoc analysis and projects as needed.Meet deadlines while working independently and collaboratively within a team environment.Maintain regular, dependable attendance and punctuality.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities. In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Financial Business Acumen: Ability to understand and analyze financial aspects to make informed strategic decisions.

Independence and Adaptability: Capability to work independently with minimal supervision and adapt to a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

Demand Forecasting and Optimization: Proficiency in demand forecasting and inventory optimization techniques.

Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills, including trend and pattern recognition, and the ability to solve problems efficiently.

Strategic Planning: Proficiency in effectively planning and executing strategies to achieve objectives.

Issue Recognition and Resolution: Capability to recognize issues and address them directly, ensuring smooth operations.

Hold and Flow Optimization: Experience in optimizing and executing hold and flow strategies for inventory management.

Change Management: Comfort and effectiveness in leading teams through change ensuring successful adaptation.

Visionary Thinking: Ability to be a forward thinking and innovative leader with a vision to drive transformative strategies propelling family of business to new heights.

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock - from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes.

The Content Acquisition (CA) team is an integral part of the Data department. We are responsible for managing, acquiring, and integrating content and data from exchanges, brokers, sell-side, buy-side, and other types of providers to drive the value of the Bloomberg Terminal and downstream enterprise products. We lead the governance, cost, and quality of the data we acquire, and we collaborate with the wider company to develop our data acquisition strategies ensuring we are aligning with the agendas of our key partners.

The Role

As a Senior Data Management Professional with the Exchanges & Venues team, you will define and implement data-driven strategies to acquire new content sets and maximize the value of our existing datasets, ensuring they are high quality, commercially impactful, and aligned with evolving client needs. Using your deep knowledge of Futures & Options markets, you will design and manage initiatives that expand and enhance our product offering, identify gaps, and address emerging use cases. You will collaborate closely with internal partners and senior leaders to drive customer-centric outcomes, proactively manage content investments, and mobilize cross-functional teams to support growth initiatives. Instinctively curious and strategically minded, you will build strong internal networks, communicate clear and coordinated updates, and translate vision into measurable results across regions in a fast-moving, complex market environment.

We’ll Trust You To

 Set and prioritize data-driven strategies and targets to discover and acquire new datasets and track progress in achieving these goals Build relationships with key internal partners and decision-makers, to understand and align closely with their priorities Ensure existing datasets are fit-for-purpose, accessible and usable in order to increase the return on our investment in onboarding the content Lead and implement Data Quality projects based on evolving business prioritization and commercial landscapes Lead campaigns across Exchange & Venues to mobilize the wider team of Relationship Managers and Technical Account Managers Identify and close gaps in existing product offerings and expand to account for emerging client use cases Act as an ambassador for the Futures & Options content that drives our product, and as a representative for the Content Acquisition team throughout the company

You’ll Need To Have

 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, STEM or degree-equivalent qualifications 4+ years of experience in financial markets and deep understanding of Futures & Options markets including market structure, the latest market trends and the competitive landscape Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills across complex functions, geographies, and seniority levels Proven ability to translate vision into measurable outcomes and actionable goals for regional teams Demonstrated ability to drive cross-regional execution, alignment, and strategic communication Strategic approach with a bias for action, comfortable making decisions with imperfect information in fast-moving markets; Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Does this sound like you?

Apply if you think we're a good match! We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are.

Description & Requirements

We are Bloomberg Enterprise Data - fast paced, innovative, and growing. We partner closely with our clients to understand their businesses, data requirements, and financial technology needs. Our broad range of datasets, delivery channels, APIs, and cloud-enabled solutions enables clients to access the data they need, when they need it, and in the format that best supports their workflows.

Corporations are a strategic growth segment for Enterprise Data. Corporate treasury, capital markets, investor relations, and finance teams increasingly rely on high-quality market and reference data to manage funding, hedging, benchmarking, and reporting.

We are seeking a Product Manager to grow Bloomberg’s Enterprise Data business within the corporations segment. Unlike asset-class roles, this position is defined by its target client: you will develop deep understanding of corporate workflows and build data products that serve corporate treasurers, capital markets and investor relations teams, and finance functions.

We’ll Trust You To

 Define the segment strategy and product roadmap for corporations, identifying the data products and use cases with the greatest commercial potential. Develop deep understanding of corporate workflows — treasury and cash management, funding and debt issuance, FX and rates hedging, peer and credit benchmarking, investor relations, and regulatory and ESG reporting. Map corporate data needs to Bloomberg’s data estate across pricing, reference, credit, and ESG, and define solutions that fit corporate delivery and consumption models. Partner with corporate clients to understand their challenges and validate product direction. Work with Sales and Marketing to build segment awareness, drive adoption, and attain commercial outcomes. Manage product specification, prioritisation, and backlog through an agile process across Data, Engineering, and Client Solutions.

You’ll Need to Have

 5+* years in product management, or equivalent, within financial data, analytics, banking, or corporate finance. Understanding of corporate workflows across at least two of: treasury, capital markets and funding, investor relations, and corporate finance. Understanding of how corporates source, evaluate, and consume market and reference data. Experience delivering product outcomes through an agile process with cross-functional stakeholders. Working knowledge of AI, automation, and agentic approaches applied to data products. Excellent communication skills with senior stakeholders. Ability to travel as needed.

We’d Love to See

 Experience in corporate treasury, banking coverage of corporates, investor relations or advisory, or selling data into corporate clients. Proficiency with Python, SQL, or other data science tools. Understanding of corporate credit, funding markets, or regulatory reporting requirements. Experience with cloud-based data delivery or modern enterprise data platforms.

Salary Range = 140,000 - 295,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson is currently seeking an Associate Director, Data Science for their Compliance team. This is a hybrid role based in New Brunswick, Titusville and Horsham.

Position Summary

JJRC Strategy & Execution is a global strategic leadership position responsible for providing advanced data analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence enablement, and project management support to the J&J Regulatory Compliance organization and its stakeholders.

Working closely with senior leaders across Enterprise and Sector Compliance, this role will leverage analytical platforms such as Alteryx and Tableau while embedding artificial intelligence into reporting, analytics, and decision-support workflows. The role will identify, design, and implement responsible AI capabilities—including intelligent agents that can automate recurring data preparation, monitor reporting processes, surface emerging trends, and generate timely insights—to strengthen risk management, accelerate reporting, and enable continuous business improvement.

In addition, the role will apply strong project and change management skills to lead and support strategic, global enterprise-wide initiatives involving all levels of management. May perform other duties as assigned.

Required

Strong Alteryx workflow experience and broad experience with computerized systems, data analytics, reporting tools, and AI-enabled technologies.Undergraduate degree in data science, computer science, artificial intelligence or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.Experience creating visuals in Tableau and using other data analytics and reporting tools.

Preferred

Demonstrated experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent agents to reporting, analytics, workflow automation, risk identification, or decision-support use cases.Knowledge of responsible AI principles and governance practices, including data quality and lineage, privacy, security, validation, transparency, auditability, monitoring, and human oversight.Experience evaluating, testing, implementing, and monitoring AI-enabled solutions across the solution lifecycle, including assessment of accuracy, reliability, risk, and business value.Minimum of 3 years of healthcare industry experience. Job Description

About MedTech

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Technology and Digital Quality Internship

We are seeking highly motivated and meticulous Sophomores, Juniors and rising Seniors for the 2027 Summer Internship within the Technology and Digital Quality organization. We work on a “hybrid model”. This means that you will be asked to report on site three (3) times a week and can work remotely two (2) times a week. If you are selected for an intern position, you will work directly with your manager as your start date approaches to confirm your exact schedule.

This Position Offers a Valuable Opportunity For Hands-on Experience In Analyzing Business Processes And Data, Supporting Decision-making Processes, Analyzing Business Challenges, Formulating Recommendations For Improvement, And Contributing To Data-driven Strategies Across Various T&DQ Functions. The Ideal Candidate Will Assist In Gathering, Analyzing, And Interpreting Data To Help Our Organization Make Informed Decisions. Below Are a Few Examples Of The Types Of Experiences You Can Expect

Digital Product Analysis: Understand and analyze end-to-end business processes and translate needs into digital solutions by building product backlogs in the form of user stories. Data Ingestion and Engineering: Assist in collecting, cleaning, and preparing datasets for analysis from various sources such as databases, APIs, and spreadsheets. Data Analysis and Reporting: Perform statistical analysis and data mining to identify patterns, correlations, and insights into business data. Develop visualizations and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Excel to communicate data findings to key stakeholders. AI and Automation: Create automated workflows for data extraction, transformation, and reporting using Python, R, or SQL. Contribute to the adoption of AI and digital technologies by supporting validation activities that enable innovative solutions while maintaining regulatory and compliance standards.Support Decision-Making: Assist in analyzing data to support business decisions and pivotal initiatives and partnering to put together recommendations for leadership.Collaboration: Work closely with various departments, including QA-Ops, JJRC, finance and operations to understand their data needs and provide actionable insights.Continuous Process Improvement: Document methodologies, processes, and results to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing within the team. 

Not only will you develop your analytical skills through on-the-job assignments. You will:

Improve your industry knowledge through open forum conversations with senior company leaders and shadowing of T&DQ personnel. Work in a fast-paced, technologically sophisticated corporate environment in an Internship program focused on developing individual analysts capable of pursuing careers across pharmaceutical and medical device businesses. Build or improve your personal brand through skills building workshops and networking mixers. Present your learnings and development experience to leadership. Have the power to connect with and support our local towns through community activities. 

To be considered for the T&DQ 2027 Summer Internship program, you must meet the following requirements:

Permanent US work authorization without the need for sponsorship now, or in the future (F1, H1B, CPT, OPT or STEM OPT require sponsorship in future). Enrollment (not necessarily taking classes) in an accredited college/university during the Internship. By start date, student must be considered an undergraduate sophomore or above. Master’s students must have earned undergraduate degree on or after June 2027. Have a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher, which is reflective of all college coursework. Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in science, communications, regulatory compliance, quality, finance, data science, computer science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering, supply chain, or technology related field. Ability to clearly present data findings and interpretations to both technical and non-technical partners. Ability to break down challenging problems into manageable components and derive actionable insights. Understanding statistical concepts such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and data distribution. Ability to work through challenges logically and deliver solutions efficiently. Ability to provide their own transportation to this location and to/from work every day. Ability to work full-time (40 hours a week) for the whole term.

Preferred Qualifications

Proven leadership and/or participation in campus/community service activities.Previous internship, Co-Op, or academic experience in a related field.Basic proficiency in data analysis tools Python, R, or SQL, and visualization tools Tableau, Power BI, or Excel.Familiarity with Cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.Basic proficiency in IA tools, such as Power PlatformFamiliarity with machine learning algorithms and AI platforms/LLMs and tools.Exposure to Agile, Scrum, or other project delivery methodologies.Six Sigma Green Belt certification

The expected pay range for this position is between $23.50 per hour and $52.50 per hour but will be based on candidate's program year, discipline, degree and/or experience. Co-Ops/Interns are eligible to participate in Company sponsored employee medical benefits in accordance with the terms of the plan. Co-Ops and Interns are eligible for the following sick time benefits: up to 40 hours per calendar year; for employees who reside in the State of Washington, up to 56 hours per calendar year. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You will collaborate with clients and interdisciplinary teams to develop impactful analytics solutions, optimize code, and solve real-world business problems across diverse industries.

You’ll grow as a technologist by contributing to cutting-edge projects, R&D, and global conferences while working alongside world-class talent in a dynamic, innovative environment.

Your work will create real-world impact. rows.title: Commerce Strategy Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Position Summary

Across industries, commerce has become one of the most important channels for growth, customer engagement, and margin performance - not simply a transactional endpoint, but a strategic lever that shapes how customers experience a brand and how a business competes. Where organizations are rethinking the role commerce should play in their broader channel mix and how they acquire, convert, and retain customers as a result, they look to Deloitte's Commerce practice.

Our team helps clients define the role of commerce as a channel within their broader growth strategy, build the value narrative and business case for where to invest, and shape the experiences, capabilities, and operating model needed to deliver on that strategy. We bring together strategic rigor, design depth, commercial judgment, and implementation expertise to help clients translate ambition into measurable business outcomes.

The Commerce Strategy Manager is a client-facing consulting leader responsible for shaping commerce strategy engagements across industries, bringing a strategic, value-oriented lens to how clients position commerce as a critical growth channel. This role combines commerce strategy expertise and consulting execution with the judgment to connect commerce decisions to the broader commercial strategy - including customer experience, pricing, and growth strategy - helping clients prioritize the highest-value commerce use cases and carry a clear value narrative through to implementation.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 30, 2026

 Work You'll Do 

Commerce organizations are operating in a fast-changing environment shaped by shifting consumer behavior, channel fragmentation, rising customer expectations, and pressure to deliver profitable growth. Many companies are investing in commerce, but too few have a clear strategy for the role commerce should play as a channel - where to play, how to win, how commerce decisions should shape pricing, customer experience, and growth strategy, and how to prioritize the use cases that matter most.

We are looking for practitioners who can work alongside client leadership teams to define the strategic role of commerce as a channel, build the value narrative and business case for where to invest, prioritize commerce use cases, and drive the implications of that positioning across pricing, customer experience, and growth strategy - creating measurable impact that carries through into how commerce gets implemented.

As a Commerce Strategy Manager, you will be responsible for:

 Leading the day-to-day delivery of commerce strategy engagements across industries, including defining commerce's role as a growth channel, channel strategy and role definition, commerce operating model design, and experience optimization - bringing a strategic, value-oriented lens into how these strategies carry through implementation  Partnering with client business, digital, technology, and operations leaders to define commerce strategies tied to clear business outcomes  Translating business challenges into structured analyses, recommendations, and executive-ready deliverables grounded in data, customer insight, and commercial logic  Shaping commerce strategy roadmaps that span channel positioning, experience design, capability priorities, and organizational change, grounded in a clear value narrative and business case for where to invest  Driving the implications of commerce strategy and channel positioning into other parts of the commercial strategy agenda - including customer experience, pricing, and growth strategy - and helping clients prioritize commerce use cases based on business value and strategic fit  Partnering with global technical and implementation delivery teams to ensure the strategic intent and value case behind commerce decisions carry through into execution, without owning day-to-day technical delivery  Managing day-to-day client relationships, facilitating working sessions, and overseeing scope, timelines, risks, and dependencies across workstreams  Using advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, insight generation, and work quality  Supporting practice growth through proposals, solution shaping, workplans, and follow-on opportunities  Coaching teams, modeling Deloitte leadership behaviors, and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing culture 

A successful candidate should possess these skills:

 Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments; managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements; and leading projects or workstreams.  Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and written and oral communication skills  Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and translate business needs into analytical or technology-enabled solutions.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team while building and sustaining professional relationships.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work products, while managing and prioritizing multiple tasks and meeting deadlines.  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor, with the ability to mentor others and provide clear guidance. 

Required

 Qualifications 

 7+ years of experience with a demonstrated history of consulting delivery in commerce strategy, digital commerce, customer experience, technology-enabled transformation, or related areas  5+ years of experience working directly with business, digital, technology, or commerce client teams  5+ years of experience shaping commerce strategies and translating them into actionable roadmaps, operating models, or implementation plans  1+ years of experience incorporating AI into daily workflow and leveraging AI tools to enable and optimize the client experience  Ability to travel up to 30%+ on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve  Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

 4+ years working knowledge of digital commerce platforms and capabilities sufficient to inform strategy and prioritization decisions, without owning hands-on implementation  4+ years of experience leading workstreams or projects, including managing scope, timelines, deliverables, and client communication  Experience connecting commerce strategy to adjacent areas of commercial strategy, such as customer experience, pricing, or growth strategy, and translating that connection into prioritized recommendations  Experience presenting recommendations and deliverables to executive stakeholders  Experience supporting proposals, solution shaping, or workplan development  Experience growing and developing teams, especially practitioners with 0-2 years of experience 

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 - $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with clients through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and client value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Recruiting for this role ends on January 5, 2027

Work you'll do

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for helping clients define, prioritize, and deliver customer-centric digital products. The ideal candidate brings experience leading digital product initiatives across strategy, experience design, and technology teams. You will:

Translate product strategy into prioritized roadmaps, release plans, and actionable product requirementsLead collaboration across engineering, user experience, analytics, and business stakeholders to support product deliveryGuide the development of digital products across platforms, including web, iOS, and AndroidSupport product planning activities, including backlog management, feature prioritization, and decision-making aligned to customer and business needsDevelop materials for executive and working-team audiences, including product strategy presentations, status updates, and recommendations

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanorAbility to meet deadlinesAbility to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

Qualifications

Required:

6+ years of experience in digital product strategy, digital product management, or digital product development4+ years of experience translating product strategy into prioritized product roadmaps and converting business requirements into user stories and acceptance criteria3+ years of experience delivering digital products across web, iOS, and Android platforms3+ years of experience leading distributed, cross-functional product development teams and working with user experience teams on wireframes, visual designs, or prototypes4+ years of experience using JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft ExcelBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or another technical disciplineAbility to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Master of Business Administration (MBA) or master's degree in Digital Strategy, Product Management, or Technology LeadershipExperience with Adobe, Salesforce Marketing, or SAP platformsProduct or agile certification such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or SAFe

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 - $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

rows.title: Pricing Strategy Manager, Celerity
rows.descriptionText:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
 WHO YOU’LL WORK WITHCelerity is a fast-growing start-up that is a part of Bain and Company and is focused on delivering high-impact pricing projects. Celerity is seeking to recruit a client delivery Pricing Consultant who will work closely with Celerity leadership and our Pricing Center of Excellence to execute pricing projects across industries and client contexts. You will be responsible for conducting rigorous pricing analyses, building models and insights from complex datasets, and translating those insights into clear recommendations that improve client revenue performance. 
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM The Lead will drive complex pricing analyses and manages significant analytical workstreams for client engagements. Translate technical findings into actionable business recommendations, coordinates project activities across team members, and serves as a trusted technical resource while coaching and developing less experienced specialists.
You will also contribute to building standardized tools, templates, and analytical workflows that improve the efficiency and consistency of pricing delivery. And you will contribute IP for on-going improvement of our Celerity pricing approaches. WHAT YOU’LL DOLead pricing analytics including price-volume analysis, segmentation, profitability diagnostics, and customer-level analyses. Conduct market research, including surveys and expert calls (30%)Coordinate Pricing Center of Expertise teams to build pricing models, revenue simulations (20%)Translate analytical findings into structured insights and client-ready materials (20%)Lead client discussions to collect data and share insights (15%)Work with Partners/Senior Managers to scope pricing workstreams (5%)Support development of repeatable tools, templates, and standardized pricing approaches and contribute to knowledge capture and methodology improvement (10%)
WORK MODELThis role follows a hybrid model, requiring in-office presence at least 3 days per week.
ABOUT YOURequired5+ years consulting pricing experience and/or industry experienceBA or equivalentPricing consulting experience OR industry pricing experience Experience building financial or pricing models Experience conducting quantitative business analysis Demonstrated ability to take ownership of analytical workstreams and deliver outputs with limited supervisionStrong analytical and quantitative problem solving Advanced analytics and modelling capabilities Ability to manage distributed teamsStrong communication and synthesis skills Ability to work with messy datasets and derive insights 
Preferred: MBA or advanced degree Distinct pricing experience, ideally with experience running quantitative analyses, working with large datasets, and building pricing models. Prior business consulting experience Proficiency in big data analysis tools such as Alteryx, Python and/or R 
COMPENSATIONIn The United States, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $150,000–$170,000 Annual discretionary performance bonus This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date Bain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family. Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheckGenerous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidaysFully vested 401(k) company contributionPaid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance
For all other locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level

rows.title: Commerce Strategy Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Position Summary

Across industries, commerce has become one of the most important channels for growth, customer engagement, and margin performance - not simply a transactional endpoint, but a strategic lever that shapes how customers experience a brand and how a business competes. Where organizations are rethinking the role commerce should play in their broader channel mix and how they acquire, convert, and retain customers as a result, they look to Deloitte's Commerce practice.

Our team helps clients define the role of commerce as a channel within their broader growth strategy, build the value narrative and business case for where to invest, and shape the experiences, capabilities, and operating model needed to deliver on that strategy. We bring together strategic rigor, design depth, commercial judgment, and implementation expertise to help clients translate ambition into measurable business outcomes.

The Commerce Strategy Manager is a client-facing consulting leader responsible for shaping commerce strategy engagements across industries, bringing a strategic, value-oriented lens to how clients position commerce as a critical growth channel. This role combines commerce strategy expertise and consulting execution with the judgment to connect commerce decisions to the broader commercial strategy - including customer experience, pricing, and growth strategy - helping clients prioritize the highest-value commerce use cases and carry a clear value narrative through to implementation.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 30, 2026

 Work You'll Do 

Commerce organizations are operating in a fast-changing environment shaped by shifting consumer behavior, channel fragmentation, rising customer expectations, and pressure to deliver profitable growth. Many companies are investing in commerce, but too few have a clear strategy for the role commerce should play as a channel - where to play, how to win, how commerce decisions should shape pricing, customer experience, and growth strategy, and how to prioritize the use cases that matter most.

We are looking for practitioners who can work alongside client leadership teams to define the strategic role of commerce as a channel, build the value narrative and business case for where to invest, prioritize commerce use cases, and drive the implications of that positioning across pricing, customer experience, and growth strategy - creating measurable impact that carries through into how commerce gets implemented.

As a Commerce Strategy Manager, you will be responsible for:

 Leading the day-to-day delivery of commerce strategy engagements across industries, including defining commerce's role as a growth channel, channel strategy and role definition, commerce operating model design, and experience optimization - bringing a strategic, value-oriented lens into how these strategies carry through implementation  Partnering with client business, digital, technology, and operations leaders to define commerce strategies tied to clear business outcomes  Translating business challenges into structured analyses, recommendations, and executive-ready deliverables grounded in data, customer insight, and commercial logic  Shaping commerce strategy roadmaps that span channel positioning, experience design, capability priorities, and organizational change, grounded in a clear value narrative and business case for where to invest  Driving the implications of commerce strategy and channel positioning into other parts of the commercial strategy agenda - including customer experience, pricing, and growth strategy - and helping clients prioritize commerce use cases based on business value and strategic fit  Partnering with global technical and implementation delivery teams to ensure the strategic intent and value case behind commerce decisions carry through into execution, without owning day-to-day technical delivery  Managing day-to-day client relationships, facilitating working sessions, and overseeing scope, timelines, risks, and dependencies across workstreams  Using advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, insight generation, and work quality  Supporting practice growth through proposals, solution shaping, workplans, and follow-on opportunities  Coaching teams, modeling Deloitte leadership behaviors, and contributing to an inclusive, high-performing culture 

A successful candidate should possess these skills:

 Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments; managing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements; and leading projects or workstreams.  Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and written and oral communication skills  Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and translate business needs into analytical or technology-enabled solutions.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team while building and sustaining professional relationships.  Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work products, while managing and prioritizing multiple tasks and meeting deadlines.  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor, with the ability to mentor others and provide clear guidance. 

Required

 Qualifications 

 7+ years of experience with a demonstrated history of consulting delivery in commerce strategy, digital commerce, customer experience, technology-enabled transformation, or related areas  5+ years of experience working directly with business, digital, technology, or commerce client teams  5+ years of experience shaping commerce strategies and translating them into actionable roadmaps, operating models, or implementation plans  1+ years of experience incorporating AI into daily workflow and leveraging AI tools to enable and optimize the client experience  Ability to travel up to 30%+ on average, based on the work you do and the clients you serve  Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

 4+ years working knowledge of digital commerce platforms and capabilities sufficient to inform strategy and prioritization decisions, without owning hands-on implementation  4+ years of experience leading workstreams or projects, including managing scope, timelines, deliverables, and client communication  Experience connecting commerce strategy to adjacent areas of commercial strategy, such as customer experience, pricing, or growth strategy, and translating that connection into prioritized recommendations  Experience presenting recommendations and deliverables to executive stakeholders  Experience supporting proposals, solution shaping, or workplan development  Experience growing and developing teams, especially practitioners with 0-2 years of experience 

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. rows.title: Agentic AI Engineer, Senior - Anthropic/Claude
rows.descriptionText:
Agentic AI is moving from experimentation to production, and organizations everywhere are racing to figure out how to build it responsibly and at scale. We're growing a team of engineers who want to work at the center of that shift: designing and building autonomous, multi-agent systems powered by Anthropic's Claude models for some of the world's largest organizations.

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As an AI and Data Science Engineer III on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for driving technology-focused client delivery across complex engagements.

Manage day-to-day interactions with client stakeholders and sponsors, acting as the primary technical point of contact for your workstreamDesign and build Generative AI and agentic solutions using Claude, including agent orchestration, tool integration, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) based integrations, using the Claude Agent SDK and Claude CoworkManage and deliver components of client engagements spanning solution design, prototyping, testing, and production rolloutLead small teams through business requirements gathering, functional design, process mapping, and support-model definition, providing technical direction throughoutDevelop and maintain project scope, schedule, and resource plans for your workstream, and adjust them as engagement needs evolveMonitor progress against plan, identify variances, and drive corrective action before issues affect deliveryManage changes to scope, schedule, and cost in line with the engagement's change management processIdentify risks, assumptions, and constraints early, and implement approved mitigations to protect deliveryMaintain clear, consistent communication with client stakeholders and internal engagement leadership

You'll be deployed onto client engagements that typically involve one or more of the following:

Designing and building agentic AI solutions powered by Claude, from proof-of-concept through production deploymentImplementing multi-agent systems that automate business processes, integrate with enterprise tools, and operate within defined autonomy and guardrailsModernizing existing AI/ML or data platforms to incorporate Generative AI capabilities, including retrieval-augmented generation and agent-based orchestrationAdvising clients on Generative AI adoption strategy, responsible AI practices, and model/platform selectionPartnering directly with client technology, data, and business stakeholders to scope and deliver AI solutions

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

4+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering production AI/ML solutions, including at least 1 year delivering production Generative AI or Agentic AI systems2+ years of hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications in PythonAt least 1 year of direct experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controlsAt least 1 year of hands-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using the Claude Agent SDK, including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions, or MCP integrationsAt least 1 year of hands-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models through the native Anthropic API or a supported cloud platformAt least 1 year of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs, and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability, and usability of AI solutions1+ years of experience leading project workstreams or engagements, translating business problems into AI solutions, and delivering measurable outcomesBachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related fieldAbility to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serveLimited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery rolesExperience using Claude Cowork to support enterprise workflows, automation, research, or other knowledge-work use casesHands-on experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic APIExperience with multi-agent systems, MCP integrations, agent evaluation, observability, safety controls, or production governanceCertifications such as Claude Certified Architect - Professional (CCAR-P), Claude Certified Architect - Foundations (CCAR-F), or Claude Certified Developer - Foundations (CCDV-F)Cloud certification(s) - AWS, Azure, or Google CloudExperience creating client workshop collateral and leading interactive working sessionsExperience presenting technical content to both large and small audiences
